Title: Specialista Monitoraggio Performance del Servizio
HTML:
Pensi che il tuo talento analitico possa migliorare l'esperienza di viaggio di migliaia di passeggeri? Unisciti al team di Trenord!

Per la nostra Pianificazione Strategica siamo alla ricerca di un/una:


Specialista Monitoraggio Performance del Servizio

La risorsa si occuperà di elaborare e analizzare i dati di produzione e qualità del servizio ferroviario erogato da Trenord per predisporre reportistiche e individuare azioni di miglioramento dell’efficienza e della qualità operativa.


Responsabilità principali:


  • Acquisire, validare e organizzare i dati relativi all’andamento del servizio al fine di quantificare indicatori di qualità e puntualità;
  • Presidiare il processo di alimentazione dei sistemi informativi aziendali relativamente ai dati di andamento del servizio ferroviario;
  • Predisporre report periodici e straordinari analizzando trend sul servizio per individuare aree di miglioramento, trasformando dati complessi in evidenze chiare e utilizzabili a supporto delle decisioni aziendali, anche attraverso dashboard, tabelle di sintesi e indicatori di performance;
  • Progettare e sviluppare dashboard direzionali e strumenti di monitoraggio destinati ai diversi livelli dell’organizzazione, fornendo analisi e KPI a supporto delle decisioni operative e del top management aziendale;
  • Collaborare attivamente con altre funzioni aziendali proponendo azioni correttive e iniziative finalizzate a ottimizzare le performance operative.


Requisiti:


  • Laurea in discipline tecniche;
  • 2-3 anni di esperienza in ruoli analoghi di elaborazione e analisi dati;
  • Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office, in particolare Excel;
  • Buona conoscenza di software di analisi dati e di Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau o equivalenti);
  • Buona capacità di gestione Database e utilizzo di query di base;
  • L'utilizzo pregresso di tecnologie basate su IA per l'ottimizzazione dei processi sarà considerato un plus;
  • Livello di inglese B2;
  • Capacità di problem solving e pensiero critico, così come precisione e attenzione al dettaglio;
  • Spiccata attitudine al lavoro di squadra e alla collaborazione con diverse funzioni, oltre ad una buona gestione del tempo e delle priorità per rispettare scadenze e gestire attività multiple in modo efficace.


Cosa offriamo:


  • Contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Mobilità Attività Ferroviaria;
  • Fascia retributiva offerta compresa tra 30.000 € e 35.000 € lordi annui (RAL). Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base all'esperienza pregressa e alle competenze maturate nel ruolo;
  • Libera circolazione ferroviaria;
  • Check Up medico annuale;
  • Long Term Care;
  • Supporto alla genitorialità;
  • Welfare incentivante + buoni pasto da 7.30€


Sede di lavoro: Rho Fiera Milano


L'offerta è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006 e della normativa vigente in materia di pari opportunità. L'azienda promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e garantisce pari opportunità a tutte le persone, indipendentemente da genere, età. origine, orientamento sessuale o disabilità.

Title: Pricing Analyst
HTML:
Unipol Rental S.p.A., società del Gruppo Unipol attiva nel settore del noleggio di flotte aziendali e nella gestione della mobilità in genere, è alla ricerca di un esperto professionista da inserire nel ruolo di:


Pricing Analyst - Noleggio a Lungo Termine


Sede di lavoro: Milano


Il profilo ricercato, inserito nel contesto dell’area Pianificazione e Controllo di Gestione, collaborerà con la Direzione Commerciale nella analisi e nella successiva gestione delle politiche di pricing della società con l’obiettivo di massimizzare redditività e performance.

  • Supporto alla analisi dei dati di pricing dei prodotti di noleggio a lungo termine sulla base dei dati storici, di mercato e societari;

  • Esperienza professionale (da 1 a 4 anni) in ruoli analoghi acquisita in ambito pianificazione e controllo preferibilmente maturata presso realtà del settore automotive o nel settore Noleggio Lungo Termine;
  • Conoscenza dei modelli di pricing di servizi NLT;
  • Abilità di analisi quantitativa e statistica;
  • Conoscenza ad un livello avanzato di Excel, PowerPoint e dei più comuni strumenti di Business Intelligence;
  • Completano il profilo: Capacità analitiche e organizzative; Orientamento al lavoro in team e al risultato; Problem solving;


Il candidato/a in possesso delle competenze ed esperienze richieste sarà inserito/a con rapporto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato ai sensi del CCNL Commercio alle seguenti condizioni retributive e benefits:

  • Range RAL da €. 35.000 a €. 50.000 + Bonus ad obiettivi
  • Buoni Pasto
  • Integrazione copertura assicurativa sanitaria


La ricerca è rivolta a candidati ambosessi ai sensi della L. 903/77 e del D.lgs. 198/2006.

Title: Sales Operations & Performance Analyst
HTML:
Lutech è il Gruppo leader in Italia e player europeo nel digitale e nell’intelligenza artificiale, con oltre 6.000 professionisti impegnati nello sviluppo di soluzioni innovative per aziende e istituzioni.

In Lutech tecnologia, dati e AI diventano strumenti concreti per trasformare processi, servizi ed esperienze. Attraverso competenze tecnologiche avanzate, ecosistemi digitali integrati e piattaforme AI proprietarie come Lutech BrAIn, il Gruppo accompagna l’evoluzione dell’intelligenza artificiale dall’analisi all’impatto operativo reale, in scenari complessi e internazionali.

Entrare in Lutech significa far parte di una community tecnologica globale, collaborando con team multidisciplinari su sfide reali legate ad AI, cybersecurity, cloud e digital transformation, in un ambiente inclusivo e orientato alla crescita, dove competenze, collaborazione e diversità delle esperienze contribuiscono a costruire l’evoluzione tecnologica del futuro.

Posizione

PLAY A KEY ROLE WHERE YOUR SKILLS MAKE A DIFFERENCE

Siamo alla ricerca di un* Sales Operations & Performance Analyst da inserire nell’area Sales Excellence. La risorsa avrà un ruolo centrale nel supportare la governance operativa delle vendite, contribuendo al monitoraggio delle performance commerciali, all’evoluzione dei processi e alla definizione di strumenti a supporto delle decisioni di business.

Collaborerà a stretto contatto con l’Head of Sales Operations e con le diverse funzioni aziendali, prendendo parte ai processi di Sales Forecasting e Budgeting, in collaborazione con le altre funzioni aziendali.

In Questo Ruolo Potrai

  • monitorare i KPI commerciali e analizzare gli scostamenti relativi a pipeline, ordinato, ricavi e primo margine;
  • supportare quotidianamente le figure Sales nell’utilizzo e nella gestione del CRM;
  • contribuire alla definizione e realizzazione di nuova reportistica aziendale;
  • supportare l’onboarding dei nuovi stakeholders sullo strumento CRM;
  • analizzare la Customer Base e il relativo Customer Value;
  • analizzare e mappare i processi di vendita e le procedure interne, contribuendo al loro continuo miglioramento ed efficientamento;
  • collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali, tra cui IT, AFC e Delivery, sui processi e task assegnati.

Requisiti

IS THIS THE ROLE FOR YOU?

Cerchiamo una persona analitica, curiosa e orientata al miglioramento continuo, con la capacità di muoversi in un contesto cross-funzionale e di trasformare dati e informazioni in insight utili al business.

Qui Potrai Dare Valore a Competenze Come

  • Esperienza di almeno 3/4 anni in ruoli analoghi;
  • Consolidata esperienza e conoscenza di Excel e del Pacchetto Office;
  • Conoscenza di strumenti di BI & Data Visualization, come Power BI, Tableau o equivalenti;
  • Solida esperienza nell’elaborazione e nell’analisi di grandi database;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. La conoscenza della lingua spagnola è un plus;
  • (Preferenziale) Conoscenza di Salesforce.com (modulo Sales lato utente) o di altri strumenti CRM;
  • Flessibilità, attitudine alla collaborazione e al lavoro in team, apertura al cambiamento e spirito di iniziativa orientato al continuo miglioramento.

Altre Informazioni

Dai alla tua carriera l’accelerata che sta aspettando: fai l'application ed entra in una realtà unica nel suo genere!

Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Commercio, con inquadramento a partire dal 3° livello, in base all'esperienza maturata. La Retribuzione Annua Lorda (RAL) è indicativamente compresa tra €35.000 e €45.000, da definire in funzione delle competenze, dell'esperienza e delle responsabilità del ruolo.

La sede di lavoro è Milano, con modalità di lavoro ibrida.

Nel rispetto della normativa sulla trasparenza retributiva, la retribuzione indicata rappresenta un riferimento iniziale, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. L'offerta finale sarà determinata tenendo conto delle competenze, dell'esperienza, delle responsabilità associate al ruolo e delle evidenze emerse durante il processo di selezione.

Lutech attua una politica di pari opportunità e accoglie le candidature senza operare alcuna discriminazione in base a razza, religione o convinzioni personali, origine etnica o nazionale, disabilità, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, inclusa convivenza di fatto e unione civile, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, o qualsiasi altra condizione applicabile tutelata dalla legge.

Per scoprire di più sul mondo Lutech e sulle opportunità di carriera, visita Lutech Group.

Title: Business Intelligence & Data Specialist
Description:
Chi siamo

In Mavriq, parte di Moltiply Group, aiutiamo le persone a fare la scelta giusta, che si tratti di un mutuo, un'assicurazione, una fornitura di energia, un piano telefonico o dell'acquisto di un nuovo prodotto.

Con i nostri comparatori italiani (tra cui MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it e Switcho) e internazionali (come LeLynx.fr, Rastreator.com, Pricewise.nl e Verivox.de), offriamo chiarezza in mercati spesso complessi e poco trasparenti.

Crediamo nel potere dei dati, nella trasparenza e nell'innovazione. Perché cambiare le regole, quando non funzionano al meglio, è nel nostro DNA!




Il ruolo

Cerchiamo un/a Business Intelligence & Data Specialist che contribuirà allo sviluppo di analisi avanzate, soluzioni di reporting e iniziative di Business Intelligence a supporto delle decisioni strategiche aziendali. In questo ruolo lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di business, prodotto e con il management, trasformando dati complessi in insight e sviluppando strumenti scalabili per supportare la crescita dell’organizzazione.




Cosa offriamo

Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall’incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, una RAL compresa tra i 30.000€ e i 35.000€ e un pacchetto di benefit solido: assicurazione sanitaria (CCNL Commercio), buoni pasto, welfare, e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning.




Dove lavorerai

La nostra sede è in Via Desenzano 2, Milano (MM1 Gambara). Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida: almeno due giorni a settimana in ufficio e fino a tre in smart working. I momenti in presenza sono fondamentali per confrontarci, scambiare idee e alimentare la cultura di squadra che ci distingue.




Cosa farai

Svilupperai analisi avanzate e reportistica a supporto del management e delle decisioni strategiche.
Progetterai e contribuirai all’evoluzione di architetture data warehouse e soluzioni di Business Intelligence.
Realizzerai strumenti e processi automatici e scalabili per la raccolta, l’elaborazione e la distribuzione dei dati.
Supporterai il senior management attraverso analisi dedicate e attività di problem solving data-driven.
Svilupperai la reportistica ufficiale destinata al business e ai partner esterni.
Contribuirai alla governance, alla qualità e alla sicurezza del dato.
Mappareai processi, logiche di business e modelli dati per favorire una gestione efficace delle informazioni.
Collaborerai con Data Scientist e stakeholder interni per promuovere un utilizzo sempre più autonomo ed efficace dei dati.
Svilupperai e documenterai codice e soluzioni garantendo qualità, efficienza e manutenibilità.




Cosa cerchiamo

Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline affini.
Almeno 1 anno di esperienza in ruoli di analisi dati, reporting o gestione di database.
Esperienza con architetture di Data Warehouse aziendali.
Ottime capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
Forte attenzione alla qualità del dato e ai dettagli.
Ottime capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione con stakeholder tecnici e business.
Ottima conoscenza dell’italiano e buona conoscenza dell’inglese.




Conoscenze tecniche

Strumenti di Business Intelligence e Data Visualization (Tableau, Power BI).
Database relazionali e non relazionali (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Hadoop).
Ottima conoscenza di SQL e delle logiche di modellazione dei dati.
Principi di Data Governance e Data Security.
Padronanza di Microsoft Excel.




Nice to have

Conoscenza di BigQuery, Python o Microsoft Fabric.
Certificazioni Tableau e/o Power BI.
Conoscenza del francese e/o dello spagnolo.




Altre informazioni

In Mavriq non diamo nulla per scontato: pensiamo, testiamo, impariamo.

Ogni giorno è un giorno uno, e ogni sfida è un’occasione per migliorare.

Se ti rivedi in questo approccio, non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti.




(La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle Leggi n. 903/77 e n. 125/91.)

Are you passionate about bridging business needs and data-driven solutions to generate real impact?

At Target Reply, you translate complex business requirements into actionable insights and analytics solutions that drive strategic decisions.




WHO WE ARE

Target Reply is a consulting company specialized in Analytics, Big Data, Data Science, Cloud Architectures, and Artificial Intelligence. Target Reply's main goal is simple: get value from data. How? Leveraging the capabilities of our excellent people — and that means your capabilities.

Working at Target Reply means sitting at the table with tier-one customers across several industries, playing a first-level game. You will design and implement solutions based on modern data architectures and emerging technologies: Cloud-Native solutions, Real-Time Processing, Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning — that's our bread and butter.




WHAT WILL YOU DO?

Core activities: You gather, analyze, and translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications. You bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring data solutions deliver real value.
Analytics & Reporting: You design and develop dashboards, KPIs, and reports using BI tools. You perform data analysis to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support business decisions.
AI integration: You contribute to AI and ML initiatives by defining business requirements for intelligent applications, validating model outputs, and translating results into business recommendations.

Title: Junior HR Cost & Data Analyst
Description:
Descrizione azienda

Siamo l’azienda digitale leader in Italia nella comparazione. Dal 2008 lavoriamo per rivoluzionare il modo in cui le persone scelgono assicurazioni, prodotti finanziari e spese di casa, rendendo ogni decisione più semplice e veloce. È così che ogni giorno aiutiamo milioni di persone a risparmiare tempo e denaro, online e nei nostri oltre 200 punti vendita in tutta Italia.

Posizione

Cosa ti offriamo:


Ambiente stimolante e data driven: lavoriamo cross team e questo ti darà l'opportunità di confrontarti con persone di talento e nuove attività sfidanti
Opportunità di carriera: ogni sei mesi avrai la possibilità di ricevere feedback sull’andamento del tuo percorso e la tua crescita sarà commisurata ai risultati raggiunti
Formazione continua: avrai a disposizione corsi formativi e di aggiornamento per ampliare le tue conoscenze con esperti del settore
Libertà di metterti in gioco: sarai libero di provare, fallire e provare ancora, perché secondo noi mettersi in gioco è il modo migliore per crescere



Benefit:


Remote working flessibile: sarai libero di scegliere se lavorare da casa o nei nostri uffici, dove potrai incontrare i tuoi colleghi per una riunione o una partita a biliardino
Settimana corta: il venerdì pomeriggio è off
Iniziative di welfare: piani specifici dedicati ai genitori e al tempo libero



Requisiti

Chi stiamo cercando:

Stiamo cercando un/una Junior HR Cost & Data Analyst che entrerà a far parte del team People Strategy & Data con l’obiettivo di supportare le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio, analisi dei costi del personale, contribuendo allo sviluppo della reportistica e delle dashboard HR aziendali.

Cosa farai con noi:


HR Cost Controlling
Supporto nella redazione, aggiornamento e consolidamento del budget del personale
Monitoraggio mensile dell'andamento dei costi del personale, analisi dei dati consuntivi e identificazione delle cause sottostanti agli scostamenti
Supporto nella predisposizione di commenti tecnici e analisi qualitative degli scostamenti rispetto a budget e forecast
Aggiornamento delle stime intramese e supporto alle attività di forecast e reforecast
Responsabilità diretta dell'aggiornamento, del mantenimento e della correttezza dei dati che impattano direttamente sul costo del personale all'interno del gestionale HR
Reporting & HR Dashboard
Gestione e aggiornamento periodico delle dashboard HR
Controllo della qualità e della coerenza complessiva dei dati di organico e costo
Supporto nella definizione, monitoraggio ed evoluzione dei KPI HR
Elaborazione di analisi ad hoc e implementazione di soluzioni per l'ottimizzazione, l'automatizzazione e la standardizzazione della reportistica periodica



Ecco cosa ci piacerebbe avessi:


Almeno 6 mesi di esperienza in attività di controlling, (HR) cost controlling, financial planning
Excel avanzato
Padronanza dei principali concetti economico-finanziari: budget, forecast, consuntivo, analisi degli scostamenti.
Elevato livello di precisione, cura e attenzione al dettaglio numerico
Approccio analitico e pragmatico: curiosità verso il dato per comprendere le cause reali dietro una variazione numerica, senza fermarsi al mero calcolo
Flessibilità e adattabilità: attitudine a muoversi in un contesto aziendale dinamico e in evoluzione
Collaborazione e comunicazione: facilità di interazione con differenti interlocutori (HR Administration, Finance, Management)



Nice to Have:


Conoscenza del gestionale Zucchetti



In base alle caratteristiche richieste e all'esperienza maturata, la RAL prevista è compresa tra 28.000€ e 30.000€.

Title: JUNIOR ANALYST a Cornaredo (MI)
HTML:
Da oltre 60 anni, Raben Italy è il punto di riferimento nel trasporto internazionale via terra, groupage e a carico parziale (LTL) e completo (FTL). Ma non solo, Raben Italy è anche Contract Logistics.

Nata nel 1960 come SITTAM, è entrata a far parte di Raben Group nel 2019 e, dal 2024, opera come Raben Italy. Con 13 filiali in Italia, tra cui 8 depot e 5 sales office, 300 dipendenti e oltre 50.000 m² di magazzini, siamo presenti in modo capillare sul territorio. Offriamo soluzioni su misura, efficienza, affidabilità e un servizio personalizzato che mette sempre al centro il cliente.

Grazie alla forza ed alla leadership di Raben Group, possiamo contare su oltre 13.000 dipendenti, una rete di oltre 170 filiali in 17 paesi europei e 2.000.000 m² di magazzini. Questo ci consente di garantire transit time certi per le nostre spedizioni, totale tracciabilità in tempo reale e un customer service dedicato per ogni cliente.

Siamo #PeoplewithDrive: una squadra che gioca per lo stesso obiettivo, con passione, energia e spirito imprenditoriale. Crediamo che la collaborazione porti non solo grandi risultati, ma anche grandi soddisfazioni.

In Raben Group siamo pronti ad affrontare le sfide del futuro, come il cambiamento climatico, proponendo soluzioni sostenibili e green. Annualmente redigiamo il Sustainability Report, a testimonianza dell'importanza che le tematiche ambientali, sociali e governative hanno per noi.

Posizione

La persona verrà inserita nell’Head Office RND e, attraverso l’analisi dei dati, contribuirà al monitoraggio delle performance della rete nazionale, all’ottimizzazione dei flussi operativi e al supporto delle decisioni strategiche.

La Risorsa Si Occuperà Delle Seguenti Attività

  • Raccogliere e analizzare i principali KPI relativi al trasporto nazionale, tra cui volumi, tempi di resa, saturazione dei mezzi, confronti tariffari e nuove linee nazionali;
  • Elaborare report periodici e analisi a supporto delle decisioni;
  • Monitorare le performance della rete domestica e analizzare eventuali scostamenti rispetto agli obiettivi prefissati;
  • Supportare l’implementazione di nuovi processi e l’efficientamento di quelli esistenti;
  • Analizzare i dati e fornire indicazioni utili all’ottimizzazione dei flussi operativi;
  • Collaborare con le diverse funzioni aziendali per individuare opportunità di miglioramento.

Requisiti

  • Diploma o Laurea;
  • Interesse per il settore dei trasporti e della logistica internazionale;
  • Conoscenza della lingua inglese;
  • Buona dimestichezza con il pacchetto Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel;
  • Precisione, curiosità, proattività e voglia di imparare;
  • Buone capacità organizzative e predisposizione al lavoro in team.

Altre Informazioni

  • Un ruolo di responsabilità all’interno di un’azienda dinamica, solida e con una presenza internazionale;
  • Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e collaborativo;
  • Opportunità di formazione e crescita professionale;
  • CCNL di Riferimento Logistica e Trasporto merci da 14 mensilità;
  • FASC e assistenza sanitaria integrativa SANILOG;
  • RAL: a partire da 28.000€

Title: Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist - Zona Milano
Description:
Cerchiamo un Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist

L’Energy Data Analyst & Control Specialist è responsabile del supporto al miglioramento delle prestazioni energetiche attraverso analisi dei dati, sistemi di controllo per la building automation e gestione della connettività IoT, con un focus specifico sull’integrazione e gestione delle macchine e degli impianti nella piattaforma IoT Abound.

Il ruolo assicura la disponibilità, la qualità e l’utilizzabilità dei dati operativi ed energetici provenienti da sistemi HVAC, Plant Control, BMS e sistemi di misura, abilitando attività di energy analytics, energy audit, monitoraggio delle performance e servizi di ottimizzazione data-driven.

La posizione opera in stretta collaborazione con i team Controls, Service, Engineering e Sales per fornire soluzioni energetiche affidabili, scalabili e digitalmente abilitate.

Analisi Dati Energetici & Monitoraggio delle Performance


Analizzare dati energetici e operativi provenienti da BMS, sistemi di Plant Control, dispositivi di misura e piattaforme digitali.
Sviluppare e monitorare KPI energetici, trend, baseline e benchmark.
Individuare inefficienze, anomalie e opportunità di ottimizzazione tramite analisi data-driven.
Supportare la validazione e il monitoraggio dei miglioramenti delle prestazioni energetiche nel tempo.


Controlli & Ottimizzazione dei Sistemi


Supportare la definizione e la validazione di strategie di controllo orientate all’efficienza energetica e all’affidabilità degli impianti (HVAC, chiller plant, sistemi integrati).
Contribuire alle attività di commissioning, retro-commissioning e ottimizzazione funzionale.
Verificare l’allineamento tra logiche di controllo, comportamento reale dell’impianto e performance misurate.


Connettività IoT & Gestione Piattaforma Abound


Gestire l’onboarding di macchine e impianti sulla piattaforma IoT Abound.
Supportare la configurazione dell’architettura di connettività (gateway, protocolli di comunicazione, punti dati e mappatura segnali).
Verificare continuità, accuratezza e qualità della trasmissione dati dai sistemi di campo verso Abound.
Supportare la diagnosi e la risoluzione di problematiche di connettività, perdita dati o incoerenze informative, coordinandosi con team Controls, Technical Support e Field Service.
Assicurare che i dati acquisiti siano pronti per analisi, dashboard, energy audit e servizi digitali.


Energy Audit & Supporto Tecnico


Supportare l’esecuzione di energy audit con particolare attenzione all’analisi dati e alla valutazione dei sistemi di controllo.
Contribuire all’identificazione e quantificazione delle Energy Conservation Measures (ECM).
Supportare la preparazione di report tecnici, documentazione e sintesi delle performance.


Strumenti Digitali, Standard & Collaborazione


Contribuire alla definizione di data model, standard di connessione e best practice per progetti digitali e IoT.
Supportare la valutazione della digital readiness degli impianti e la definizione di roadmap di digitalizzazione per sistemi inizialmente non connessi.
Collaborare con i team Sales e Service nelle fasi di pre-sales e delivery di soluzioni data-driven e digitali.
Promuovere la condivisione della conoscenza e il miglioramento continuo all’interno del team.


Formazione e certificazioni


Diploma tecnico (preferibilmente elettronico, elettrotecnico o termotecnico).
Laurea in Ingegneria (Energetica, Meccanica, Elettrica, Automazione o equivalente).
Esperienza in ambito building automation, controlli HVAC, energy management o analisi dati energetici.
Conoscenza di sistemi HVAC e centrali energetiche, architetture BMS/BAS/DDC, analisi dati energetici e monitoraggio delle performance.


Esperienza e competenze richieste


Esperienza in attività di energy audit e valutazioni di efficienza energetica.
Familiarità con architetture IoT applicate alla Building Automation.
Esperienza o esposizione a piattaforme digitali per energy monitoring e analytics.
Conoscenza di standard e linee guida energetiche (es. ASHRAE, ISO 50001 – preferenziale).
Spiccate capacità analitiche e di problem solving.Approccio data-driven e orientato ai risultati.Metodo di lavoro strutturato e attenzione al dettaglio.Attitudine al lavoro trasversale in team multidisciplinari.Orientamento all’innovazione digitale e al miglioramento continuo.Familiarità con strumenti digitali (reporting, piattaforme di gestione interventi, CRM o ERP.


Requisiti logistici


Residenza preferibilmente in Lombardia.
Patente B in corso di validità.
Disponibilità a trasferte su territorio nazionale.

Title: Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist
Description:
Job Title

Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist

Descrizione del ruolo

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Real Estate Performance & Reporting Specialist da inserire nel team di Asset Services-Client Finance con l’obiettivo di supportare il business nelle decisioni strategiche ed evolvere i processi di reporting.

La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nel trasformare le informazioni disponibili in strumenti chiari, accessibili e orientati all’azione, favorendo una lettura integrata delle performance e migliorando la qualità e la tempestività dei processi decisionali e l’uniformità del dato.

Sarà inserito/a e lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team di business e con le funzioni tecniche, agendo come punto di collegamento per tradurre le esigenze operative in soluzioni strutturate di reporting e monitoraggio, con un focus sul settore Real Estate.

Principali responsabilità


Supportare il monitoraggio economico-finanziario e la gestione di OPEX/CAPEX, contribuendo a migliorare visibilità e controllo delle performance.
Collaborare con i team di business per comprendere bisogni informativi e priorità decisionali, traducendoli in strumenti di reporting efficaci.
Evolvere la reportistica esistente verso modelli più dinamici, intuitivi e orientati al business, facilitandone l’utilizzo da parte degli stakeholder attraverso applicativi quali Power BI.
Contribuire alla definizione di indicatori chiave e modelli di analisi per il monitoraggio delle performance degli asset (es. turnover, footfall, redditività, costi).
Favorire una maggiore integrazione e coerenza delle fonti informative a supporto delle analisi.
Supportare la diffusione e l’adozione degli strumenti di reporting all’interno dell’organizzazione (es. Client Portal e Dashboard condivise).
Garantire l’evoluzione continua degli strumenti di reporting in funzione delle esigenze del business.


Requisiti


Esperienza in ambito reporting e analisi, performance management o supporto alle decisioni.
Capacità di comprendere esigenze di business e tradurle in soluzioni analitiche e di reporting.
Ottima conoscenza delle principali applicazioni MS Office (Excel in particolare, Word, PPT etc) incluso SharePoint.
Solida esperienza in Power BI (in particolare Power Query / ETL, DAX e data modeling) o altri strumenti di BI (ad esempio Tableau).
È preferenziale maturata esperienza con Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
Esperienza nell’utilizzo di SQL e nella gestione di database relazionali.
Esperienza nella gestione e integrazione di informazioni provenienti da fonti diverse.
Conoscenza del settore Real Estate (property/asset management, advisory o contesti affini).
Familiarità con logiche di budgeting e monitoraggio economico (OPEX/CAPEX).
Forte orientamento al business, capacità analitica e attenzione al dettaglio.
Ottime capacità relazionali e di collaborazione con stakeholder diversi (business e tecnici).
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.


Compensation and Transparency

We believe in an open and transparent approach to compensation. For this role, the base salary range is between €38,250 and €45,000 gross per annum (RAL). Positioning within the range will depend on experience, skills, and the expected impact in the role. Candidates at an early stage in their career are typically positioned towards the lower end of the range, while candidates with significant experience and the ability to deliver immediate impact may be positioned towards the upper end. We also offer a comprehensive compensation package which, in addition to benefits, may include discretionary performance-based bonuses in line with company policies. Our compensation decisions are based on clear, objective criteria, aligned with market benchmarks and internal equity.

Title: Global Customer Insights Senior Analyst
Description:
About OTB Group

OTB is an international fashion group comprising the iconic brands Diesel, Jil Sander, Maison Margiela, Marni and Viktor&Rolf. It also controls the Staff International and Brave Kid companies and holds a stake in American brand Amiri. OTB – short for “Only The Brave” – believes in the possibility of pushing beyond the frontiers of fashion and style to support the creativity of international talents and express in full the innovative spirit and uncompromising courage of its founder and chairman, Renzo Rosso. With more than 7,000 employees worldwide, the Group is founded on a digital approach centred on the consumer, a concrete long-term commitment to the creation of a sustainable, technologically driven business, and close attention to social issues through OTB Foundation.

Reporting to the Global Customer Insights Manager, the Global Customer Insights Senior Analyst supports CRM data governance, customer segmentation and analytics, helping maintain a reliable, unified customer view and turning customer data into insights and reporting that support commercial and strategic decisions.

The role is hands-on and execution-focused, covering data quality checks, KPI reporting, campaign analysis and support to predictive modeling and Customer Engagement Programs. It partners closely with the Global Customer Insights Manager and cross-functional teams (IT, Marketing, Retail) to ensure accurate, timely and actionable customer data across all touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities:


Support CRM data governance and data quality checks, helping ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR) and consent management, in partnership with IT.
Maintain and update customer database segmentation, contributing to a single, unified customer view across all touchpoints.
Build and maintain CRM KPI reports and dashboards to track acquisition, engagement and retention performance.
Analyze customer data and prepare clear, actionable summaries to support commercial and strategic decisions.
Support the development and maintenance of predictive analytics and scoring models (e.g. churn, CLV) under the guidance of the Manager.
Help define campaign targets, monitor campaign performance and support test-and-learn (A/B testing) activities.
Contribute to analytical and predictive models used for one-to-many and one-to-one targeting.
Support the implementation and day-to-day management of Customer Engagement Programs, among which the Loyalty Program.
Perform regular data quality controls and audits across CRM platforms and customer databases, flagging and helping resolve data integrity issues.
Assist in the evaluation of CRM and customer analytics tools, coordinating with IT and external vendors as needed.


Requirements:


2-4 years' experience in CRM, Customer Insights, Data Analytics or a related analytical role, ideally within luxury or premium fashion retail.
Working knowledge of CRM data governance, database segmentation and customer data management, including privacy and consent frameworks (GDPR).
Hands-on experience with data analysis and reporting tools, with the ability to build clear KPI dashboards.
Exposure to predictive/scoring models (e.g. churn, CLV) or strong interest in developing these skills.
Experience supporting CRM campaign execution and monitoring, with a test-and-learn (A/B testing) mindset.
Strong Excel and big data-handling skills; familiarity with AI is a big plus.
Good knowledge of CRM platforms and BI tools is strongly appreciated
Good stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with IT, Marketing and Retail.
Detail-oriented, analytical mindset with a proactive, hands-on approach.
Genuine passion for the client and service excellence, and knowledgeable about the Fashion & Luxury industry.
Fluent in English.


Location: Breganze (VI)

Compensation & Level:


CCNL Textile Industry, Level 6°
Salary range (gross annual): €35.000 - €42.000
Variable incentive plan: 5% of gross annual salary


The final offer will be determined based on experience, skills, and level of responsibility. We are open to candidates with different levels of seniority.

What We Offer:


A dynamic, and international work environment
Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
Exposure to multiple business functions and cross-functional collaboration
Flexible working hours and smart working options
Work-life balance initiatives
Supplementary health insurance
Supplementary pension plan
Diversity and inclusion policies
Corporate volunteering initiatives
Exclusive discounts on OTB Group brands' products
Ticket Restaurant


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion:

At OTB, we believe diversity is a strength: every perspective, background, and experience enriches our culture and fuels our creativity. We celebrate our differences and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic.

Candidates who require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the selection process are encouraged to inform the HR team: we will take every necessary step to ensure equal opportunity to participate.

Title: Group FP&A Senior Specialist GSC Insight & Analytics
Description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Overall Context

Campari Group is a major player in the global spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands including Aperol, Appleton Estate, Campari, SKYY, Wild Turkey and Grand Marnier. Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari has its own distribution network in 20 markets. The Group employs approximately 4,000 people and the shares of the parent company Davide Campari‐Milano N.V. (have been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001).

General Description Of The Role

The Group FP&A Senior Specialist, Global SC Analytics & Insights, plays a pivotal role in transforming financial data into actionable insights across the global Supply Chain organization. The role is focused on enhancing COGS and COGP transparency, identifying key performance drivers, and developing scenario-based analyses that support strategic and operational decision-making. By combining advanced analytics with a deep understanding of Supply Chain economics, the position enables Finance and business leaders to make informed decisions that drive performance.

The role acts as a center‑of‑expertise contributor, supporting standardization, automation, and the evolution of FP&A SC analytics capabilities at global level.

Key Responsibilities

This role builds and evolves the global Supply Chain FP&A analytics toolkit (COGS and COGP bridges, scenario models, and KPI dashboards) to improve cost transparency and enable faster, better decisions.

Analytics & Insight Generation


Develop and maintain analytical models to explain actual COGS performance and forecast its evolution, including drivers such as pricing, mix, productivity, inflation, foreign exchange, and operational inefficiencies.
Drive simplification and transparency of COGS frameworks through standardized methodologies and consistent analytical practices, while supporting the COGS Transformation initiative.
Monitor and analyze inventory positions to provide insights on working capital, stock levels, and supply chain performance.
Lead SG&A reporting and performance tracking for the Supply Chain function.
Contribute to global diagnosis initiatives by highlighting root causes and improvement levers.


Scenario Modeling & Strategic Analysis


Build standardized financial models for simulations and strategic scenarios (what‑if, make‑or‑buy, cost inflation, footprint, capacity).
Provide scenario‑based insights to support decision‑making under uncertainty.


Performance Dashboards & KPIs


Design and enhance global dashboards and KPIs to track Supply Chain and COGS performance consistently across regions.
Maintain clear KPI definitions and report logic across regions, functions, and reporting layers.
Support leadership reporting by turning analyses into clear visuals and concise takeaways.


Data Quality, Standardization & Automation


Help define and govern data models, KPI definitions, and analytical standards for Supply Chain FP&A reporting and analytics.
Work closely with Reporting & Analytics teams to accelerate automation and reduce manual, Excel‑driven processes.
Act as a key reference point for the best analytical practices within Global FP&A Supply Chain.


Cross‑Functional Collaboration


Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance stakeholders to align analytical outputs with business needs.
Support Finance leadership in preparing materials for senior management, performance reviews, month end closing and strategic discussions.


Key Relationships

Internal


Global FP&A Supply Chain leadership
Supply Chain Operations (Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Planning)
Group / Corporate FP&A
IR & CF teams


External: external consultants and providers

Experience Required


4-6 years of FP&A and/or data analytics
Experience in FMCG preferred
Strong exposure to Supply Chain, Manufacturing, COGS, or Operations‑related analytics
People management skills are a plus


Education / Professional Qualifications


Degree in Economics/Business Administration
Fluency of English is a must, knowledge of other languages is a plus


Functional


Advanced analytical and financial modeling capabilities
Strong understanding of cost structures, COGS drivers, and operational finance
Advanced Excel skills (power query and power pivot are a must), experience with BI tools, dashboards, and ERP (SAP) systems is highly desirable
Ability to translate data into clear, structured narratives for senior stakeholders
Knowledge of business processes in the FMCG industry


Behavioral competencies


Strong analytical curiosity, detail-oriented approach, and problem-solving mindset
Ability to synthesize complexity into clear insights
Comfortable working in global, matrix organizations
Strong communication skills and ability to influence through data
Proactive, structured, and continuous‑improvement oriented
Effective stakeholder management in a multi-cultural, matrix environnement
Able to balance hands-on execution with a continuous-improvement mindset


Additional Information


Availability to occasionally travel domestically and internationally


The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within €45,000 - €60,000, depending on the candidate's experience, skills, and overall profile.

The role is classified in accordance with the CCNL Alimentare Industria.

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.

Note to applicants:

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Notice to third party agencies:

Please refrain from cold-calling or emailing our executive leadership team or the HR community directly. The Talent Acquisition department manages centralized recruiting operations globally, including the selection and management of external suppliers. Currently, our preferred supplier list is at full capacity. To ensure we have your information on file for future consideration, we kindly request that you complete the online form provided here.

Title: Sr. Analyst , Global Operational Excellence
Description:
Description

Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.

What Makes This Role Unique


Context-switching is the job - one week you're decomposing a delivery-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto-generates root-cause narratives for business reviews.
Federated stakeholder model - you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.
GenAI as a force multiplier - you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.


Key job responsibilities


Design and own end-to-end data architectures spanning real-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
Build production-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
Architect real-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root-cause analysis when metrics move.
Develop GenAI-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root-cause analysis, reducing time-to-insight from days to minutes.
Drive deep-dive investigations across complex, multi-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network-wide impact with statistical methods.


A day in the life

You'll Have Exposure To The Full Data-product Lifecycle — From Defining Metrics To Designing Architectures, Building Pipelines, And Delivering Insights To Senior Leadership. A Typical Week Might Include


Designing pipelines that unify real-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
Building Python-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
Iterating on GenAI-powered tools and presenting data-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
Triaging emerging operational issues from real-time dashboards and providing data-backed context.


About The Team

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large-scale data analysis, automation, and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large-scale enterprise, including data-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
Experience with both real-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business-impact quantification.


Preferred Qualifications


Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.
Experience with GenAI/LLM integration - building AI-assisted analytical tools, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic workflows.
Experience with statistical analysis and experimentation (design of experiments, causal inference, A/B testing) and ML/data-mining pipelines.
Knowledge of supply-chain operations (inventory placement, network optimization, transportation, fulfillment) and Amazon internal data systems (Andes/Redshift, Cradle, Data Central, EDX).

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
You will join the Technology & Partnership Reporting team. Our team plays a key role in supporting senior management's day-to-day decision-making by delivering timely, accurate, and insightful reporting on technology initiatives and partner performance. We work closely with internal technology teams and external partners to align on reporting priorities, track performance, and surface insights that drive action, helping shape how Telenet delivers on its technology and partnership strategy.




Your tasks as a Data Analyst

You develop curiosity and a deep understanding of your domain's business context and processes.
You understand the business context and processes underlying business requests and reformulate them into clear insights questions.
You collect, query, clean, validate, and manipulate data from different sources to support reporting and analytical needs.
You define, build, and automate reporting dashboards relevant to the technology and partnership topics you are working on.
You develop a proactive partnership with your stakeholders, anticipating their needs and bringing data-driven recommendations to the table.
You perform deep-dive analyses on specific insights requests that lead to actionable recommendations for business and technology colleagues.
You contribute to optimizing reporting processes, tools, and methodologies, including the handling of ad-hoc business requests
You take an active role in the community of data professionals within Telenet, through sharing sessions, inspiration, and coaching.




Our ideal Data Analyst

You have strong analytical skills.
You have a hands-on mentality to really dive into the data and find the answers.
You have a constructive mindset and can collaborate effectively with colleagues from various teams, both from a business and a more analytical background.
You can manage an analytics initiative end to end, including strong communication & presentation skills and stakeholder management.
You have experience in reporting and a solid understanding of performance measurement.
You have solid knowledge of one of the main dashboard tools (Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau); previous Qlik Sense experience is a strong plus, as it is our primary reporting tool.
You have exceptional knowledge of SQL. Experience with Snowflake is a nice to have.
You have an interest in technology, IT, and operational processes
You have a relevant degree and experience:
Master's degree in a quantitative field (business engineering, TEW, computer science, information management, etc.)
Min. 3 years work experience.
Fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch or French is a bonus.




Our offer to you

At Telenet group, you get more than just an attractive gross salary. We strongly believe in results and ownership: we give trust but also expect commitment and impact. What you achieve truly matters.

In addition to a thirteenth-month salary and holiday pay, you can count on an extensive package of extra benefits that supports you in your daily life as well as at work.




An overview of our benefits:

Mobility budget: compose your own mobility plan, you can opt for a company car or alternative mobility solutions
Meal vouchers and eco vouchers
Mobile phone, mobile subscription, laptop, and employee discounts
Collective bonus and individual bonus (aligned with your performance)
Hospitalization insurance (including an ambulatory plan) and group insurance
20 days of paid leave and 12 compensatory days off

We value your ongoing development, investing in growth via our internal learning platform, coaching, and on-the-job training. You will have opportunities to keep learning and further strengthen yourself in your role.

We also prefer working closely together. We believe strong teams form by frequent interactions and quick transitions. To facilitate a smooth onboarding and rapid integration for new employees, we expect you to be present in the office at least three days a week during the first six months. On other days, you can work remotely from home.

Title: Data Analist
Description:
Hallo toekomstige collega, je bent van harte welkom bij Comfort Energy Group!

Bij Comfort Energy Group geloven we dat goede data leiden tot betere beslissingen. Als Data Analist vertaal jij data naar heldere inzichten, betrouwbare rapporten en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards. Daarmee help je collega’s in Finance, Sales, Operations en HR om sneller en slimmer te werken.

Jouw analyses ondersteunen zowel dagelijkse operationele beslissingen als de strategische keuzes van het management. Zo draag je rechtstreeks bij aan een efficiëntere organisatie én een betere dienstverlening aan onze klanten.

Zo krijg jij energie


Rapporten bouwen die écht gebruikt worden: Je ontwikkelt heldere en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards in Power BI voor verschillende teams binnen onze organisatie. Van het opvolgen van openstaande brandstofleveringen en operationele KPI’s tot de maandelijkse managementrapportering: jij zorgt ervoor dat de juiste informatie op het juiste moment beschikbaar is.
Sterke datamodellen ontwerpen: Je gaat verder dan mooie visuals. Je bouwt doordachte semantische modellen in Power BI, met sterschema's, correcte relaties en de juiste granulariteit. Je schrijft DAX-measures die betrouwbaar werken in elke filtercontext en werkt met onder andere row-level security. Een goed model is voor jou geen technische luxe maar de basis voor betrouwbare en performante rapportering.
Meegroeien met ons datawarehouse: Achter onze rapporten zit een dbt-datawarehouse op Azure SQL Server. In het begin ben je vooral gebruiker van dit warehouse. Naarmate je groeit in de rol, krijg je alle ruimte om ook zelf mee te bouwen en je kennis verder uit te breiden.
Waken over datakwaliteit: Je neemt datakwaliteit serieus. Je documenteert definities, controleert en test je cijfers voordat rapporten bij eindgebruikers terechtkomen en zorgt ervoor dat je oplossingen duidelijk en overdraagbaar zijn.
Samenwerken in een klein en sterk datateam: Je komt terecht in een compact en ervaren team, samen met een data-analist en data engineer. Je staat er dus nooit alleen voor en kunt rekenen op veel kennis en ondersteuning. Tegelijk krijg je de verantwoordelijkheid en autonomie om je eigen rapporten en stakeholders op te volgen.


Zo breng jij energie


Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Data Science, Statistiek, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting, of je hebt gelijkwaardige ervaring.
Je hebt een zeer goede kennis van Power BI en beheerst niet alleen de visualisaties, maar ook DAX en het onderliggende datamodel.
Je hebt een goede kennis van SQL en begrijpt wat je schrijft. Joins en CTE’s zijn voor jou vertrouwde concepten.
Je denkt vanuit datamodellen en begrijpt welke gevolgen een verkeerde granulariteit of structuur kan hebben voor rapportering.
Ervaring met dbt, Git, Python of Azure Data Factory is een plus, maar geen must. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent en graag nieuwe technologieën leert.
Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt complexe technische materie helder uitleggen aan collega’s zonder technische achtergrond.
Je werkt gestructureerd, maar kunt ook flexibel inspelen op veranderende omstandigheden.
Je bent proactief: je ziet kansen om data en processen te verbeteren en neemt gericht initiatief om tot oplossingen te komen.
Je denkt ‘ah zo denk ik er ook over’ als je onze ENER²GY-waarden leest.
Je communiceert zeer vlot in het Nederlands en kunt je ook goed uitdrukken in het Frans.


Zo geven wij jou energie


Vast contract van onbepaalde duur met een marktconform salaris, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en skills.
Bovenop je salaris maaltijdcheques, ecocheques en een bedrijfswagen inclusief tank-/laadpas.
32 verlofdagen voor een gezonde werk-privébalans (20 wettelijke, 12 arbeidsduurverminderingsdagen).
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering, plus een fietsplan na 6 maanden dienst.
Welzijnsinitiatieven zoals een jaarlijkse bezoek aan de bedrijfskinesist, griepvaccinterugbetaling, en begeleiding door een well-being coach.

Title: Corporate Data Analist
Description:
Onze klant, een toonaangevende en mensgerichte organisatie gespecialiseerd in dienstverlening voor ondernemers, zoekt een Corporate Data Analist om complexe data te vertalen naar strategische groei. In deze rol combineer je technische expertise met business-inzicht om de digitale maturiteit en operationele efficiëntie van de organisatie direct te beïnvloeden.

Responsibilities

Je werkt nauw samen met corporate diensten, data engineers en data architects om de vertaalslag te maken van ruwe data naar waardevolle sturingsinformatie. Je rapporteert over de voortgang van de analytics roadmap en adviseert stakeholders op basis van jouw bevindingen.


In kaart brengen van businessbehoeften en deze vertalen naar relevante analyses, dashboards en datagedreven inzichten ter ondersteuning van strategische beslissingen.
Ontwikkelen, testen en optimaliseren van dataproducten die trends, opportuniteiten en risico’s visualiseren voor het management.
Beheren van de prioriteiten binnen de analytics roadmap, rekening houdend met budgetten, GDPR, security en technische haalbaarheid.
Bewaken van de datakwaliteit en consistentie door het toepassen van standaarden en kwaliteitscontroles.
Omzetten van data-inzichten naar concrete beleidsaanbevelingen voor de verdere uitbouw van de organisatie.
Opvolgen van innovaties binnen data en analytics om processen en besluitvorming continu te professionaliseren.


Requirements


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma in een analytische richting of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring.
Je hebt sterke ervaring met het modelleren van datasets en het bouwen van rapportages in Power BI.
Je beschikt over een diepgaande kennis van DAX om complexe logica te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
Je hebt ervaring in het samenwerken met diverse stakeholders en kunt vlot schakelen tussen business-noden en technische IT-oplossingen.
Je bent in staat om complexe materie begrijpelijk over te brengen aan verschillende doelgroepen.
Je bent kritisch, nieuwsgierig en proactief ingesteld om verbeterpotentieel binnen de organisatie te detecteren.
Je beschikt over uitstekende organisatorische vaardigheden om diverse projecten en deadlines efficiënt te beheren.
Je bent communicatief vaardig en vloeiend in het Nederlands.
Affiniteit met data-architectuur en databeveiliging is een pluspunt.


Offer


Contract: vast contract van onbepaalde duur.
Extra-legale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met laadpas en laadinstallatie, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, cadeaucheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, pensioenfonds, loonbonus en een flexibel verloningssysteem (o.a. fietsleasing).
Arbeidsregime: voltijds (38u) met een glijdend uurrooster.
Werkmodel: hybride (telewerk mogelijk na de inwerkperiode).
Vakantie: 32 vakantiedagen bij een voltijdse tewerkstelling.
Opleiding: uitgebreid aanbod aan e-learnings en georganiseerde opleidingen voor persoonlijke groei.
Atmosfeer: een professionele werkomgeving met een sterke focus op welzijn en een informele compagnon-cultuur.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
At Decathlon, our ambition is to bring people together through sport to make physical, mental, and social well-being accessible to everyone. We believe in the power of the team, shared experiences, and prevention through sport to build a happier world. Do you share this vision? Join us!




Do you love making data speak to solve real business challenges? Within our Data team, you turn complex data into clear decision-making levers for our business teams. Your work directly guides our strategy to create value every day.

Mission

Translation of business needs: you listen to team requests, challenge assumptions, and define precise analytical questions.
Exploration and cleaning data: you identify the best internal and external data sources, check their quality, and prepare data using SQL, Python, or dbt.
Building concrete solutions: you create reusable metrics, design prototypes, and test your hypotheses with statistical models.
Explaining your analysis: you explain complex results using visual storytelling on Tableau or other BI tools to convince non-technical colleagues.
Working as a team: you document your methods on Git, share best practices with your peers, and care for your own well-being as much as your teammates.




Job Profile

You are passionate about digital, love numbers, and embody our active values every day.

Rigorous and proactive, you organize your work independently, self-motivate, and naturally propose hypotheses and actionable recommendations.

You communicate clearly, you can break down complex findings into simple, synthetic reports for non-technical teammates. Having a good understanding of the business and a good critical thinking, you encounter an operational problem and immediately spot the data needed to solve it.




Moreover,

You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering, informatics, or statistics with a specialization in data engineering, big data, or data science and you bring at least 3 years of hands-on experience in a data analyst role.
You master data languages: you navigate SQL and Python and R with ease.
You bring insights to life with high-impact dashboards using Tableau, Looker Studio, or Power BI.
You bring hands-on experience with cloud environments like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
A real plus: You are familiar with dbt, DataBricks, have knowledge on Gen AI, on A/B testing strategies and logic and you are product builder (app, assistant)
You are fluent in French with a solid level in English for our international context (basic Dutch is a plus).




What we offer

A meaningful project: You join a supportive team (Data Engineers, Datascientists, Data Analysts, Product Manager) where trust is given on day one.
Real impact: Your analyses directly shape strategic business decisions.
A stimulating environment: You will be working in our headquarters in Brussels (Evere).




Ready to make data talk with us? Apply today and let's play together!

Title: Data Analyst – Customer & Usage Experience

Role And Responsibilities

Within the Customer & Usage Experience squad, we are committed to enhancing the experience of customers by leveraging big data using cutting-edge tools and technologies. As a data analyst, you will play a key role in identifying new customer & usage experience insights through innovative methods, models, and impactful visualizations, with the objective of driving meaningful improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with BI specialists, data scientists, and big data experts to tackle challenges and achieve measurable results.

Skilled in statistical analysis techniques (e.g., multinomial confidence intervals, correlations, data reduction, clustering, segmentation, Bayesian algorithms, hierarchical regressions, machine learning).
Capable of translating business needs into analytical requests and effectively communicating technical results to non-technical stakeholders through clear and appropriate visualizations.
Result-oriented, with a proven ability to transform data into actionable insights that create business value.
Responsible, result-driven, and passionate about data; a team player who continuously seeks creative solutions and who can also work independently towards high-quality results.
Master’s degree in computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics, with programming experience.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience.
Languages: NL/EN or FR/EN.
Knowledge of telecommunications and experience with data pipelines creation/maintenance is a plus.

Within the Customer & Usage Experience squad, we are committed to enhancing the experience of customers by leveraging big data using cutting-edge tools and technologies. As a data analyst, you will play a key role in identifying new customer & usage experience insights through innovative methods, models, and impactful visualizations, with the objective of driving meaningful improvement initiatives. You will collaborate closely with BI specialists, data scientists, and big data experts to tackle challenges and achieve measurable results.

Your Profile

  • Hands-on coding experience with SQL and Python (experience with PySpark is a plus).
  • Proficient in creating Power BI visualizations (knowledge of DAX is a plus).
  • Experienced with traditional relational databases on-premises, as well as with big-data environments and cloud technologies such as Azure, Cloudera, Hadoop, and Teradata.
  • Skilled in statistical analysis techniques (e.g., multinomial confidence intervals, correlations, data reduction, clustering, segmentation, Bayesian algorithms, hierarchical regressions, machine learning).
  • Capable of translating business needs into analytical requests and effectively communicating technical results to non-technical stakeholders through clear and appropriate visualizations.
  • Result-oriented, with a proven ability to transform data into actionable insights that create business value.
  • Responsible, result-driven, and passionate about data; a team player who continuously seeks creative solutions and who can also work independently towards high-quality results.
  • Master’s degree in computer science, applied mathematics, or statistics, with programming experience.
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience.
  • Languages: NL/EN or FR/EN.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications and experience with data pipelines creation/maintenance is a plus.

Title: Data Analyst - Aftermarket
Description:
Are you passionate about data, dashboards, and translating numbers into meaningful business insights?

Do you enjoy working with Power BI and helping teams make smarter decisions?

Then this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

We are looking for a motivated Data Analyst to strengthen our Aftermarket team. In this role, you will help transform data into actionable insights that support business performance, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence across our aftermarket activities.

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained some experience, we offer the opportunity to develop your analytical skills in an international and dynamic environment.




What can you expect from this challenging role?

As a Data Analyst within the Aftermarket department, you will collect, analyze, and visualize data related to spare parts sales, inventory, service performance, and business operations. Your insights will help stakeholders identify opportunities, monitor performance, and support strategic decision-making.

Data Analysis & Insights

Collect, cleanse, and analyze data from various aftermarket systems and data sources.
Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities within sales, inventory, service, and operational data.
Translate complex datasets into clear and actionable business insights.
Support data-driven decision-making across the Aftermarket organization.

Dashboarding & Reporting

Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Monitor and report on key business KPIs.
Create impactful visualizations that help stakeholders quickly understand business performance.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reports.

Business Intelligence & Process Improvement

Support the continuous improvement of reporting processes and data quality.
Help automate recurring reports and analytical processes.
Contribute to the development of standardized reporting frameworks and KPI structures.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through data and analytics.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with colleagues from Aftermarket, Parts Sales, Service, Supply Chain, and Finance.
Gather business requirements and translate them into reporting and dashboard solutions.
Present findings and recommendations in a clear and understandable way.
Support strategic and operational projects with data analysis and performance tracking.




Are you the new colleague we are looking for?

You have a strong interest in data analytics, reporting, and business intelligence.
You have knowledge of Power BI and data visualization principles.
You are comfortable working with Excel and large datasets.
Experience as a Data Analyst is a plus, but not required.
Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
You have an analytical mindset and enjoy solving problems using data.
You are eager to learn and continuously develop your technical skills.
You can translate business needs into meaningful reports and insights.
You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders.
You are fluent in English and Dutch.

Nice to have

Knowledge of Power Query, DAX, SQL, or other data analytics tools.
Interest in aftermarket, spare parts, service operations, or supply chain processes.
Experience gained through internships, academic projects, or personal projects involving dashboarding and analytics.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Role: Data Analyst
Level: Medior
Scope: Support our GTM teams with analytics, reporting, and operational insights, as well as assist with some of our internal AI-related initiatives
Language requirement: Fluent in English
Location: Ghent, Belgium, with hybrid/on-site working model


Who are we and why should you care?

Teamleader is a SaaS scale-up born in 2012 in Ghent, Belgium, and part of the Visma Group since 2022. Our mission? To make work easier, not harder , for small and medium-sized businesses.

Here’s What We Bring To The Table


Teamleader Focus : the all-in-one tool that helps small businesses optimise CRM, projects, and invoicing.
Teamleader One : the go-to e-invoicing software that self-employed pros can count on.


We’ve Also Been Growing Smarter Through Strategic Acquisitions


Teamleader Orbit (2019): helping medium-sized agencies thrive and scale.
Vectera (2022): powering seamless customer meetings.
Dexxter (2024): making financial admin a breeze for freelancers.


Curious to learn more about us, our products, and why you’ll love working at Teamleader? Check us out here .

We Are Looking for an Data Analyst to Join us

We are looking for a Data Analyst to join our central Data & Revops Team . In this role, you will turn data into actionable insights across the full customer funnel, from Marketing and Sales through onboarding, usage, and retention.

You will work closely with GTM teams, product stakeholders, and fellow data colleagues to deliver high impact analysis, dashboards, and data stories that influence decision making. In addition, you will contribute to the rollout of applied AI use cases by preparing high quality datasets, supporting automation, and helping translate insights into scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on, impact-driven role focused on applied analytics and AI rather than research-oriented data science.

As a Data Analyst At Teamleader, You Will


Analyze performance across the full Go-to-Market funnel, including acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, and expansion
Build and maintain dashboards and reporting layers using Looker to enable self-serve insights across teams
Create clear data stories and communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations to business stakeholders
Collaborate with GTM and Product teams to define metrics, ensure reliable tracking, and evaluate experiments or initiatives
Work with structured datasets in Snowflake , including relational modeling using SQL
Support recurring analytics needs as well as ad hoc deep dives across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product
Contribute to applied AI initiatives by preparing datasets, identifying automation opportunities, and supporting insight generation workflows
Help improve data quality, documentation, and analytical best practices across the organization
Take ownership of analytics projects from scoping through delivery, in close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders


Why others chose Teamleader: we're lively, not corporate

We have the energy and boldness of a start-up and the expertise and pragmatism of a scale-up. The result: a team of both young and seasoned professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who give recognition and rewards for hard work. You’ll be working in a fast-paced tech environment with open feedback culture and room for initiatives as well as ideas. You’ll have plenty of room to apply your personality, express yourself, and impact our course of action with your insights or ideas.

On Top Of That, You’ll Get


An extensive training budget.
A hybrid working model: a pleasant mix of office and home working.
A personal tooling budget, to make working from home as comfortable as from our offices.
Daily budget-friendly in-house prepared lunch and dinner options (only in our Ghent office), as well as Friyays and numerous sport initiatives!
32 holidays on top of the standard public ones! (based on full-time employment).
Our long-lasting dedication to employee well-being, just take a look at our career page and Instagram to see how we keep the Team(leader) spirit going.


We value diversity

Our ambition is to build and sell a product that helps everyone everywhere (starting with Europe) to work smarter, so we want our team to reflect that. We believe that a diverse, inclusive working environment is crucial to realise that ambition, so we’re committed to continue to build and cherish a culture where every colleague feels welcome, appreciated and heard.

Job Requirements

You’d be a great fit for this role if you:


3–5 years of experience in a Data Scientist, Data Analyst, or Analytics role
Strong SQL skills and solid understanding of relational data modeling
Proven experience building dashboards and visualizations using tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI
Ability to translate complex analyses into clear business insight s and actionable recommendations
Experience working with funnel metrics and business KPIs
Comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset and ability to work autonomously on projects


Bonus If You Have


Experience with Snowflake or other modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Redshift)
Familiarity with GTM systems such as HubSpot or similar CRMs
Exposure to experimentation, A/B testing, or product analytics
Hands-on experience with AI-driven workflow automation tools and processes
Experience bringing analytics or automation workflows into production
Interest in AI, automation, and scalable analytics solutions
Experience in SaaS or B2B environments


Interested? Questions? Get in touch!

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to analyse, transform, and visualise complex datasets while contributing to enterprise data platforms and Business Intelligence solutions within an international environment.

🔹Who We Are🔹

Altia is a high-value digital transformation services company that has undertaken, changed, and reformulated international projects for nearly a thousand clients, leaders in their sectors, who have understood that their businesses can be revolutionized through digitalization. Over its 30 years of experience, it has proven to be a robust company with a future, a capacity for innovation, and adaptability.

You will contribute to data analysis, data modelling, Business Intelligence, and data integration activities within an international project supporting a prestigious European agency, ensuring the quality, consistency, accessibility, and effective visualisation of enterprise data.

ETL & Data Integration: Design and maintain data transformation processes, pipelines, and workflows using modern integration and orchestration technologies.

Data Analysis & Programming: SQL, Python, R, data manipulation, advanced analytics and data processing.

Data Warehousing & Modelling: Data Warehouses, dimensional modelling, relational databases and analytical data structures.

Business Intelligence: BI platforms, dashboards, reporting, data visualisation and advanced analytical solutions.

Data Engineering: ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, workflow orchestration and data integration.

Our offer
