Title: Reporting & Analytics Specialist
Description:
Wat ga je doen

Als Reporting & Analytics Specialist bent u verantwoordelijk voor het leveren van de nodige rapportages aan de operatie om de operationele prestaties te maximaliseren, evenals de benodigde analyses om de uitvoering te verbeteren. U gebruikt deze inzichten om de operationele processen in vraag te stellen en verbeteringen door te voeren binnen de organisatie.

Je beschikt over uitgebreide technische vaardigheden om data te verzamelen, verbeteren en toe te passen op een manier die ten goede komt aan de gehele organisatie.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de goede uitvoering van de logistiek door het juiste gegevensmateriaal/rapportages op het juiste moment te leveren.

Je meet, evalueert, verdedigt en daagt de KPI's uit van alle logistieke belanghebbenden, zoekt naar procesverbeteringen om de prestaties van distributiecentra en transport te optimaliseren en zorgt voor een effectieve en efficiënte operationele samenwerking.

Je ondersteunt de operatie door de go-to partner te zijn voor alle rapportagebehoeften.

Als expert op het gebied van rapportage en de benodigde tools (Excel, PowerBI, Databricks), analyseert en ontwikkelt het team de rapportages die nodig zijn om de operationele uitvoering te verbeteren.

Je fungeert als kenniscentrum voor de analyse van logistieke/transporte data. U analyseert de huidige configuratie van data en rapportages om mogelijke verbeteringen te identificeren op het gebied van nauwkeurigheid, toegankelijkheid en beschikbaarheid.

Je neemt deel aan data- en rapportageprojecten, volgens het projectplan en de voorgestelde resultaten, om ervoor te zorgen dat het project binnen het budget, de tijdslimieten en de overeengekomen doelstellingen wordt opgeleverd.

Je richt zich meer op de ontwikkeling van nieuwe technieken, standaardisatie en fungeert als architect van een oplossing.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent in het bezit van een bachelordiploma of beschikt over een gelijkwaardige ervaring. Jij hebt 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring in data of Business Intelligence.

Jij hebt een uitstekende operationele kennis van alle logistieke en supply chain-processen.

Jij hebt een analytisch denkvermogen en weet data om te zetten in bruikbare informatie.

Jij bent drietalig (NL/FR/EN) en beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden.

Jij bent een expert in MS Office: Jij hebt een diepgaande kennis van Business Intelligence-tools en -platforms zoals Power BI en Azure Databricks. Jij beheerst data-analyse talen en technologieën zoals SQL, Python en/of R.

Jij bent veelzijdig, klantgericht en stressbestendig.

Waar werk je

Asse/Zellik - afdeling OPERATIONS PLANNING

Wat we bieden

Een job én een rijkelijk gevuld privéleven? Bij Delhaize kan dat. Je krijgt een aantrekkelijk loon aangepast aan jouw ervaring. Bovendien geniet je van diverse extralegale voordelen: bedrijfswagen met tank- of laadkaart binnen het federaal mobiliteitsbudget, gsm plus abonnement, netto vergoeding, jaarlijkse bonus, maaltijdcheques, uitgebreide groepsverzekering en facultatieve hospitalisatieverzekering en uiteraard een personeelskorting in de winkel! Je krijgt ook toegang tot onze fitness en een gevarieerd aanbod aan groepslessen. Thuiswerk spreekt voor zich en wordt voor elke job anders ingevuld. En groeien? Dat gaat hard bij Delhaize. Door de opleidingen, op de werkvloer én via onze opleidingscatalogus, krijg je daar de ruimte voor. Doorgroeien? Ook dat kan. Vraag maar aan één van je toekomstige collega’s. Spreekt bovenstaande functie jou aan? Solliciteer dan onmiddellijk en ontdek wat jouw mogelijkheden zijn bij Delhaize!

Over Delhaize

Beter leven begint bij beter eten. Dat geloven wij bij Delhaize met heel ons hart. Daarom zetten wij ons in voor het eten op het bord van 5 miljoen klanten, elke week opnieuw. In meer dan 810 winkels kunnen Belgische en Luxemburgse klanten terecht voor een uitgebreid assortiment van meer dan 20.000 kwaliteitsproducten. Van een snelle stop in een Shop&Go, over dagelijkse boodschappen in een lokale Proxy tot een ruim aanbod binnen onze AD Delhaize's; en vergeet zeker onze e-commerce diensten niet.

Die hele keten van voeding, die start binnen onze Logistiek. De 2200 collega's in onze distributiecentra van Zellik en Ninove verwerken dagelijks alle producten van onze leveranciers, vaak van Belgische bodem, en brengen deze via meer dan 3000 leveringen per dag tot bij onze winkels.

Maar het stopt niet in onze winkels of logistiek. Want ook onze meer dan 1000 collega's binnen Finance, HR, IT, Commerce of Legal staan staan om elkaar en onze klanten te helpen goed te eten.

Strong understanding of data strategy, governance, security, and reporting standards.
Experience working in Agile and digital environments.
Master’s degree in statistics, mathematics, economics, another quantitative discipline, or an alternative academic background supported by substantial analytics expertise.
Fluent spoken and written Dutch, French, and English.
Strong communication, analytical, stakeholder-management, and teamwork skills.

Title: Research & Insights Analyst F/M (Advanced Quant & Data Integration)
Description:
Are you excited for your new career adventure?   


At Lyreco, we offer more than just a job, but a career!

About Lyreco

Lyreco is the European leader and the third largest distributor of workplace products and services in the world. Privately owned since 1926, Lyreco has continuously adapted to the evolving workplace through operational excellence, strong customer focus, and long-term supplier partnerships.

With more than 12,000 employees, Lyreco operates directly in 25 countries across Europe and Asia and covers 17 additional markets through a network of distribution partners.

To learn more about Lyreco – see our career website here

What We Offer

To support the development of our Customer Intelligence Team, we are looking for a Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst who will help us transform customer knowledge into meaningful business decisions.

As Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst, you will play a key role in generating actionable customer insights through advanced quantitative research and data analysis.

Working closely with Customer Experience, Marketing, Sales Excellence and Merchandising stakeholders, you will connect multiple data sources and uncover the customer behaviours, needs and drivers that help shape strategic business decisions.

You will join an international team of customer research, journey management and service design professionals focused on turning insights into action.

In This Role You Will


Design and execute quantitative research projects to better understand customer needs, behaviours and expectations.
Gather business information needs and translate them into research objectives and methodologies.
Conduct advanced statistical analyses including segmentation, cluster analysis, regression analysis and driver modelling.
Analyse and connect multiple data sources including survey data, CRM information, digital analytics, customer care interactions and revenue data.
Identify patterns, correlations and key drivers influencing customer behaviour and business performance.
Develop dashboards and reporting solutions combining behavioural, attitudinal and operational data.
Collaborate with external research agencies when required and ensure business needs are translated into research requirements.
Partner with internal stakeholders to transform complex analyses into clear and actionable business recommendations.
Support the evolution of customer intelligence capabilities across Lyreco by helping connect existing data sources and uncovering new insights opportunities.



YOUR PROFILE



Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Market Research, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing Analytics, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Market Research, Customer Insights, Consumer Insights or Analytics.
Strong expertise in quantitative research methodologies and advanced statistical analysis.

Onze klant is een engineering- en exploitatiebedrijf gespecialiseerd in technisch gebouwbeheer, waterbehandeling en energieoplossingen, waaronder HVAC, hernieuwbare energie, energieoptimalisatie en technische installaties.

In deze functie centraliseer, structureer en analyseer je technische gegevens van verschillende gebouwen en installaties en zet je deze om in duidelijke en bruikbare informatie.

Je bevindt je op het kruispunt van data-analyse, facility management en speciale technieken. Op basis van beschikbare gegevens help je technische prioriteiten te bepalen en acties op korte, middellange en lange termijn te plannen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden


Centraliseren van technische rapporten afkomstig van installaties, technische teams en externe keuringsorganismen.
Gegevens uit verschillende bronnen en tools verzamelen, structureren en combineren.
Ontwikkelen van duidelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke dashboards.
Analyseren van technische gegevens rond HVAC, elektriciteit, BMS, sanitair en andere gebouwtechnieken.
Technische data vertalen naar concrete acties en aanbevelingen.
Prioriteiten bepalen en bijdragen aan de technische planning.
Technische vaststellingen analyseren en de impact ervan op installaties beoordelen.
Synergieën en terugkerende problemen identificeren over verschillende gebouwen en projecten heen.
Visualisatietools ontwikkelen om technische informatie en trends inzichtelijk te maken.
Vervaldatums van keuringen, certificaten, rapporten en technische documenten opvolgen.
Betrokken partijen tijdig informeren en de nodige acties voor vernieuwing coördineren.
Samenwerken met techniekers, ingenieurs, facility managers en verantwoordelijken op de verschillende sites.
Bijdragen aan de digitalisering en optimalisatie van technische beheerprocessen.



Jouw profiel


Je beschikt over een Bachelor- of ingenieursdiploma in een relevante technische richting.
Je hebt ongeveer 10 jaar ervaring in een technische omgeving, bij voorkeur binnen gebouwenbeheer, industrie of facility management.
Je hebt een goede kennis van verschillende technische disciplines, zoals HVAC, elektriciteit, BMS, sanitair en speciale technieken.
Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met data-analyse, datavisualisatie en digitale tools.
Ervaring met of interesse in AI-toepassingen is een pluspunt.
Je kunt complexe technische informatie analyseren en vertalen naar duidelijke KPI's, prioriteiten en acties.
Je bent in staat verschillende stakeholders te coördineren en, indien nodig, medewerkers aan te sturen.
Je werkt analytisch, gestructureerd en oplossingsgericht.
Je bent zelfstandig en kunt verschillende dossiers en prioriteiten tegelijkertijd beheren.
Je spreekt Nederlands of Frans en beschikt over een goede kennis van het Engels.

Een multidisciplinaire functie waarin data, engineering en technisch gebouwbeheer samenkomen.
Afwisselende projecten op verschillende sites en technische installaties.
Veel autonomie en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
Een groeiende technische organisatie met mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling.

Let’s shape the future of finance - together

At Isabel, we believe that real innovation happens when people and ideas connect

That’s why we’re building more than technology, we’re building an ecosystem.

One where every voice counts, and where your work can truly make a difference.

We’re looking for curious minds and collaborative builders. People who believe success means growing together, learning from each other, and challenging the status quo.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

What You’ll Do

Strengthen Isabel’s AI-native data team by combining BI development with functional business and data-domain expertise.

An important objective is to go beyond delivering static reports and dashboards. This person will enable business users to interact directly and intuitively with data, using self-service BI, AI-powered solutions, and potentially conversational data experiences. This should make trusted data and insights more accessible while maintaining appropriate governance and quality.

Main tasks


Develop a strong functional understanding of Isabel’s business and data domains.
Engage with stakeholders to identify reporting, analytical, and operational needs.
Translate these needs into dashboards, insights, data products, and operational solutions.
Enable business users to explore, question, and interact with data through self-service and AI-powered capabilities.
Create intuitive and governed data experiences that reduce dependency on the data team for recurring questions.
Develop solutions using Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and related technologies.
Work closely with data engineers and business and technical stakeholders.
Apply an AI-native approach to analysis, development, testing, documentation, and delivery.
Proactively identify relevant insights, data-quality issues, and opportunities for business or process improvement.
Help improve data literacy and encourage effective use of data across the organisation.


Job Requirements

What makes you a great fit


A hybrid functional and technical BI/data professional.
Strong stakeholder-management and requirements-analysis skills.
Able to understand complex business processes and data domains.
Hands-on knowledge of Databricks, Power BI, SQL, and modern data platforms.
Fluent in AI-assisted development and capable of creating AI-enabled ways for users to access and interact with data.
Able to make complex data understandable and accessible to non-technical users.
Proactive, curious, collaborative, and focused on delivering business value.


Why join us

At Isabel, we offer more than a job, we offer a place to grow, contribute, and thrive.


A human-sized Belgian company (250 people) where your ideas and impact matter
50% hybrid work, flexible hours, and autonomy to manage your time

A flat, collaborative structure with real ownership and cross-functional work
Competitive rewards: Flex Income Plan, annual bonus, insurance, meal vouchers
A strong engagement culture and inclusive mindset
Easy mobility options: our MOBI strategy supports flexible, low-footprint commuting, whether by bike, public transport, or electric car
Professional gatherings that encourage collaboration and networking, as well as fun and purposeful activities led by our BeFun team
A certified Top Employer with 30 years of tech leadership and ambition


Ready to join us?

Your voice, your vision, and your impact all have a place here.

Let’s shape smarter solutions and a stronger digital economy. Together.

Title: Data Analyst & Planning Coordinator H/F/X
Description:
Notre client

Notre client est une société d'ingénierie et d'exploitation spécialisée dans la gestion technique des bâtiments, le traitement de l'eau et les solutions énergétiques : HVAC, énergies renouvelables, optimisation énergétique et installations techniques.

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités, notre client recherche un(e) Data Analyst & Planning Coordinator disposant d'une solide compréhension des techniques du bâtiment.

Votre mission

Votre rôle consiste à centraliser, structurer et analyser les données techniques provenant de différents bâtiments et installations afin de les transformer en informations exploitables.

À l'intersection de la data, du facility management et des techniques spéciales, vous développez une vision claire de l'état des installations et contribuez à la planification des actions techniques à court, moyen et long terme.

Vos responsabilités


Centraliser les rapports techniques provenant des installations, équipes terrain et organismes de contrôle.
Structurer et consolider les données issues de différentes sources et outils.
Développer des dashboards simples et efficaces permettant de suivre les informations essentielles.
Analyser les données techniques liées notamment au HVAC, à l'électricité, au BMS et aux installations sanitaires.
Transformer les données disponibles en plans d'action et en recommandations concrètes.
Identifier les priorités d'intervention et contribuer à l'élaboration des plannings techniques.
Analyser les constats réalisés sur site et évaluer leur impact sur les installations.
Identifier les synergies et problématiques communes entre plusieurs bâtiments ou projets.
Développer des outils de visualisation facilitant le suivi et la prise de décision.
Suivre les échéances des contrôles, rapports, certifications et autres documents techniques.
Alerter les parties concernées et coordonner les actions nécessaires avant expiration.
Collaborer avec les équipes techniques, responsables de sites, ingénieurs et autres intervenants.
Participer à l'amélioration et à la digitalisation des processus de gestion technique.



Votre profil


Formation de niveau Bachelor ou Ingénieur dans un domaine technique pertinent.
Environ 10 ans d'expérience dans un environnement technique, idéalement lié aux bâtiments, à l'industrie ou au facility management.
Bonne compréhension de plusieurs disciplines : HVAC, électricité, BMS, sanitaire et techniques spéciales.
Forte affinité avec la data analyse, la visualisation de données et les outils digitaux.
Un intérêt ou une expérience avec des solutions basées sur l'IA constitue un atout.
Capacité à interpréter des informations techniques et à les transformer en indicateurs et actions concrètes.
Capacité à coordonner différents intervenants et, lorsque nécessaire, à superviser des collaborateurs.
Profil analytique, structuré et orienté solutions.
Autonomie et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.
Vous maîtrisez le français ou le néerlandais, ainsi que l'anglais.



Notre offre


Une fonction multidisciplinaire combinant data, ingénierie et gestion technique des bâtiments.
Des projets variés sur différents sites et installations.
Une organisation à taille humaine favorisant l'autonomie et la prise d'initiative.
Un environnement technique en croissance offrant de réelles possibilités d'évolution.
Un package salarial attractif complété par des avantages extralégaux : chèques-repas, indemnité forfaitaire nette, assurances groupe et hospitalisation, GSM, ordinateur portable et 6 jours RTT supplémentaires.

Title: VIE - Business Analyst / Data Analyst BCBS 239
Description:
Context

Degroof Petercam recherche un Business Analyst / Data Analyst BCBS 239 pour le périmètre Finance, basé à Bruxelles au sein du Chief Financial Office.

Le poste s’inscrit dans le périmètre BCBS 239 de la Direction Financière du Groupe Indosuez, qui couvre le reporting financier, le contrôle de gestion, la gestion des risques financiers, les activités de pilotage en alignement avec les standards Groupe et les exigences réglementaires.

Il s’agit d’un rôle d’exécution et d’analyse contribuant à l’exécution directe, à la documentation, à l’analyse et à l’automatisation des processus, tout en participant activement à une approche collaborative et transversale impliquant Risk, Finance & Opérations.

Le titulaire travaille sous la responsabilité de la Regulatory Reporting Domain Lead et contribue à la fois à la phase de transformation et à la gestion du Business As Usual (BAU) de la gouvernance des données financières.

Your position


Déploiement opérationnel & ownership
Participer à la mise en œuvre et la supervision des standards BCBS239 pour les données financières et de reporting.
Contribuer à la définition, la mise à jour et la documentation des domaines de données critiques pour Finance.
Participer à la mise en œuvre des plans de remédiation et à l’adaptation des standards Groupe à la réalité financière.
Gouvernance des données & gestion de la qualité
Participer à la structuration et au maintien de la gouvernance des données financières, à la documentation et aux contrôles de qualité selon les frameworks Groupe.
Soutenir la nomination et le fonctionnement des Data Owners et Data Domain Réeféerents pour Finance.
Garantir l’exhaustivité, l’exactitude et la mise à jour des référentiels (glossaire, catalogues, lineage).
Contribuer aux revues mensuelles de qualité des données et aux comités de remédiation, en exploitant les retours d’audit et de contrôle pour des améliorations tangibles.
Harmonisation des pratiques
Participer à l’harmonisation des pratiques entre les entités Finance et géographies.
Identifier, cartographier et prioriser les processus manuels et EUC dans Finance. Développer des scripts et solutions automatisées en coordination avec les équipes métier, IT et Data.
Amélioriation continue & transition BAU
Être un acteur de la gestion, la réduction des risques et l’optimisation de la performance des domaines de données critiques.
Contribuer à l’efficacité opérationnelle, à la réduction des risques et à la fiabilité du reporting financier.
Soutenir et accélérer la transformation digitale de Finance par des initiatives pragmatiques et opérationnelles.
Engagement des parties prenantes & leadership
Participer à l’animation d’une communauté Finance transversale, en travaillant avec des parties prenantes de différents pays et niveaux de séniorité.
Être un point de contact pour BCBS239 Finance.
Contribuer à l’influence et à la fédération des parties prenantes sans autorité hiérarchique directe.
Reporting & animation de la gouvernance
Contribuer à la préparation des dashboards, synthèses de management et supports de reporting pour la direction financière et les instances de gouvernance.
Participer à l’organisation, l’animation et le suivi des forums et comités de gouvernance Finance, garantissant la qualité d’exécution et le suivi des décisions.


Your profile


Master ou équivalent (finance, gestion, data, informatique).
Première expérience (stage ou 1-2 ans) en analyse de données, contrôle qualité ou support projet dans un environnement bancaire ou financier.
Connaissance Business Objects, Power BI, (VBA, Python, SQL ou autre langage pertinent pour l’automatisation des processus).
Bonne compréhension des métiers Finance et des enjeux de gouvernance des données.
Langues : français et anglais courants.

Title: SAP BW Business Analyst
Description:
Senior Business & Data Analyst – SAP BW




Industry: Retail

Location: Belgium




We are looking for a Senior Business & Data Analyst with strong SAP BW expertise to support a major data transformation programme within the retail industry.

You will bridge business stakeholders and data engineering teams, maintaining existing SAP BW reporting solutions while supporting the design and migration of data solutions to Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery.




Your responsibilities

Translate business needs into detailed data requirements, functional specifications, data mappings, transformation rules and KPI definitions.
Design and document conceptual and logical data models alongside data engineers.
Use SQL to profile data, validate business rules and assess data quality.
Document data flows, extractors, data lineage and integration with the BigQuery data warehouse.
Design and execute test scenarios, including regression testing, to ensure reliable reporting and data solutions.
Deliver actionable insights through dashboards, datasets and self-service BI.
Maintain and support SAP BW reporting solutions, investigate data discrepancies and resolve pipeline issues.
Collaborate with data engineering, BI, data science and governance teams on end-to-end delivery.
Support reporting governance, business glossary maintenance and user adoption.




Your profile

Extensive hands-on experience with SAP BW 7.5 on HANA, including DataSources, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, InfoObjects, process chains, OpenHub extraction and BEx Queries.
Strong experience in business and functional analysis, translating stakeholder needs into clear specifications.
Excellent understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, ETL and enterprise data models.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins.
Proven experience with BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Looker or Tableau, and a strong understanding of data visualisation best practices.
Understanding of cloud and big data platforms such as GCP or Azure.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a collaborative approach.
Ability to communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders.
Excellent written and spoken English, plus French or Dutch.




Nice to have

Previous experience in the retail industry.
Experience with SAP Retail MM and SD modules.
Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals and the ability to collaborate with data scientists.




Interested? Apply with your CV to discuss the opportunity.

Title: Analyst | Competition Practice | Brussels
Description:
Who We Are

We are one of the world’s leading economic consulting firms. We strive to recruit and develop talented people to work together to produce meaningful economic analysis of exceptional quality, and to create a positive impact on our clients and society.

Our Competition Practice provides expert economic advice on competition policy, economic and financial regulation, public policy and the assessment of damages in complex disputes.

We are looking to hire junior economists to help us to provide advice to our clients on some of the most high-profile cases before the European Commission, the General Court and national competition authorities, regulators and courts.

We believe that working in diverse teams, where everybody’s views are considered and respected, helps us to deliver work of the highest standards of quality and integrity.

About The Role

We pride ourselves on providing Analysts with an opportunity to make a significant impact from day one. As an Analyst you will become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of helping clients understand how competition works in their industry. You will contribute to cases in a variety of ways, working closely with senior staff to understand the issues that face the client, relating those issues to relevant economic theory, and supporting the analysis with solid and persuasive empirical evidence. You are also guaranteed to be closely supervised by senior staff, both within the scope of projects and via our internal mentoring programme.

Analysts typically join us after completing their Master’s degree in economics.

Applications for this position close on 29th January 2027.

Key Responsibilities


Analysing qualitative and quantitative client data to better understand how competition works in their industry
Reviewing literature and contributing to discussions about the theoretical and empirical approach
Conducting empirical analysis using Excel and Stata
Drafting reports summarising analysis
Participating in client meetings and conference calls


Skills/profile Sought


Master’s degree in economics, ideally with focus on microeconomics, industrial organisation and/or econometrics
Highly analytical
Excellent organisational skills with an ability to multi-task
Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues and clients
Accuracy and attention to detail
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Basic Stata and Excel skills
Fluency in written and spoken English


Benefits Of Working At Compass Lexecon


Competitive salary and benefits
A wide variety of interesting and challenging projects
An international team with a broad range of backgrounds and experience
A blend of professional and academic environments
The opportunity to work with top law firms, corporations, government bodies and academics
A steep learning curve, coupled with a supportive and collaborative team
Opportunities for training such as secondments, office rotations, internal seminars, and conferences
The opportunity to take on a lot of responsibility and contribute from day one


When Drafting Your Application

We ask all applicants to provide their most up to date CV, cover letter and transcripts.

We acknowledge that AI is now commonly used for drafting, however we emphasize the importance of personalization to truly reflect your unique experiences. We are able to recognise applications that are solely created using AI and those that demonstrate individuality.

What happens next?

Once your application has been submitted, you will receive an email confirmation outlining next steps.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does our interview process look like?

Our interview process for Analysts involves two stages. The first stage is one 60-minute interview with both motivational and technical questions. The second stage includes a written case study and a technical interview. All interviews are currently being conducted virtually.

Compass Lexecon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We appreciate that recruitment agencies may have speculative CVs that they wish to submit to Compass Lexecon. To avoid any ambiguity around fees, please note that speculative CVs received by Compass Lexecon, that have not been authorised in advance by the Recruitment team, will be ineligible for an agency fee.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analysing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Title: Business Support Analyst (Workforce Planning and Reporting) for NATO with security clearance
Description:
Somebody has to know where the money and the people actually are.

A programme office inside a multinational defence organisation needs a business assistant across workforce planning, budget tracking and business execution. It is the seat where the plan meets the spreadsheet - and where the reporting that leadership relies on gets built.

What You Would Be Doing


Providing administrative support to project boards, project teams and review meetings
Supporting managers and teams with resourcing and recruitment activity, using the recommended tools to plan, schedule and track it
Running the organisation's budget cycle and process in practice, and helping develop and monitor a budget for a specific group
Analysing variances and patterns in budget and project execution, and explaining them
Preparing the monthly reporting and the data analysis behind the quarterly cycle
Acting as learning officer for the team - the whole lifecycle of training requests, and the funding for them
Building and maintaining the Power BI dashboards, and the data sources underneath them


What you would bring


Several years by title in administrative and coordination work - financial management, resources or project management
Expert-user command of the Microsoft Office tool set, with certification behind it
Power BI at expert level: you can build a dashboard and maintain what feeds it, and show that you have
Expert SharePoint - managing, designing and securing site content with metadata, web parts and version control
Expert-user knowledge of ServiceNow, and ideally an enterprise project model such as Oracle's


Why this one is worth a look

It is a broad seat for someone who likes being the person who actually knows, with visible reporting and a short line to decision-makers, and it runs from a standing framework rather than a one-off project.

Title: Data Management Consultant - Risk and Regulatory Reporting
Description:
At Finalyse, for over 35 years, we have supported (re)insurance and banking clients in navigating changes and embracing innovations in valuation, risk management, and regulatory compliance. Our commitment to contributing to a sustainable and resilient financial system drives us every day. We empower our talented consultants to design and implement efficient, pragmatic solutions, fostering a collaborative spirit with partners and clients. Our unique blend of financial and technological expertise has been the cornerstone of numerous successful projects and enduring relationships.




We embrace diversity at Finalyse, recognising the unique strengths everyone brings, and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment that respects diverse beliefs and backgrounds.




THE ROLE




In an increasingly complex regulatory environment and financial world, shaping state-of-the-art reporting capability and data intelligence is essential to bank’s core business and financial stability. Finalyse embraces this evolution and is committed to maintain a cutting-edge approach in its Data Management Advisory services.

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated risk data analyst to join our team.

You will be working on vital and massive finance and risk datasets, implementing reliable data aggregation solutions to fulfill management and regulatory reporting needs in the banking industry. In this role, you will have a direct impact on bank’s internal and external stakeholders.




The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of risk calculation and reporting and will be able to implement solutions that not only meets data quality standards but, most of all, business requirements that are meaningful for risk managers.




RESPONSIBILITIES




Participating in and leading engagements within the Risk Advisory practice for banking and insurance clients to support the build-up and maintenance of data infrastructures for risk and regulatory reporting.
Assisting our clients in the processing and reporting of their risks: credit risk, market risk, interest rate risk, liquidity risk etc., from data collection, treatment, risk calculations and reporting.
Conducting workshops with business users, gathering business requirements, and defining functional and technical requirements.
Guiding and supporting required IT testing activities.
Performing deep dives into data details and investigating reconciliation issues with other reporting systems, such as accounting systems or other source systems.
Advising our clients on how to implement data governance policies and procedures.
Developing and maintaining documentation for all data-related processes, including data lineage, data dictionary, data quality, in order to comply with BCBS 239 standards.




REQUIREMENTS




Master's degree in management, applied economics or computer sciences.
At least 2-4 years of experience in financial institutions with a strong understanding of banking business, financial products and how data and regulatory reporting processes interact.
Outstanding analytical skills.
Proficiency in SQL, SAS or Python or other programming languages.
Familiarity with BCBS 239 and its requirements for data governance, data quality, and risk management.
Ability to work autonomously in a result-oriented environment.
Good communication, writing and presentation skills with the ability to explain sophisticated issues in a simple but professional way.
Fluency in English (both verbal and written).
Understanding of one or more risk calculation (credit risk, market risk, ALM, climate risk, liquidity risk etc.) and reporting processes.
Knowledge of European risk regulation (CRR2, CRR3, Basel IV).
First-hand experience with Agile ways of working is a plus.




WHY FINALYSE




A meaningful role and mission contributing to the stability and responsible innovation of the financial sector.
A diverse, multinational team of talented specialists and senior experts, committed to sharing knowledge, supporting each other, and driving collective success.
A clear and flexible career path, with the freedom to shape your own specialization and grow quickly in a flat, agile organization.
Personalised development through tailored technical training, recognised certifications, and continuous learning.
A healthy work culture and environment that values wellbeing, work–life balance, and sustainable consulting practices.
Flexible ways of working with hybrid/remote options, trust-based autonomy, and openness to part-time arrangements.
A competitive compensation and benefits package, including healthcare, pension, and sustainable mobility options, etc.
International exposure and opportunities to travel and work with clients and colleagues across Europe and beyond.
Innovation and thought leadership opportunities, including internal initiatives, research groups, and access to modern tools and structured methodologies.

Title: Market Analyst
Description:
Market Analyst – Long-Term Power & Grid Modelling (F/M/X)

Do you enjoy turning complex market dynamics into actionable insights that support strategic business decisions?

Would you like to work at the intersection of data, economics, regulation and power systems while collaborating with experts across ENGIE?

Then this job is for YOU.

For the Long-Term Power & Grid Modelling Team, within the Market Analysis Expertise Center (ECMA) of ENGIE Supply & Energy Management, we are currently looking for a Market Analyst (F/M/X) based in Brussels.

Research shows that men apply when they meet 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. Don't let that hold you back, we'd love to hear from you!

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES as Market Analyst:

As a Market Analyst, you will support ENGIE’s business entities in understanding and anticipating the transformation of electricity markets across multiple geographies and time horizons.

Working within a transversal team of quantitative experts, you will contribute to strategic and operational projects for a wide range of internal clients, including Strategy, Trading, Renewable & Flexible Generation, Regulatory Affairs and Finance teams.

Your main responsibilities will include:


Develop and improve quantitative power market models to analyze long-term market evolution, technology deployment, investment economics and energy transition scenarios across Europe and Brazil.
Deliver market intelligence and analytical insights supporting ENGIE's strategic decisions, investment opportunities and regulatory assessments.
Produce long-term power market forecasts and scenarios used by multiple ENGIE business entities, including Strategy, Trading and Renewable Development teams.
Translate complex modelling results into clear recommendations, presentations and decision-support materials for stakeholders and senior management.
Ensure consistency and quality of market analyses across geographies, business lines and forecasting horizons.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of modelling methodologies and challenge existing market assumptions and practices.


YOUR PROFILE as Market Analyst :


Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Data Science or another quantitative field.
Strong analytical mindset with a genuine interest in power markets, energy systems and the energy transition.
Good understanding of wholesale electricity markets and energy market fundamentals.
Experience with quantitative modelling, optimization, data analysis or programming; Python is a strong asset. Knowledge of Plexos and/or SDDP is a plus.
Ability to transform complex analytical outputs into clear business recommendations and impactful presentations.
Autonomous, curious and collaborative team player with excellent communication skills and fluency in English (French and/or Dutch are assets).


WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

The Long-Term Power & Grid Modelling team provides market insights across multiple horizons:


0-5 years: supporting ENGIE's trading activities and market positions.
5-10 years: assessing grid congestion risks and supporting risk mitigation strategies.
Up to 25 years: developing ENGIE's Corporate Scenarios and long-term outlooks on power prices, technology evolution and investment profitability.


This role offers broad exposure across ENGIE’s activities and provides the opportunity to work on strategic questions shaping the future of energy markets in Europe, the Americas and beyond.

It is an ideal opportunity for someone looking to build expertise in quantitative energy market analysis while contributing to ENGIE’s net-zero ambitions.

MORE ABOUT US :

ENGIE Supply & Energy Management (S&EM) is the energy management business unit of ENGIE and plays a key role in delivering reliable, affordable and low-carbon energy solutions worldwide.

The Market Analysis Expertise Center (ECMA) supports ENGIE's businesses through advanced market intelligence, forecasting, strategic studies, investment analysis, regulatory expertise and ESG-related insights.

By joining S&EM, you become part of a global community of more than 10,000 energy professionals across 20 countries, working together to accelerate the energy transition and provide decarbonized energy 24/7.

At S&EM, we encourage innovation, curiosity, collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit while fostering a healthy work-life balance.

Title: Pricing Analist
HTML:
About The Job...

In het kader van de gedefinieerde strategieën en de gestelde prioriteiten, ben je als Pricing Analist verantwoordelijk voor de analyses met als hoofddoelstelling de ontwikkeling van de tarieven (pricing), de follow-up van de winstgevendheid van de producten en de uitwerking van de aanbiedingen van service en diensten (B2B).

Je zal betrokken worden in de volgende activiteiten:

  • In samenwerking met de Product Manager, neem je deel aan de ontwikkeling van nieuwe producten en je zorgt voor de bijhorende pricing;
  • Je neemt eveneens deel aan de berekeningen voor nationale en internationale aanbestedingen en alsook de component "Statistiek en Pricing";
  • Waken over een vlotte inproductiename om een betrouwbare follow-up te garanderen;
  • Dashboards ontwikkelen en interpreteren als onderdeel van de bewaking en periodieke controle van de winstgevendheid van klanten;
  • Je evalueert de "Profit & Loss" of winstdeelname van de contracten;
  • Het bepalen van saneringscriteria van de portefeuille en je ontwikkelt de Life Time Value scoremodellering van de klant;
  • Participeren in de ontwikkeling en bewaking van budgetten door forecasts van verwachte premies en bijhorende sinistraliteit;
  • De leiding nemen over risicoanalyses van de verschillende bijstandsportefeuilles en indien nodig diepgaande analyses en aanpassingen voorstellen;
  • In samenwerking met de afdeling Finance zorgen voor een optimale kosten- en overheadstructuur.
  • Bij het voorbereiden van de te analyseren gegevens voor feedback en ideeën zorgen in het kader van continue verbetering in zowel de procedures als de kwaliteit van de gegevens.

Onze ideale collega...

We zijn op zoek naar een nieuwe collega die:

  • In het bezit is van een (bij voorkeur) Master-diploma in één van de volgende vakgebieden: Actuariaat, Wiskunde, Statistiek, Economie,…;
  • Zich vlot kan uitdrukken in de Nederlandse & Franse taal, dit zowel schriftelijk als mondeling. 
  • Sterke analytische en conceptuele capaciteiten bezit en niet bang is van complexe problemen aan te pakken;
  • Klantvriendelijk is, kan luisteren naar de behoeften van de klant en een stap terug kan nemen om alle elementen goed te analyseren om een 360° beeld te verkrijgen;
  • In staat is om de discussie aan te gaan met zijn/haar gesprekspartners en de verkregen informatie durft te challengen;
  • Actief bijdraagt aan de samenwerking en streeft naar een gemeenschappelijk resultaat;
  • Zeer nauwkeurig te werk gaat en open staat voor verandering;
  • Technische taal gemakkelijk kan vertalen naar duidelijke en begrijpbare taal.
  • Een eerste ervaring in een functie van pricing, tarificatie, rentabiliteit (of in de auditsector) is een pluspunt maar zeker geen must! 

Waarom is Touring "a cool place to be"?

Touring is meer dan alleen een Leading Employer, naast een uitdagende functie bieden we jou ook:

  • Touring biedt jou een boeiende functie aan met ruimte voor initiatief in een informele werksfeer.
  • Een bruisende werkomgeving in een modern gebouw met de nieuwste technologieën.
  • Een team van gemotiveerde professionals die samenwerken in een open cultuur.
  • Flexibele werkuren en mogelijkheid tot hybride werken.
  • Opleidingsmogelijkheden en ondersteuning in je professionele groei.
  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals 13e & 14e maand*, hospitalisatie-& groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques, gratis toegang tot onze fitnesszaal*, etc.
  • Een goede balans tussen werk & privéleven.

Build semantic data models that support dynamic, reliable, and scalable reporting
Develop dashboards and reports aligned with business needs and decision processes

Contribute to end-to-end data platform design, including data warehousing and integration

Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance within reporting solutions
Work with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable BI solutions
Contribute to architectural decisions and promote best practices in BI and analytics
Participate in cross-industry projects, connecting data, reporting, and performance management

You understand that reporting is not the end goal, enabling better decisions is

You contribute to raising standards in data visualisation and information design

Professional working proficiency in Dutch and English


Technical Skills


Strong experience with Power BI (data modelling, DAX, dashboards)

Understanding of data governance, quality, and consistency principles


Nice-to-haves


Basic understanding of AI/advanced analytics is a plus

Growth

Description:
Skills And Competencies


Strong ability to interpret, analyze, and validate complex ownership and entity relationship data

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Per un gruppo industriale internazionale con sedi in Italia e Svizzera, in fase di forte evoluzione e digitalizzazione dei processi, selezioniamo un/una Data Analyst da inserire all'interno della funzione IT di Gruppo.




Scopo del ruolo La figura sarà il punto di riferimento trasversale per la raccolta, la pulizia, la strutturazione e l'analisi dei dati provenienti dai diversi sistemi aziendali (ERP, gestionali di stabilimento, CRM, file operativi). L'obiettivo principale è trasformare dati eterogenei e distribuiti su più società in reportistica affidabile, dashboard di KPI e analisi a supporto delle direzioni Finance, Controllo di Gestione, Operations e Commerciale.




Responsabilità principali

Raccogliere, consolidare e validare dati provenienti da più fonti e società del Gruppo (ERP/SAP, gestionali locali, CRM, Excel), garantendone qualità e coerenza.
Sviluppare e mantenere dashboard e reportistica periodica su KPI commerciali, andamento crediti, capitale circolante, marginalità per commessa e provvigioni agenti.
Supportare il Controllo di Gestione nella predisposizione di reporting mensile, budget, forecast e nell'analisi degli scostamenti tra consuntivi e previsionali.
Predisporre reportistica a supporto dei progetti di integrazione e automazione dei flussi dati tra i gestionali del Gruppo, riducendo il lavoro manuale di riconciliazione.
Fornire analisi all'area Commerciale su performance della rete vendita, punti vendita e tracking della lead generation.
Automatizzare i processi di reportistica ricorrenti tramite Excel avanzato, query SQL e strumenti di Business Intelligence per garantire tempestività e affidabilità dei dati.
Predisporre dataset e report per l'integrazione all'interno di futuri progetti basati su AI e automazione.
Documentare fonti dati, logiche di calcolo e procedure per rendere i processi di analisi ripetibili.
Presentare periodicamente risultati e insight alla direzione a supporto del processo decisionale.




Requisiti richiesti




Laurea in ambito economico, statistico, ingegneristico, informatico o esperienza equivalente.
2–5 anni di esperienza in ruoli di data analysis, business intelligence o reporting, preferibilmente in contesti industriali o multi-societari.
Conoscenza avanzata di SQL per l'estrazione e l'interrogazione in autonomia dei database.
Padronanza avanzata di Excel (formule complesse, tabelle pivot, macro) e familiarità con strumenti di BI (es. Power BI, Tableau o analoghi).
Capacità di lavorare con dati provenienti da sistemi eterogenei per ricondurli a un modello unico e coerente.
Rigore analitico, precisione e attitudine al problem solving.
Buone capacità comunicative per tradurre analisi complesse in informazioni chiare per interlocutori non tecnici.
Italiano fluente e buona conoscenza della lingua inglese per l'interazione con le società svizzere del Gruppo.




Titoli preferenziali

Esperienza pregressa in ambienti SAP o in progetti di estrazione e analisi dati da ERP.
Conoscenza di strumenti di automazione e scripting (es. Power Query, Python) per il trattamento dei dati.
Esperienza in contesti di gruppo multi-società e multi-valuta (realtà italo-svizzere o multinazionali).
Pregressa esposizione a tematiche di credit management, working capital o controllo di gestione industriale.
Partecipazione a progetti in ambito AI.




Offerta dell'azienda

Ruolo trasversale con visibilità diretta sul management e impatto concreto sulle decisioni strategiche.
Inserimento in un contesto industriale solido, in crescita e con progetti attivi di trasformazione digitale e Advanced Analytics.
Percorso di sviluppo professionale in un ambiente che valorizza l'autonomia e l'iniziativa.




Sede di lavoro: Lugano con disponibilità a trasferte saltuarie nel Nord Italia.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
OBJECTIVES OF THE PROGRAMME

The strategic objective of the Department of Polio Eradication Initiative is to achieve certification of the eradication of polioviruses worldwide by providing support to national governments via the Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) Partnership. The two goals of the current GPEI Strategy are to permanently interrupt transmission of all polioviruses in endemic countries and to stop vaccine-derived poliovirus transmission and prevent outbreaks in non-endemic countries. The five objectives within the GPEI Strategy are to create urgency and accountability to generate greater political will, generate vaccine acceptance through context-adapted community engagement, expedite progress through expanded integration efforts with broader partners, improve frontline success through evaluating and adapting campaign operations and outbreak response, and enhance detection and response through sensitive surveillance activities. Additionally, the strategy includes implementing the four objectives in the GPEI Gender Equality Strategy for Polio Eradication. The immediate strategic objective is to achieve and sustain polio-free status in all regions, thereby eliminating the disease and preventing its resurgence. The Polio Data and Information Systems (DIS) team is responsible for the management, organization, analysis and dissemination of polio related data including immunization data, program monitoring and poliovirus surveillance information while promoting and maintaining global polio information systems such as Polio Information System (POLIS), WebIFA and geodatabases.

Description Of Duties


Support Global Polio Eradication program by cleaning, verifying, entering and uploading AFP, Env, Lab, SIA and other datasets received from regional and country offices.
Contribute to carrying out PSL's periodical data analysis and produce regular/standardize reports for outbreak and high-risk countries.
Contribute to improving data quality by regularly running data quality and consistency checks.
Contribute to POLIS development by regularly auditing the POLIS reports and output.
Work with Regional office and lab team to accurately track and analysis status polio virus type 2 lab results.
Contribute to risk analysis for Event Briefing Meeting by producing relevant analysis on short notice.
Coordinate with global and regional partners, sharing insights and recommendations from data analysis to inform broader polio eradication strategies and policies.
Provide training and guidance to regional and country office staff on data entry, and analytical techniques to strengthen local data management capacities and data quality.
Provide other technical support as needed.


Required Qualifications

Education

Essential: First university degree in information management, geographic sciences or other related degree that involves data analytics, computing, science, statistics, mathematics, epidemiology or other science.

Desirable: Formal training (certificate or course) in data management.

Experience

Essential:


At least 5 years' experience in health information systems, statistical analysis, and data management services.
Experience in managing and analyzing public health databases using computer-based applications including databases required by geographic information systems and mapping applications/systems.
Experience in data analysis of communicable diseases and/or vaccinepreventable diseases.
International exposure is required.


Desirable


Experience in all aspects of the development of health information management and/or data analytics.
Ability to manage and analyze data.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with Microsoft Access and Excel, the ESRI GIS/QGIS software, and EpiInfo.


Skills


Proven knowledge of the optimum use of databases as an information/management tool.
Proven expertise in database programming, data management, user interface design, browser-based and web application development with role-based access control as well as report layout and design technologies and techniques, including experience in query design, stored procedures, and views and functions using T-SQL within MS SQL-Server.
Good knowledge of Relational Databases Management principles, database design and normalization, development methodologies and use of SVN version control.
Proven experience in using VBScript, VBA, R, HTML and/or T-SQL todevelop applications.
Knowledge of standard polio data analysis and reporting procedures.
Excellent interpersonal skills combined with the ability to synthesize and present facts in a clear and logical manner.
Ability to produce results under pressure.
Ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment.


WHO Competencies

Teamwork

Respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences

Communication

Producing results

Ensuring the effective use of resources

Use of Language Skills

Essential: Expert knowledge of English.

Desirable: Intermediate knowledge of French.

WHO salaries for staff in the Professional category are calculated in US dollars. The remuneration for the above position comprises an annual base salary starting at USD 71,335 (subject to mandatory deductions for pension contributions and health insurance, as applicable), a variable post adjustment, which reflects the cost of living in a particular duty station, and currently amounts to USD 4976 per month for the duty station indicated above. Other benefits include 30 days of annual leave, allowances for dependent family members, home leave, and an education grant for dependent children.

Staff members separated due to the 2025 Prioritization and Realignment Process will receive special consideration according to the applicable regulatory framework.

Only candidates under serious consideration will be contacted.
A written test and/or an asynchronous video assessment may be used as a form of screening.

Description:
Your team

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Join Pictet’s Operations Data Office to build and run data solutions that power our banking operations. You will work at the intersection of IT, data platforms and business teams.

Your role


Collect, organise and analyse user requirements, and design data flows / pipelines between client data reference systems and data platforms to bridge business needs with data processes.
Perform and automate data extractions and mass updates in data warehouses (Snowflake) to support reporting, operational campaigns and data quality improvements.
Propose, prototype and implement optimised solutions using AI tools (incl. LLMs) to replace legacy work processes and continuously improve operational quality and efficiency.
Actively participate in strategic and cross departmental projects related to client static data (tax & regulatory, compliance, IT modernisation), working with IT and business teams to design and deliver data driven solutions.

Your profile


Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics or equivalent.
First experience working with complex datasets (finance or other industries).
Strong data literacy (data governance, quality frameworks, regulatory awareness).
Fluent in spoken and written French and English.
Strong SQL skills; experience with AI tools (incl. code generation assistants) is an asset.
Experience working with industry standard BI tools and data platforms such as Tableau and Snowflake; Python or R for data is a plus.
Residence in Switzerland required


As the successful applicant, you will be a strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills, combining a quality driven and analytical mindset with a rigorous approach to your work. You will be autonomous and proactive, able to make clear and well structured proposals, while effectively prioritising tasks and performing under pressure. Client oriented, with a strong sense of service, you will contribute positively to the team and act as a trusted partner for our internal and external stakeholders

Descrizione Del Lavoro

ABOUT FORFIRM

FORFIRM is providing solutions to real business challenges for our clients through innovation and deep industry understanding.

We pride ourselves on being a knowledge-based company, with no barriers or pre-built solutions. We listen to our clients and solve their unique problems.

At FORFIRM, we are creating a culture where each person can define their own role parameters and speak their mind without hesitation. We are a true meritocracy, where individual results define each person's career path.

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Data Analytics Consultant to join our international team and contribute to strategic data and reporting initiatives for leading Swiss and European organizations.

About The Role

The Senior Data Analytics Consultant will act as a trusted advisor for clients and internal stakeholders, supporting the design and implementation of data-driven solutions that enable effective decision-making and business transformation.

The role combines consulting expertise, data modelling capabilities, advanced SQL development, and Business Intelligence competencies. The selected candidate will lead analytical initiatives, interact directly with business stakeholders and management teams, and contribute to the definition of modern data architectures and reporting frameworks.

Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Consulting


Engage with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and analytical requirements.
Translate business needs into scalable data and reporting solutions.
Lead workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and analytical assessments.
Support clients in defining KPI frameworks and performance measurement models.
Act as a trusted advisor for data-driven decision-making initiatives.


Data Modeling & Data Architecture


Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
Define dimensional data models (Star Schema and Snowflake Schema) supporting enterprise reporting needs.
Collaborate with Data Engineers and Architects to define scalable analytics architectures.
Support data governance, master data management, and data quality initiatives.
Ensure consistency, integrity, and sustainability of analytical data platforms.


SQL Development & Data Analysis


Develop and optimize complex SQL queries and database objects.
Perform advanced data analysis and profiling activities.
Conduct data reconciliation and root cause investigations.
Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities.
Support data migration and transformation initiatives.


Power BI & Business Intelligence


Design and develop enterprise-grade dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI.
Develop advanced DAX calculations, KPIs, measures, and semantic models.
Implement reporting best practices and governance standards.
Support executive reporting and management dashboards.
Ensure performance optimization and scalability of reporting solutions.


Leadership & Project Delivery


Act as senior reference point within client engagements.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and analysts.
Collaborate with project managers in defining scope, timelines, and deliverables.
Contribute to proposal preparation and business development activities.
Support pre-sales initiatives related to Data & Analytics services.


WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related discipline.
At least 5 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or related fields.
Strong expertise in SQL development and relational databases.
Solid experience in conceptual, logical, dimensional, and physical data modeling.
Proven experience designing and developing solutions with Microsoft Power BI.
Strong knowledge of DAX, Power Query, and semantic model design.
Experience interacting directly with business stakeholders and senior management.
Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent English and Italian.


NICE TO HAVE


Python for data analysis, automation, and data processing.
Microsoft Fabric.
Azure Data Platform.
Data Warehouse architectures.
ETL / ELT frameworks and tools.
Cloud analytics environments.
Banking or Financial Services experience.
Knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Regulatory Reporting frameworks.


What We Offer


Opportunity to work on strategic and highly visible projects for major Swiss and international clients.
Exposure to complex Data & Analytics transformation programs.
Meritocratic environment with clear career progression opportunities.
Continuous investment in professional development and certifications.
Dynamic, international, and collaborative working environment.
Participation in the growth of FORFIRM's Data & Analytics practice.

This is a hands-on, delivery-oriented role well-suited for someone who is proficient with data visualization tools, comfortable working across multiple client accounts simultaneously, and eager to grow within a fast-paced healthcare analytics environment.

Ensure all reporting outputs are accurate, on-time, and aligned to client needs and brand objectives

Support preparation of performance summaries and benchmark reports used in client reviews and business development

Build and maintain interactive dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, or Looker
Translate business requirements into clean, client-ready visual reports and data stories
Contribute to development and maintenance of standardized reporting templates across reseller relationships (e.g., InStep, Relevate)

Query and pull structured data from Snowflake, SQL databases, or equivalent environments

Flag bottlenecks, data issues, or turnaround risks early and proactively communicate with relevant stakeholders
Collaborate with cross-functional teams — client services, product, and strategy — to support timely delivery

Title: Senior Specialist - HD Analytics & Reporting
Description:
In Short

Our Happiness Delivery (HD) team is growing, and we are looking for an Analytics & Reporting Senior Specialist to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.

You will sit at the intersection of business, analytics and data engineering, helping HD understand its performance, improve how we use data and identify opportunities to work smarter through automation and technology.

This is not just a reporting role. You will be a curious problem solver and trusted analytics partner who can move from a business question to the underlying data, understand what is happening, and translate the answer into a simple and actionable story for the right audience.

Your Mission


Own the Performance Narrative: Design, build and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide a clear view of HD performance across regions, channels and processes. Ensure that metrics are accurate, relevant and presented at the right level of granularity for different stakeholders.
Turn Business Questions into Insights: Partner with HD leadership and operational teams to understand their questions and translate them into meaningful analysis, KPIs and reporting. Go beyond reporting what happened to help explain why it happened and what we should do about it.
Bridge Business and Data Engineering: Act as a strong link between HD and Data Engineering / Business Intelligence teams. Translate business needs into clear data requirements, help clarify priorities and investigate issues when reporting or data does not behave as expected.
Look Beyond the Dashboard: You are comfortable going deeper into the data pipeline when necessary. You will investigate data quality issues, understand how data is transformed, identify gaps or inconsistencies and provide recommendations on where the underlying data or processes can be improved.
Continuously Improve: Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to simplify reporting, automate flows, improve data structures, reduce manual effort and strengthen the overall analytics landscape. Help the team move from reactive reporting towards scalable, proactive analytics.


Your Story


Analytical Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, performance management, customer service, CRM, operations or a related field. Experience in customer service is a strong plus, and you understand the importance of translating operational performance into actionable insights.
Strong Technical Foundation: You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with data logic and transformations. You can investigate data beyond the reporting layer and understand how data flows through a pipeline. Experience with LookML is desirable, and Python is a plus.
BI & Data Visualization: You have strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools. You understand not only how to build dashboards, but how to structure information and visualizations so that complex performance can be communicated clearly to different audiences. Experience with Looker and HEX is a strong plus.
AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI and modern automation technologies and naturally look for opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve processes and scale analytics. Experience measuring or working with AI/automation initiatives, such as automation rates, model accuracy or human intervention, is a plus.
Curious Problem Solver: You enjoy investigating problems rather than accepting the first answer. When a number looks wrong, a process is inefficient or a stakeholder has a difficult question, you are comfortable digging into the data and underlying logic to understand what is really happening.
Business & Technical Translator: You are able to translate business needs into data requirements for engineering teams, while also explaining technical concepts and data limitations in a simple way to business stakeholders.You can challenge assumptions constructively, align different perspectives and turn ambiguous business questions into clear analytical requirements.
Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, data analytics, business analytics or a related quantitative field.
Language Skills: Business fluency in English is required.


Your Team

At On, delivering happiness is not just a phrase, it’s a mission. That’s why we call our customer service organization Happiness Delivery.

You will join an entrepreneurial and ambitious team where analytics plays a key role in improving how we serve our customers and operate at scale. You will work closely with HD leadership, operational teams, Analytics & Reporting, Data Engineering and other technology partners across Berlin, Zurich and Portland.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how HD uses data: from strengthening the foundations of our reporting to identifying new opportunities to automate, simplify and improve the customer experience.

  • Strong Technical Foundation: You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with data logic and transformations. You can investigate data beyond the reporting layer and understand how data flows through a pipeline. Experience with LookML is desirable, and Python is a plus.
  • BI & Data Visualization: You have strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools. You understand not only how to build dashboards, but how to structure information and visualizations so that complex performance can be communicated clearly to different audiences. Experience with Looker and HEX is a strong plus.
  • AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI and modern automation technologies and naturally look for opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve processes and scale analytics. Experience measuring or working with AI/automation initiatives, such as automation rates, model accuracy or human intervention, is a plus.
  • Curious Problem Solver: You enjoy investigating problems rather than accepting the first answer. When a number looks wrong, a process is inefficient or a stakeholder has a difficult question, you are comfortable digging into the data and underlying logic to understand what is really happening.
  • Business & Technical Translator: You are able to translate business needs into data requirements for engineering teams, while also explaining technical concepts and data limitations in a simple way to business stakeholders.You can challenge assumptions constructively, align different perspectives and turn ambiguous business questions into clear analytical requirements.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, data analytics, business analytics or a related quantitative field.
  • Language Skills: Business fluency in English is required.

Your Team

At On, delivering happiness is not just a phrase, it’s a mission. That’s why we call our customer service organization Happiness Delivery.

You will join an entrepreneurial and ambitious team where analytics plays a key role in improving how we serve our customers and operate at scale. You will work closely with HD leadership, operational teams, Analytics & Reporting, Data Engineering and other technology partners across Berlin, Zurich and Portland.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how HD uses data: from strengthening the foundations of our reporting to identifying new opportunities to automate, simplify and improve the customer experience.

Title: RFP Data Analyst
HTML:
Job Description

The RFP Data Analyst is part of LGT Capital Partners’ Product and Client Solutions (PACS) team in Pfäffikon SZ and plays an active role in both the firm's client engagement activities and its data infrastructure. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible.

The role has a strong focus on data analysis within a client servicing and investor relations context. The successful candidate will work with fund, performance, portfolio and firm-level data that supports RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and other investor-facing materials. This is a role for someone who enjoys working analytically with data, understands the importance of accuracy in client-facing communication, and is able to translate quantitative inputs into clear, reliable and well-structured content.

The person will also help improve the team’s workflows by using AI and other tools to maintain the knowledge base and strengthen content and data processes. A key expectation is that the person acts as a bridge between the data and the wider PACS team, ensuring that analytical inputs are accurate, consistent and suitable for use in external client and investor communication.

As part of the PACS team, the successful candidate will contribute to data-driven client servicing across the following areas:

  • Take ownership of the analytical inputs used in RFPs, RFIs, DDQs and investor materials, including pulling, cross-checking, analyzing and formatting performance, fund, portfolio and firm-level data from multiple sources;
  • Complete RFP, RFI and DDQ processes from prospective and existing clients across private and public markets, working within stated deadlines;
  • Generate high-quality, tailored responses and continuously improve the firm's standard content library;
  • Collaborate directly with business development, investment management and other internal teams to gather inputs and ensure responses reflect LGT CP's current positioning accurately;
  • Act as the link between client-facing teams and the PACS Data team, translating investor relations and client servicing needs into clear data requirements and helping ensure timely, accurate delivery;
  • Operate as a power user of the firm's RFP platform (Responsive), data workflows and AI-assisted tools, contributing to the continuous improvement of data quality, content maintenance, automation and process efficiency.

Requirements

  • University degree in quantitative finance, finance, business analytics, economics or a related field; CFA, CAIA or an equivalent qualification is a plus;
  • Minimum two years of relevant experience in data analysis, ideally within investor relations, RFP/DDQ, product management, or a related function in asset management;
  • Excellent written English; French, German or other languages an asset;
  • Prior exposure to data workflows or digital tools, with eagerness to develop these skills further;
  • Curiosity and confidence in using AI-assisted tools;
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple concurrent deadlines without losing precision and attention to detail;
  • Clear, proactive communicator with the confidence to flag issues and ask clarifying questions across teams;
  • Team-oriented, with a high sense of ownership and follow-through.

What You Can Expect

  • We provide modern working conditions, including work-from-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;
  • A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;
  • We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills;
  • We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;
  • Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family’s long-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;
  • You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners’ investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.

Contact Information

If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.

For further information please contact us.

Cassandra Fritschi

Human Resources

LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon
