Title: EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst
Description:
Our Company

JOB DESCRIPTION

EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.

EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.

Our Purpose and Mission

Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

Job Description

The EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst will be part of the Group Performance Measurement, Budgeting & Reporting Team in Lugano and will contribute to develop and run an integrated planning, reporting and performance review process to facilitate value-driven business decision-making. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer, the resource will oversee running, maintenance and development of our existing OneStream planning platform. In his role as EPM OneStream Developer/Business Data Analyst, the resource will support the performance measurement activities by running granular analysis of financial performance root causes and by providing insights on value creation levers.

The resource will play an active role supporting business development and providing value-added decision support using data modelling and forecasting intelligence.

Main Responsibilities


EPM OneStream Developer
Business analyst and power user of MI data
Design and maintain data models for analysis and forecasting
Establish and compile dashboards and presentations to senior management
Take active role in the business performance dialogues
Active collaboration with Strategy & Corporate Development unit during budgeting and forecasting process
Design and develop MI reports and simulations with data from the various MIS systems of the bank to provide insight on value creation levers to the business
Develop strong relationship with business management and business controllers to support the Planning & Controlling business partnership


Skills And Experience


Professional experience in EPM Business Intelligence in Financial Industry
OneStream software: EPM applications maintenance and developments expert
Ability to understand large datasets and experience of data modelling, providing accurate data analysis
Power user of OneStream, MS-PowerBI, MS-Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Excel Macros, VBA, Python, SAS Enterprise Guide to automate data extraction and reporting
Quick learner, accurate and efficient
Proactive attitude and willingness to take on new knowledge and skills
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to unforeseen work demands
Good communication skills to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
Fluent in Italian and English


Our Values


Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement
Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results
Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence
Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset
Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

Title: Business Analyst
Description:
Rhone is a leading international group founded in 1982 whose key focus is the protection and succession of family wealth. Rhone has 60 experienced staff across offices in the Bahamas, Canada, Hong Kong, Monaco, Singapore and in Switzerland and offers a stimulating and diverse work environment.




To join the office of the CEO, Rhone is looking for a:




BUSINESS ANALYST







OVERVIEW




The Business Analyst supports data-driven decision-making and operational effectiveness across the Rhone Group. The role is responsible for analysing business and operational data, developing management and regulatory reporting, reviewing cross-functional processes, and delivering practical improvements to reporting, controls, data quality and operational efficiency. The position works closely with stakeholders across the Group to support strategic and operational initiatives.







KEY RESPONSIBILITIES




1. Data Analysis and Operational Process Review

Perform structured analyses of operational, financial and organisational data to identify trends, risks, data quality issues and improvement opportunities.
Contribute to cross-departmental process reviews aimed at improving efficiency, internal controls, data quality and service delivery.
Prepare and deliver dashboards, reports and performance metrics to support informed decision-making.
Work with internal stakeholders to identify, design and implement practical process enhancements aligned with strategic objectives, including reporting efficiency, standardisation and automation.
Support the tracking and implementation of key operational and strategic initiatives.




2. Regulatory Reporting and Corporate Documentation

Prepare and submit assigned regulatory reports and coordinate with internal stakeholders and regulators to ensure accurate and timely reporting.
Support the development and maintenance of company operating manuals and procedures.




3. Office Management

Provide general support with day-to-day office management, including reception cover as required.







QUALIFICATIONS

5–8 years’ relevant experience in business analysis, data analysis, operations and/or process improvement.
Demonstrated experience in data or business analytics; a relevant professional qualification would be an advantage.
Advanced knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint.
Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query and other data analysis tools would be an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with sound judgement and a good understanding of quality and internal controls.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in French other languages would be an advantage.
Swiss resident with eligibility to work







WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive compensation and benefits package.
Motivating work environment.
Complimentary day off on your birthday.
Regular company sponsored events.
Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
Paid time off to support charitable activities of your choice.
Training and development including time-off to pursue professional certifications.
Contribution to public transportation passes







ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Location: Geneva
Start date: As soon as possible
Work rate: 100%
Swiss or valid work permit

Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business performance and delivering integrated, objective, and actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

As a key member of the Revenue Management & Sales Services Analytics team, he/she will have the opportunity to work with large-scale datasets and advanced technologies, developing deep expertise in the core business. To succeed in this role, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst must have a strong passion for data analysis, reporting, and uncovering meaningful insights. The role requires the ability to interpret complex information, assess business implications, and provide impactful recommendations that drive revenue growth and improve overall business performance.

Your Impact

Reporting directly to the Revenue Management Business Analytics Manager, the Revenue Management Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for:


Supporting the full lifecycle of the budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring the delivery of accurate and timely analyses.
Partnering with business stakeholders to identify needs, define requirements, and translate them into actionable analytical solutions.
Gathering, documenting, and maintaining data requirements to support both recurring and ad hoc business analyses.
Developing expertise across multiple data sources and business domains to generate meaningful insights and drive informed decision-making.
Collaborating with vendors, third-party providers, and cross-functional corporate teams in a dynamic and agile environment.
Contributing to the continuous enhancement of analytical frameworks, reporting capabilities, and data-driven business processes.


Data Analysis And Insights. Main Activities Include


QA data to ensure accuracy
Analyze and mine data to find opportunities in time allotted
Undertake proactive and reactive ad-hoc requests as needed
Make business recommendations based on the data findings
Drive more efficient and sophisticated analytical insights


Analysis Distribution. Main Activities Include


Design effective and impactful reports and visualizations for both large and small scale distribution
Create presentations to highlight recommendations and tell the story
Ensure partners understand the analysis presented

Drive efficiencies to current processes through tools and processes
Increase the level of sophistication of analyses through statistical, machine learning, and artificial intelligence techniques


Your Journey so far


Four plus years of relevant experience in a fast paced, rapidly changing operations environment
Experience with “big data” environments and tool

Experience with budgeting and forecasting processes

Title: DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist
Description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Analytics Solutions team, part of Digital Client Experience at Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Zurich or London.

DCX Product Analytics Specialist / Senior Analytics Specialist

We will count on you to:


Partner with brokers, client executives, product teams, and analytics colleagues to identify risk and renewal pain points and translate them into clear analytical problems and success criteria.
Prepare, clean, and enrich data from multiple sources including exposure, policies, claims, pricing, engineering, and third-party hazard or vendor model data.
Build, assess, and validate analytical models and loss modeling approaches to support Property Risk Quantification, including catastrophe and non-catastrophe use cases, with potential application across other lines of business.
Apply pricing, actuarial, and risk-based techniques to generate actionable insights for loss modeling, portfolio assessment, and business decision-making.
Prototype dashboards, reports, and analytical outputs that translate technical model results into clear, decision-ready guidance for business stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to operationalize analytical workflows, improve data foundations, and support scalable analytics solutions.
Document models, assumptions, methodologies, and data lineage in line with governance requirements and support transparent interpretation of model outputs.
Operate effectively in a fast-changing, incubation-style environment where priorities, use cases, and project scope may evolve, helping bring structure and momentum to emerging analytics problems.


What you need to have:


Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in analytics, actuarial work, catastrophe modeling, pricing, or insurance risk analysis.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or equivalent practical experience.
Solid understanding of statistical modeling, loss modeling, and model validation, ideally in insurance, pricing, or actuarial contexts.
Experience with catastrophe modeling, Property risk analytics, or related risk quantification approaches, including interpretation and use of model outputs.
Experience working with insurance-related data and tools, with familiarity with platforms such as RMS, AIR/Verisk, or similar analytics and modeling environments considered a plus.
Proficiency in Python and/or SQL for analytics, modeling, and data preparation, with experience in reproducible analytical workflows.
Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to create prototype dashboards and business-ready analytical outputs.


What makes you stand out:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field or progress toward an actuarial qualification.
Experience working in insurance, reinsurance, broking, or risk advisory, particularly in Property cat and non-cat analytics.
Demonstrated ability to translate technical results into actionable business insights and communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-changing, and not fully structured environments, with the ability to create clarity and move work forward.
Product mindset with the ability to shape approaches, refine problem statements, and adapt as priorities evolve in an incubation-style setting.


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Company Description

At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare’s hardest challenges and advance what is possible.

Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere—we strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.

Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.

Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let’s advance the world of minimally invasive care.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

The Senior Service Analytics Analyst – EU & WWI serves as a strategic analytics and finance partner to the EU & WWI Customer Experience & Services leadership team. The role integrates financial, operational, customer, and workforce data to generate forward-looking insights, evaluate business scenarios, and influence decisions that improve Services performance, scalability, and profitability.

Supporting Field Services, Technical Support, Digital Technical Support, Customer Services, and Customer Success, this role goes beyond reporting to identify key business drivers, quantify opportunities and tradeoffs, and translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.

The Senior Analyst will also leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics to accelerate insight generation, strengthen forecasting and scenario modeling, and enable more effective, scalable decision support.

Roles And Responsibilities


Deliver integrated financial and operational analytics that identify performance drivers, risks, and opportunities across EU & WWI Services.
Develop scenario, sensitivity, and driver-based models to evaluate strategic alternatives, quantify tradeoffs, and support business decisions.
Provide insights and recommendations across revenue, cost-to-serve, margin, profitability, productivity, workforce capacity, and customer performance.
Support financial planning and performance management, including forecasting, budgeting, P&L analysis, variance analysis, and identification of risks and opportunities.
Translate complex business questions into structured analyses and forward-looking recommendations that enable leadership action.
Support regional Objectives, Goals, Strategies & Tactics (OGST) by connecting financial and operational KPIs to business outcomes and strategic priorities.
Apply AI, automation, and advanced analytics to identify patterns and anomalies, accelerate recurring analysis, improve forecasting, and generate deeper insights.
Partner across Services, Operations, IT, Data & Analytics, and global teams to strengthen data quality, metric consistency, and analytical capabilities.
Communicate complex analysis through concise, executive-ready insights, scenarios, and recommendations that clearly articulate business implications and expected impact.
Drive continuous improvement by simplifying, automating, and scaling analytical processes and best practices across EU & WWI.


Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:Fina


Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of relevant experience in financial analytics, business analytics, FP&A, operational finance, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong financial acumen, including P&L, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, cost drivers, margin, profitability, and financial modeling.
Demonstrated ability to integrate financial and operational data and translate analysis into business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure and solve complex, ambiguous business problems.
Experience with analytics and BI tools such as Tableau, SQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms, along with advanced Excel skills.
Practical experience or strong interest in applying AI and automation to finance and analytics workflows.
Strong business acumen and understanding of the relationship between operational, customer, workforce, and financial performance.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with demonstrated ability to influence business and finance stakeholders.
Proactive and intellectually curious, with the ability to identify insights and opportunities beyond the initial analytical request.
Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As Senior Regulatory Data Analyst (reporting to the Registration & Compliance Lead, Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE), you will work within our Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE – Registration & compliance, you will provide subject matter expertise with chemical regulatory compliance, chemical management and be responsible for by carrying out compliance monitoring reviews to ensure the business is meeting its regulatory obligations and risks are mitigated.

In this role, you will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with existing and emerging chemical control legislations.

Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity if, like us, you always aim to exceed customer needs, deliver value and are skilled at fostering strong relationships.

In This Exciting Role You Will


Perform compliance monitoring on all aspects of the CCL (Chemical Control Legislation) to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards and outcomes.
Collaborate with the RAPS team and business stakeholders to finalise reports for presentation and submission to relevant boards and sub-committees, in line with the requirements of the plan, including impact analysis for decision making.
Provide analyses for large datasets necessary for decisions using actionable insights
Attending sub-committee’s sessions as required to present monitoring findings and recommendations.
Support the review/update/development of the regulatory/compliance policies and procedures to ensure they remain appropriate, relevant and effective.
Participate to the development of the solutions to ensure of the compliance globally, the testing and the training of the teams as needed
Define and deliver metrics, reporting platforms, dashboards for tracking and managing the compliance
Tracking of monitoring actions through to successful resolution
Identify business challenges and initiate process improvement projects
Facilitate the computerization of analytics and data collection processes


You?

Are you someone who wants to grow and shape your own world? Who thrives being in a culture where you can express yourself in a creative team environment? Who wants to collaborate and learn together with teams who are as passionate as you are? Then come join us – and impact your world.

Your Professional Profile Includes


University / Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a scientific field
A minimum of 5 years relevant in a compliance role in chemical or related industry
Proficient knowledge of BI, SAP, or other business Intelligence tools. Must also demonstrate advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
Familiarity with programming languages (e.g: Python, Javascript, SQL) and AI is a plus
Strong analytical skills
Good working knowledge of CCL regulatory requirements and legal guidelines is an advantage
Business fluency in English AND French is a must
Experience in supporting cross functional groups and teams
Ability to work well in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment


Our Benefits


Healthcare support
Paid Time Off and family leave
Retirement plan
Sport and leisure clubs
Company shop
Staff restaurant
Corporate Mobility Plan


At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Title: Payment Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Payment Analyst based in Switzerland.

Join a newly established Payment Operations team focused on creating end-to-end visibility across a complex payment funnel serving millions of active users.

You’ll investigate payment performance across more than a dozen payment service providers, identifying issues before they become business-critical.

Your analysis will help distinguish technical defects from user-behavior patterns and uncover the bottlenecks with the greatest impact on authorization and conversion.

You’ll turn complex payment and customer data into clear insights that can guide Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams.

The role offers significant autonomy, with the opportunity to build diagnostic processes, dashboards, alerts, and reporting capabilities from the ground up.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, practical problem-solving, and small proof-of-concepts are preferred over lengthy planning cycles.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted expert on payment funnel health while directly contributing to measurable improvements in a rapidly scaling international business.

Accountabilities


Take diagnostic ownership of checkout and payment funnel health, proactively identifying alerts, anomalies, insights, and defects before they become business-critical.
Lead root-cause investigations into funnel drop-offs and payment declines, distinguishing technical or engineering issues from user-behavior patterns.
Analyze authorization rates, decline codes, payment performance, and other funnel metrics to identify the highest-impact bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Investigate performance across multiple payment service providers and identify differences, outages, or recurring issues requiring attention.
Support regular funnel reporting for cross-functional stakeholders, translating payment data into clear insights and recommendations that can improve authorization rates and conversion.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams to investigate payment issues, processor outages, and other funnel-related challenges.
Communicate technical and analytical findings clearly to stakeholders who may not have deep payments expertise.
Build and improve dashboards, alerts, reporting, and diagnostic processes that increase visibility into payment funnel performance.
Develop into a trusted point of contact for payment funnel health, helping establish best practices within the broader team.
Work proactively in an evolving environment, creating practical solutions from first principles where established processes or playbooks do not yet exist.


Requirements


Hands-on understanding of payment funnels and payment operations, including concepts such as interchange, decline codes, foreign exchange (FX), tokenization, 3DS, and fraud fundamentals.
Demonstrated experience performing root-cause analysis on funnel drop-offs, declines, or payment performance issues, including distinguishing technical causes from behavioral patterns.
Ability to analyze complex data and customer-behavior insights and communicate findings clearly to audiences without extensive technical or payments expertise.
Strong investigative mindset, with the initiative to independently identify and explore issues rather than waiting for predefined tasks.
Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where processes and playbooks may still be developing.
Nice to have: Familiarity with self-service BI and dashboarding tools to accelerate independent analysis.
Nice to have: Strong SQL skills for conducting independent investigations and data analysis.
Nice to have: Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly evolving organization.
Nice to have: Experience comparing payment performance across multiple PSPs.
Strong English communication skills, as English is the primary working language in the international team.


Benefits


Competitive salary: €40,000–€60,000 per year, with compensation potentially varying according to experience and seniority.
Employee stock options: Opportunity to participate in an employee stock options program.
Performance incentives: Access to various bonus programs, including performance-based and referral bonuses.
Additional paid leave: Opportunities to earn additional paid time off through applicable bonus programs.
Learning budget: Personal budget dedicated to professional development and learning.
Paid volunteering: Opportunities to participate in volunteering activities during paid working time.
Flexible work location: Choose between office-based and remote work, with opportunities to combine work and travel.
International environment: Work in a global team where English is the primary business language.
Career development: Strong opportunities for personal and professional growth supported by structured feedback and promotion processes.
High-impact role: Help scale a fast-growing international marketplace while directly contributing to payment performance, customer conversion, and business growth.
Autonomy and ownership: Join a newly formed function where you can help establish processes, tools, and ways of working from the ground up.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Title: Data & Insights
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data & Insights based in Switzerland.

This is a highly autonomous data role at the intersection of product, business, engineering, and analytics.

You will turn complex and sometimes ambiguous questions into actionable insights that improve product and company performance.

Your work will directly influence product priorities, experiments, growth initiatives, metrics, and data-driven decision-making.

You will contribute both to hands-on analysis and to the evolution of data foundations, models, pipelines, instrumentation, and tooling.

You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and leadership while helping teams become more effective and self-sufficient with data.

The role also offers the opportunity to shape how AI and internal data tools are used across the organization.

With broad ownership and freedom to build, buy, or simplify solutions, you will have substantial influence over both the data strategy and how data creates measurable impact.

Accountabilities


Partner with Product and Engineering teams to identify opportunities, define meaningful metrics, run experiments, and influence roadmap decisions.
Translate ambiguous or complex business and product questions into rigorous analysis, actionable insights, and measurable improvements.
Collaborate with the Head of Data on data architecture, foundations, tooling, and the long-term evolution of the data environment.
Develop and improve data models, pipelines, instrumentation, and analytics workflows as business and product requirements evolve.
Evaluate when to build internal solutions, purchase existing tools, or adopt lightweight approaches to solve data challenges efficiently.
Help advance the internal data agent, making it more useful, accessible, and valuable to teams across the organization.
Enable teams across the business to become more autonomous and effective in accessing, understanding, and applying data.
Identify opportunities to improve the reliability, accessibility, and usability of data and analytics.
Balance technical depth with practical business judgment, prioritizing solutions based on their expected impact.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data practices, processes, and tooling within a modern, evolving data environment.


Requirements


Strong experience in data analytics, insights, data engineering, product analytics, or a closely related discipline.
Strong SQL skills and solid knowledge of data modeling, analytics, and modern data tooling.
Ability to work comfortably across both analytical problems and data foundations, including models, pipelines, instrumentation, and practical internal tools.
Product-oriented mindset with genuine curiosity about user behavior, product performance, and how data can improve decision-making.
Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to take an ambiguous problem, determine the right approach, and move it toward a practical solution.
Ability to assess when to move quickly, investigate deeply, build, buy, or keep a solution intentionally simple.
Strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn raw or messy data into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, and senior leadership.
Confidence challenging assumptions constructively and communicating complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong bias toward measurable impact, with a focus on what changes as a result of your work rather than simply what gets delivered.
Experience with modern data technologies is valuable, particularly GCP, BigQuery, Composer, dbt, Tableau, Count, Amplitude, Segment, or similar tools.
Familiarity with AI-powered data tools, internal data agents, or data applications is a plus.
Willingness and ability to learn new technologies and continuously evolve your technical toolkit.


Benefits


Highly autonomous role with significant freedom to identify opportunities and shape solutions.
Broad scope spanning product analytics, business insights, data foundations, experimentation, and AI-enabled data tools.
Direct influence on product strategy, company metrics, roadmap decisions, and growth initiatives.
Opportunity to shape data architecture, tooling, processes, and the way teams across the organization use data.
Remote-first working environment across Europe, with flexibility around location.
Opportunity to work with a modern data stack including GCP, BigQuery, dbt, Replit, Tableau, Count, Amplitude, and Segment.
Collaborative environment spanning Product, Engineering, Growth, Marketing, Data, and leadership.
Opportunity to work at a profitable, growing technology company serving thousands of teams and millions of users.
Significant opportunity for professional growth through ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives.
A culture centered on autonomy, experimentation, practical problem-solving, and measurable impact.

The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

Title: un/una Data Manager
Description:
L’EOC l’ospedale multisito del Ticino è presente con i suoi istituti sull'intero territorio cantonale per un totale di 1’000 posti letto. L’organizzazione permette di combinare efficacemente approccio locale e visione d'insieme, garantendo alla popolazione un'offerta ospedaliera globale e di prossimità, indipendentemente dal luogo in cui sono richiesti i servizi.

Grazie all’impegno e alla competenza degli oltre 6’500 collaboratori e alla loro attenzione verso la relazione umana, l’EOC assicura un’assistenza sanitaria di qualità prendendosi cura di oltre 41'000 pazienti degenti all’anno e fornendo oltre 600'000 consulti ambulatoriali.

Per il Servizio Qualità e Rischi della Direzione Generale cerchiamo

un/una Data Manager (80-100%)

Scopo della funzione

Contribuire alla gestione, alla qualità e alla valorizzazione dei dati nell’ambito delle attività del Servizio Qualità e Rischi, favorendone l’utilizzo per il monitoraggio e il miglioramento continuo della qualità e della sicurezza delle cure.

Assicurare la gestione dei dati relativi ai registri sanitari nazionali, internazionali e interni e fornire supporto, attraverso dati, indicatori e analisi, alle attività di qualità, gestione dei rischi e, per gli aspetti di competenza, di clinical governance.

Principali attività


Gestire i dati relativi ai registri sanitari nazionali, internazionali e interni di competenza del Servizio Qualità e Rischi, assicurandone qualità, completezza e tracciabilità.
Organizzare e ottimizzare i processi di raccolta, validazione e gestione dei dati, favorendone, dove possibile, l’automazione.
Elaborare e analizzare dati e indicatori relativi alla qualità e alla sicurezza delle cure, contribuendo alla realizzazione di report, dashboard e strumenti di monitoraggio.
Supportare, attraverso dati e analisi, i progetti di miglioramento della qualità e della sicurezza dei pazienti e, per gli aspetti di competenza, le attività di clinical governance.
Collaborare con i professionisti clinici e con le altre funzioni aziendali nella definizione e nello sviluppo di indicatori e strumenti di monitoraggio.
Partecipare, per gli aspetti di competenza, ad audit, certificazioni e altre attività di verifica.


Competenze ed esperienze professionali


Formazione accademica (discipline sanitarie, economiche, statistiche o affini) o titolo equivalente.
Esperienza nella gestione, elaborazione e analisi di dati.
Conoscenze di base in statistica.
Buone competenze informatiche nell’ambito della gestione e analisi dei dati.
Capacità di comprendere processi complessi e di tradurre esigenze cliniche e organizzative in requisiti informativi.
Costituisce titolo preferenziale esperienza in ambito sanitario e ospedaliero e/o nella gestione di registri sanitari.
Auspicate conoscenze delle lingue nazionali e dell’inglese.


Caratteristiche personali


Capacità analitica, precisione e attenzione alla qualità del dato.
Autonomia, affidabilità e senso di responsabilità.
Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla collaborazione in contesti multidisciplinari.
Capacità organizzativa e di gestione delle priorità.
Capacità di comunicare informazioni e risultati complessi in modo chiaro e comprensibile.


Data d'entrata

da subito o da concordare.

Le candidature complete di curriculum vitae, lettera di motivazione, copie dei certificati di studio e di lavoro, dovranno essere depositate sull'apposita piattaforma tramite il sito www.eoc.ch, entro il 31 ottobre 2026.

Candidature che giungeranno oltre questa data non saranno tenute in considerazione, così come quelle pervenute in forma cartacea o via posta elettronica.

Ulteriori richieste possono essere richieste a Adriana Degiorgi, Responsabile Servizio Qualità e Rischi, adriana.degiorgi@eoc.ch .

Description:
Il Gruppo Damiani, tra i principali player internazionali nel settore della gioielleria di alta gamma, per il potenziamento del team IT siamo alla ricerca di un IT Business Intelligence Specialist che operi come ponte tra business e tecnologia.

La risorsa entrerà a far parte del team IT e lavorerà a stretto contatto con il responsabile della funzione, colleghi senior e consulenti esterni, contribuendo allo sviluppo e al mantenimento di soluzioni di reporting e analisi dati basate su tecnologie Microsoft. Formazione


Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o affini (oppure esperienza equivalente)

Title: Junior Product and Analytics Specialist (12 months temporary role) (80% - 100%)
Description:
Do you have a client-centric mindset, embrace new technologies easily, and strive for process efficiency? Are you looking for an entry-level position in the financial industry following the completion of your BSc or MSc?

If so, we invite you to explore this opportunity to join Vontobel’s Client Content Center as a Junior Product and Analytics Specialist for our Institutional Clients Segment. In this role, you will be exposed to our Investment Boutiques, which manage over CHF 110bn of client assets across the globe, with a focus on the Multi Asset Boutique.

You will run reports on investment and client data, contribute to process automation, and help deliver high-quality client communications while collaborating with global stakeholders across Client Portfolio Managers, Content Operations & Marketing Enablement and Investment teams, with a focus on the Multi Asset Boutique and the Swiss Institutional business.

What would your role be?


Support client meetings and reporting activities, through data analysis and the preparation of client-facing materials.
Contribute to the enhancement and automation of reporting and presentation processes, helping to improve efficiency and the quality of deliverables used across the business.
Gain hands-on experience in transforming and analyzing investment, fund and client data, translating complex information into clear and meaningful insights.
Collaborate with global teams to enhance presentation content and reporting materials, supporting the continuous evolution of marketing and client communication tools.


What are we looking for?


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with strong quantitative focus, preferably in Finance, Sciences or Engineering
Experience in working in a data management and/or processing role and interest in the asset management sector
Entrepreneurial mind with problem solving skills and a willingness to challenge the status quo
Structured personality with the ability to work on multiple tasks and to effectively communicate with stakeholders
Proficient in MS Office, with strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint; Porfolio Management software, Bloomberg and programming/scripting languages (Python or Matlab) are a plus
Equipped with graphic skills to improve product presentations
Familiar with AI tools and techniques to improve efficiency (automation, agents, reviews, etc.)
Fluent in English and German; Italian, Spanish and/or French is a plus


What do we offer?


Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch
Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space
All the latest technology to help you excel and advance
Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other
Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels
Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit


We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the leading and most trusted global investment firms. We have 2,300+ engaged professionals, based in 27 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich.

We are both majority family-owned and publicly listed. Our capacity for long-term focus, on topics such as sustainability, is underpinned by the security of the family’s 100-year commitment. Driven by an ownership mindset, you can unlock your potential and translate insights into opportunities. We are hiring talented individuals who are determined to deliver in a changing world and who come from a wide variety of backgrounds. Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.

We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form.

Title: Retail Allocation Analyst
Description:
At a Glance

As a Retail Allocator, you will combine analytical thinking with commercial insights to maximize in-season performance. Bridging planning, retail, and operations, you will support the EMEA region's transition to a fully AI-powered allocation system. In this role, you will help to drive highly responsive, data-driven decisions and leverage advanced analytics tools to optimize product availability and commercial growth.

Meet the Team

Help shape and scale a modern allocation function for a fast-growing brand across the EMEA region. In this role, you will support the transition to and operate our new AI-powered allocation solution, while partnering with Merchandising, Retail, Operations, and Supply Chain to boost regional performance. This role reports to the Manager of Planning and Allocation, EMEA.

Your Mission


Inventory Maximization: Optimize in-season stock utilization and strategically manage end-of-season inventory to protect margins.
AI Transition: Help support our transition to a fully AI-powered allocation system, refining logic and championing new tool adoption.
Trading & Analytics: Use data to evaluate in-season performance, driving commercial reviews, test-and-learn initiatives, and clear action plans.
Insights & Communication: Translate complex datasets into clear, visual, and actionable recommendations for merchandising, planning, and operations.


Your Story


Experience: Proven experience in data management and analytics. Experience in apparel or footwear is a plus.
Technical Skills: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets and BI tools (Tableau/Power BI). SQL, Python, or web reporting is a plus.
The AI Edge: Strong interest in transitioning to next-generation, AI-driven allocation systems.
Acumen & Mindset: Curious, detail-oriented thinker who combines sharp analytical skills with a collaborative mindset. Great at finding opportunities in data, streamlining processes, and working closely with teams to build better solutions.
Education: Preferred degree in Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, or Information Design.


What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

Title: Senior Business Partner Claims Analytics 80-100% (m/w/d)
Description:
Als Business Partner Claims Analytics mit Fokus auf das Motorgeschäft bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen dem operativen Schadenmanagement und unseren Analytics-, Data- und AI-Teams.

Du verstehst das Motorgeschäft in der Tiefe – von den operativen Schadenprozessen über die relevanten KPIs bis hin zu den P&L-relevanten Finanzkennzahlen.

Du übersetzt fachliche Herausforderungen in datenbasierte Lösungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der ersten Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz.

In einer Phase tiefgreifender technologischer Transformation gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft der datengetriebenen Schadensteuerung mit und nutzt dabei modernste Technologien als Grundlage für deine analytische Arbeit.

Unser Team in Zürich-Wallisellen sucht Verstärkung ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung!

Das kannst du bewirken


Du bist die analytische Ansprechperson für das Motorgeschäft und übersetzt die Anforderungen der Fachbereiche in konkrete Reporting-, Analyse- und Steuerungslösungen
Du verknüpfst operative Schadenkennzahlen mit finanziellen KPIs und leitest daraus relevante Handlungsempfehlungen ab
Du unterstützt Führungskräfte als Sparringspartner:in bei datenbasierten Entscheidungen und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale entlang der Schadenprozesse
Du entwickelst mit Analytics, Process Mining und AI bestehende Dashboards, Reports und Datenprodukte weiter und arbeitest eng mit unseren Data-, Analytics- und AI-Expert:innen zusammen
Du übernimmst Verantwortung von der Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und bringst eigenständig neue datengetriebene Ideen und Lösungen ein


Das bringst du mit


Hochschulabschluss in Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Mathematik, Naturwissenschaften oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science oder Data & AI, idealerweise im Versicherungs-, Schaden- oder Finanzumfeld
Ausgeprägtes Business- und Prozessverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, operative und finanzielle Kennzahlen zu verknüpfen und daraus Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten
Fundierte SQL-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit Analyse- und Reporting-Tools wie Power BI oder Celonis; Kenntnisse in Python, R oder Databricks von Vorteil
Sehr gute analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften
Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Umsetzungsstärke und Freude daran, Veränderungen und neue Themen aktiv mitzugestalten
Ein solides Verständnis von Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und KI-Tools ist erforderlich, mit einem Bewusstsein für ethische KI-Nutzung


Darum startest du mit uns

«Let’s care for tomorrow» heisst für uns auch, ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, das die Individualität unserer Mitarbeitenden berücksichtigt: Mit der Möglichkeit von Jobsharing, mit 8 Wochen Vater- und 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub, der Option, 10 zusätzliche Ferientage pro Jahr zu kaufen, bis zu 25 Tagen pro Jahr im Ausland zu arbeiten, vielseitige Weiterbildungen und weiteren Benefits. Lies mehr auf https://careers.allianz.com/Schweiz.

Title: Marketing Analytics Specialist 100% (f/m/d)
Description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius Baer is the leading Swiss private banking group and a premium brand in global wealth management with a focus on servicing and advising sophisticated private clients. In order to strengthen our leading position and shape the future of wealth management, both a comprehensive range of first-class solutions and committed teams behind them are essential. We therefore celebrate and value the individual qualities of our employees, enabling them to be entrepreneurial and empowered to create value beyond wealth.

Brand & Marketing power our firm's short- and long-term success by positioning, promoting and protecting our unique brand. We design intuitive digital user journeys, enhanced by data-driven insights, and produce impactful content through website, publications and social media, showcasing Julius Baer's outstanding investment expertise and offering. Our global client engagement initiatives, backed by unified standards and scalable tools, deliver meaningful experiences and drive measurable business impact.

Within the Digital Channels & Analytics team, we are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist who is passionate about delivering data-driven marketing insights and continuous improvements to our marketing measurement capabilities.

YOUR CHALLENGE

In your role, you will:


Analyse impact-generating customer journeys across public digital touchpoints to identify trends, behavioural patterns, and optimisation opportunities
Monitor and analyse marketing touchpoint and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement and conversion outcomes
Create recurring reports, dashboards, and automated reporting solutions using Adobe Analytics, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery), and related data sources
Consolidate and integrate data from multiple digital and offline marketing channels to create a holistic view of marketing performance and customer engagement
Translate datasets into business recommendations, tailored to operational teams, marketing stakeholders, and senior leadership
Support data validation and (A/B) testing activities
Partner with stakeholders across internal and external stakeholders to define KPIs, measurement approaches, and reporting requirements
Collaborate closely with the Data Specialist to leverage and continuously enhance data quality, measurement standards, tracking concepts, and analytics capabilities
Serve as the first-level technical support for analytics tools and dashboards (Tableau, Power BI, Adobe) within Brand & Marketing


YOUR PROFILE


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field
2-3 years of experience in marketing analytics or a similar analytical role
Experience analysing marketing performance and impact across digital and offline marketing channels
Experience in dashboard development and data visualisation, using Tableau and Power BI
Working knowledge of SQL and experience with cloud-based data platforms such as Adobe Analytics and BigQuery. Python is a plus
Understanding marketing objectives, A/B testing, conversion funnels, customer journey analytics, and marketing performance measurement
Familiarity with AI-powered analytics, automation, and self-service reporting solutions is an advantage
Experience working with Scrum methodology and tools such as Jira
Ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and translate data into practical business recommendations
Excellent written and spoken German and English


Mindset & Skills:


Curious and eager to learn new technologies, analytics methodologies, automation approaches, and AI-supported capabilities
Passionate about data, user behaviour, marketing performance, and emerging analytics technologies
Structured and detail-oriented working style with a strong focus on quality and accuracy
Hands-on mentality with the ability to independently drive dashboarding and analytical tasks
Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and explain analytical findings
Ability to balance technical implementation with business needs and user experience
Strong business acumen and a practical understanding of marketing funnels and performance measurement


We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Zimmerwald BE | 80-100% (jobsharing possible)

Ce à quoi tu peux contribuer


Évaluer la pertinence des données de communication conformément aux objectifs définis pour la politique de sécurité et analyser leur contenu
Compléter les résultats d'analyse à l'aide d'informations issues de sources publiques
Rédiger des rapports sur les informations extraites
Traiter les dossiers attribués avec autonomie et les développer de manière proactive
Optimiser les méthodes, techniques d'analyse et processus existants et contribuer à en élaborer de nouveaux


Ce qui te rend unique


Diplôme d'une haute école ou formation supérieure équivalente
Esprit d'analyse très développé et très bonnes compétences rédactionnelles
Intérêt particulier pour les questions liées à la politique de sécurité et pour les forces armées en Asie de l'Est
Très bonne compréhension des liens techniques et compétences dans les domaines cyber, télécommunication, informatique et/ou science des données
Bonnes connaissances actives dans une deuxième langue officielle, très bonnes connaissances en anglais et, idéalement, connaissances en mandarin (B2-C1)


En quelques mots

Tu travailles de manière autonome sur des thèmes définis au sein d'une équipe d'analyse. Dans un environnement dynamique, tu contribues au traitement des données de communication afin d'en extraire des informations pertinentes du point de vue du renseignement et de la politique de sécurité de la Suisse. Tu fais preuve de rigueur dans ton travail, tu aimes découvrir de nouvelles technologies et tu es capable de garder une vue d'ensemble en situation de stress. L'engagement est limité à la période allant du 1er janvier au 30 juin 2027.

Ce que nous offrons


Travailler pour la Suisse Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien-être de la population.
La diversité au quotidien Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents.
Santé au travail Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique.


Tous les avantages

Ton engagement pour la sécurité et la liberté

Le commandement Cyber (cdmt Cyber) est gage de compétences en matière cyber et de numérisation. Nous allions l'enthousiasme pour notre mission à notre savoir-faire et les associons à l'innovation, aux technologies les plus modernes et aux méthodes de travail agiles. Nous fournissons des prestations informatiques sûres, robustes et résilientes pour l'Armée suisse et nos partenaires du Réseau national de sécurité. Le cdmt Cyber permet ainsi à notre armée d'avoir l'avance nécessaire en matière de connaissances et de décisions pour assurer la sécurité de la Suisse. L'Armée suisse emploie plus de 9000 collaborateurs/trices dans quatre professions militaires et environ 200 professions civiles, et ce, sur 110 sites dans toute la Suisse. Elle assure également la relève en formant des apprenti/e/s dans plus de 30 métiers.

Même en cas de postulation jointe, merci de nous faire parvenir ton dossier individuel séparément, en mentionnant le nom de la personne avec qui tu souhaites partager le poste. Diesen Beitrag kannst du leisten


Kommunikationsdaten gemäss sicherheitspolitischen Zielsetzungen auf ihre Relevanz prüfen und inhaltlich analysieren
Analyseergebnisse mit Informationen aus öffentlich zugänglichen Quellen anreichern
Gewonnene Erkenntnisse in Form von schriftlichen Berichten aufbereiten
Zugewiesene Dossiers selbständig bearbeiten und proaktiv weiterentwickeln
Optimierung bestehender sowie Erarbeitung neuer Prozesse, Methoden und Analysetechniken aktiv mitgestalten

Hochschulabschluss oder vergleichbare höhere Ausbildung
Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denken und überdurchschnittliche redaktionelle Fähigkeiten
Besonderes Interesse an sicherheitspolitischen Fragestellungen sowie Streitkräften im ostasiatischen Raum
Hohes Verständnis für technische Zusammenhänge und Kompetenzen im Bereich Cyber, Telekommunikation, Informatik und/oder Data Science
Gute aktive Kenntnisse einer zweiten Amtssprache und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Sprachkenntnisse in Mandarin (B2–C1) sind von Vorteil


Auf den Punkt gebracht

Du arbeitest selbstständig in einem Analyseteam an vorgegebenen Themenbereichen. Du hilfst mit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld aus Kommunikationsdaten nachrichtendienstlich relevante Erkenntnisse zugunsten der Sicherheitspolitik der Schweiz zu gewinnen. Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, hast Freude daran, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten, und behältst auch in hektischen Zeiten den Überblick. Die Anstellung ist befristet vom 1. Januar bis zum 30. Juni 2027.

Das bieten wir


Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.
Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.
Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.


Alle Benefits

Dein Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit

Das Kommando Cyber (Kdo Cy) steht für Kompetenz in den Bereichen Cyber und Digitalisierung. Wir erbringen sichere, robuste und resiliente Informatikleistungen für die Schweizer Armee und unsere Partner im Sicherheitsverbund Schweiz. Title: Senior Digital Analytics Consultant H/F (Geneva)
Description:
fifty-five is a new kind of data company that helps brands transform with data and AI to improve their marketing operations through a combination of specialized consultancy and technology services.

As the strategic data pillar of The Brandtech Group, we offer services that combine strategy consulting, cloud services, media consulting and customer experience.

We are made up of over +320 digital experts. Digital consultants, tracking and media specialists, engineers and data scientists all work in close collaboration to provide senior-level marketing consultancy and technical support to our clients, in every type of industry, all around the world.

As a partner to advertisers from data collection to activation and exploitation, we help organizations become truly omnichannel entities that control the efficiency of their digital ecosystem and its synergies with the physical world.

Headquartered in Paris, we operate across 3 time zones from our 10 offices, located in Paris, London, Geneva, Milan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Taipei, Singapore and New York. fifty-five attaches particular importance to the well-being of its employees, which enabled it to be included in the Best Workplaces France ranking in 2018.

Within the consulting team based in Geneva, you will actively take part in delivering fifty-five's data-led projects to multiple clients. Those projects will be driven by client objectives relating to data collection, customer acquisition, onsite conversion optimisation, media-mix optimisation and digital business consulting. During these projects, you will contribute to promoting a customer-centred vision of digital marketing, based on the systematic and methodical use of data to support decisions. You will work across multiple industries including luxury, FMCG, sport, and beauty.


You will report to a Local Executive Director and will work closely with Product, Engineering and Operations Teams based in Paris. As a data analyst and consultant, you will follow an action plan, issuing step-by-step the deliverables required for successful delivery of the project. You will guarantee the integrity of analytics data as well as its analysis and interpretation in working with your team and client.


You will be responsible for the content, the format and overall quality of the outputs delivered to the client and for monitoring their operational and technical implementation where required. Based on your good understanding of our projects and our clients' needs, you will collaborate with all our teams to develop fifty-five's offer, both in terms of marketing and in terms of technical and operational delivery.



Responsibilities


Deliver projects related to the monitoring of the client's digital activity based on key performance indicators (reporting), to onsite conversion optimization through data analysis and webtesting, to online media buy optimization and CRM.
Analyse data and structure relevant information for the client's benefit, in consistency with business indicators specific to their industry (eg. mobile operators, retail, travel, etc.)
Develop a sharp operational expertise on both conversion and online media-buy topics
Meet clients' needs and pay strong attention to the quality of all deliverables
Occasional travel possible, within Switzerland or abroad (including Paris)


Education and Experience


Master's degree (business, engineering) or equivalent diploma
1 to 3 years experience in digital marketing, consulting firms, marketing or business intelligence software, or media agencies
Working with web analytics tools
Knowledge of the main online acquisition channels: SEO, SEM and bidmanagement, display and programmatic, affiliates, email and social media

Skills and Interests


Fluent in French & English and excellent communication, oral and written
Strong analytical skills and knowledge of analysis, statistical software and data vizualization tool
Good business and market understanding
Client-facing skills
Good team spirit
Strong interest in new technologies and the digital industry

Title: Revenue Analyst
Description:
Organization- Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport

Summary

Hyatt Regency Zurich Airport Convention Center & Hyatt Place Zurich Airport The Circle are just a few steps from the terminals and within The Circle district, an urban location with various shops, restaurants, the iconic Convention Center and an extensive park. The Circle Convention Center is the ideal venue for an international congress, an extravagant reception or a car presentation. Guests enjoy direct access to the Zurich Airport hub, featuring versatile spaces designed by starchitect Riken Yamamoto with daylight in all our meeting rooms and innovative lighting as well as Swiss quality and first-class catering.

Your main tasks & responsibilities:

As a Revenue Analyst, you will support the hotel’s revenue and profitability goals through pricing, forecasting, market analysis, and inventory management. Working closely with the Revenue Manager and Commercial Team, you will analyze performance and market trends, identify opportunities, and provide insights that support commercial decision-making and strengthen the hotel’s market position.

Furthermore, you:


Monitor hotel performance and identify opportunities to maximize revenue and profitability.
Analyze booking patterns, demand trends, competitor performance, and business mix.
Support pricing and inventory strategies across market segments and distribution channels.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly revenue reports, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities.
Support forecasting, budgeting, and business planning.

Maintain revenue management systems and ensure data accuracy.

Support group pricing decisions and evaluate business opportunities.
Monitor competitor activity, market developments, and industry trends.
Identify opportunities to improve Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, market share, and overall hotel revenue.
Work collaboratively with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations.
Ensure revenue management practices are aligned with Hyatt standards and business objectives.

A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Revenue Management, Revenue Analysis, Commercial Analysis, or a similar hospitality role.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence using reporting and analytical tools.
Fluent English, both written and spoken. German would be considered an advantage.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Comfortable turning data into clear business recommendations.

Title: LPG Analyst
Description:
As an LPG Analyst to support our global oil trading team, providing in-depth market analysis, building and updating supply and demand models, providing value-add market insights, and analyzing high-frequency indicators of market dynamics. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland.

Key Responsibilities

Collating, analysing and interpreting data to produce commodity market insights

Conduct comprehensive research and analysis on fuel oil markets, including supply/demand dynamics, pricing trends, arbitrage opportunities, and regulatory developments across major global trading hubs

Build and maintaining supply and demand models, and develop detailed market reports, presentations, and trade recommendations to inform trading strategies

Provide trade flow analysis and other ad-hoc analysis to support decision-making by senior traders and management

Collaborate closely with traders, operations teams, and other analysts to identify trading opportunities, monitor positions, and manage risk exposure

Build and maintain proprietary models and tools for market analysis, forecasting, and scenario planning.

Stay up-to-date on industry news, market intelligence, and competitor activities to provide a competitive edge

Establish strong relationships with key market participants, including refiners, suppliers, and customers, to gather market intelligence.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related quantitative field;

Minimum of 4 years of experience in commodity analysis or a related analytical role, preferably with exposure to fuel oil/refined products markets

Prior experience in commodity research, specifically in LPG analytics

Strong quantitative and analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex data sets and extract meaningful insights

Experience using trade data, data visualization tools and statistical data modeling software.

Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, R, SQL) and Microsoft Office suite.

Knowledge of commodity trading fundamentals, risk management principles, and financial modeling

Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced educational degree

Fluency in another foreign language

Programming experience and a solid understanding of database concepts (Python and SQL preferred; R, MATLAB or VBA beneficial).

Direct knowledge of LPG markets

Attributes for success

Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely

Strong intrinsic interest in financial markets, geopolitical developments and a sound understanding of economic theory and cycles

Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Ability to work independently and proactively to deliver timely results.

Analytical mindset and critical thinking skills, with an emphasis on providing proactive insights that have tradeable value.

Title: Payment Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Payment Analyst based in Switzerland.

Join a newly established Payment Operations team focused on creating end-to-end visibility across a complex payment funnel serving millions of active users.

You’ll investigate payment performance across more than a dozen payment service providers, identifying issues before they become business-critical.

Your analysis will help distinguish technical defects from user-behavior patterns and uncover the bottlenecks with the greatest impact on authorization and conversion.

You’ll turn complex payment and customer data into clear insights that can guide Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams.

The role offers significant autonomy, with the opportunity to build diagnostic processes, dashboards, alerts, and reporting capabilities from the ground up.

You’ll work in a fast-moving environment where experimentation, practical problem-solving, and small proof-of-concepts are preferred over lengthy planning cycles.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted expert on payment funnel health while directly contributing to measurable improvements in a rapidly scaling international business.

Accountabilities


Take diagnostic ownership of checkout and payment funnel health, proactively identifying alerts, anomalies, insights, and defects before they become business-critical.
Lead root-cause investigations into funnel drop-offs and payment declines, distinguishing technical or engineering issues from user-behavior patterns.
Analyze authorization rates, decline codes, payment performance, and other funnel metrics to identify the highest-impact bottlenecks and improvement opportunities.
Investigate performance across multiple payment service providers and identify differences, outages, or recurring issues requiring attention.
Support regular funnel reporting for cross-functional stakeholders, translating payment data into clear insights and recommendations that can improve authorization rates and conversion.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Fraud teams to investigate payment issues, processor outages, and other funnel-related challenges.
Communicate technical and analytical findings clearly to stakeholders who may not have deep payments expertise.
Build and improve dashboards, alerts, reporting, and diagnostic processes that increase visibility into payment funnel performance.
Develop into a trusted point of contact for payment funnel health, helping establish best practices within the broader team.
Work proactively in an evolving environment, creating practical solutions from first principles where established processes or playbooks do not yet exist.


Requirements


Hands-on understanding of payment funnels and payment operations, including concepts such as interchange, decline codes, foreign exchange (FX), tokenization, 3DS, and fraud fundamentals.
Demonstrated experience performing root-cause analysis on funnel drop-offs, declines, or payment performance issues, including distinguishing technical causes from behavioral patterns.
Ability to analyze complex data and customer-behavior insights and communicate findings clearly to audiences without extensive technical or payments expertise.
Strong investigative mindset, with the initiative to independently identify and explore issues rather than waiting for predefined tasks.
Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where processes and playbooks may still be developing.
Nice to have: Familiarity with self-service BI and dashboarding tools to accelerate independent analysis.
Nice to have: Strong SQL skills for conducting independent investigations and data analysis.
Nice to have: Experience working in a high-growth or rapidly evolving organization.
Nice to have: Experience comparing payment performance across multiple PSPs.
Strong English communication skills, as English is the primary working language in the international team.


Benefits


Competitive salary: €40,000–€60,000 per year, with compensation potentially varying according to experience and seniority.
Employee stock options: Opportunity to participate in an employee stock options program.
Performance incentives: Access to various bonus programs, including performance-based and referral bonuses.
Additional paid leave: Opportunities to earn additional paid time off through applicable bonus programs.
Learning budget: Personal budget dedicated to professional development and learning.
Paid volunteering: Opportunities to participate in volunteering activities during paid working time.
Flexible work location: Choose between office-based and remote work, with opportunities to combine work and travel.
International environment: Work in a global team where English is the primary business language.
Career development: Strong opportunities for personal and professional growth supported by structured feedback and promotion processes.
High-impact role: Help scale a fast-growing international marketplace while directly contributing to payment performance, customer conversion, and business growth.
Autonomy and ownership: Join a newly formed function where you can help establish processes, tools, and ways of working from the ground up.
