Title: Statistician
Description:
Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level.

The incumbent will work in the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics team within the Statistics Division and will contribute to the production and dissemination of all statistics reported in the Food Security and Nutrition, Food and Diet, and Cost and Affordability of Healthy Diets data domains of FAOSTAT.

The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician reports to the Senior Statistician and team leader of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team, under the overall guidance of the Director of ESS.

Technical Focus

The S tatistician will provide statistical expertise in the improvement of existing methods and development of new methods for the generation of food security and nutrition statistics, and in the compilation, processing, validation, analysis, storage and dissemination of data, microdata and metadata, with a special emphasis on data from experience-based food security scales. The role includes: ensuring the correct application of methods to estimate the Prevalence of food insecurity based on Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES), the Prevalence of Undernourishment (PoU), and the Prevalence of Unaffordability of a healthy diet (PUA); the production of high quality documents and statistical tools, including software packages, scripts, datasets and reports on the analysis of food security and nutrition data; collaborating with external stakeholders and partners, including national statistical offices and other international organizations or research institutions, involved in the collection, analysis, dissemination and reporting of food security and nutrition statistics based on FAO endorsed statistical methods and definitions.

Key Results

Research and analysis of information, data and statistics, statistical methods, statistical and econometric modelling. Development and maintenance of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases and the technical assistance services to support the implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions


Collects, reviews, processes and/or analyses key social/economic/environmental/indicators, based on both traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods, to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work, which can be focused on products, projects, publications or services.
Develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems, databases.
Conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
Produces a variety of technical reports and provides input in technical documents, divisional publications and/or web pages.
Provides response to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices, including technical backstopping to field projects.
Participates in multidisciplinary teams, collaborates with other Divisions/Offices/Centres on work groups and committees and promotes best practices.
Provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
Participates in divisional teams, Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
Supports the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with the Strategic Framework and divisional plans.
Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.


Specific Functions

Maintains and refines the methodology and the statistical tools to compute the Prevalence of Food Insecurity based on FIES and other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the FSN statistics Team.


Contributes to the development of analytic models and scoring strategies for the FIES, with the aim of ensuring cross-country comparability and stability over time of the food security measure.
Analyses results to identify potential inconsistencies in the level s and trends of different indicators (FIES-based, PoU, PUA, economic and social well-being) and propose s appropriate strateg ies to address them.
Maintains and extends the analytic codes and statistical methods to analyse FIES data through Item Response Theory models (both dichotomous and polytomous) as needed for various purposes (capacity building, research, SDG monitoring, IPC classification etc.).
R eviews sampling frames of surveys used to inform food insecurity indicators, including post-stratification weighting, with the purpose of assessing the survey quality and re-adjusts the sampling weights if needed.
Provides methodological guidance for the improvement of other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the team, including the PoU and PUA.
Works on and refines the methodologies for data disaggregation and variance computation of the different food security and nutrition indicators.


Undertakes and supports data analysis and dissemination activities.


Conducts analyses of national datasets collected in order to determine the potential for producing food insecurity prevalence estimates to inform the global assessment.
Contributes to the publication of divisional reports and scientific papers on the FIES methodology and empirical application.
Conduct s research on extending existing methods to different applications (e.g. acute food insecurity monitoring, right to food, urban food security, etc.).
Contributes to discussions among food security analysts in different fora, providing guidance for the analysis and interpretation of food security indicators.
Disseminates and interprets results based on the analysis of FIES data in different platforms and systems (Statistical Working System -SWS, FAOSTAT, UNSD, etc.).
Drafts sections of the State of Food Insecurity and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) report that concern statistical data analysis and interpretation of the food security indicators, updating and interpreting the latest trends and contributing in the thematic part as needed.
Supports the computation of regional aggregates of various food security and nutrition indicators to be disseminated in FAOSTAT and other data platforms.


Provide technical assistance and capacity development on the FIES-based and other food security indicators.


Within the mandate of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team , provides assistance for statistical analyses related to food security indicators to other teams and divisions in FAO, to professionals from other international agencies, NGOs and academicians with an interest towards food security measurement, their interpretation and use in policy making.
Provides technical assistance to national statistical offices for statistical analyses of food security data collected in national surveys.
Designs, tests and conducts capacity development activities on the use of the developed FAO software and modelling approach to assess access to food (may require travel and language courses).
Oversees the development of web-based learning materials for the software and model application to estimate the access to food, both for internal (FAO) and external (not FAO) users.


Provide statistical expertise/support to other members of the food security and nutrition statistics team as necessary.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements


Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in statistics, mathematics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field.
Five years of relevant experience in the compilation and analysis of food and agricultural statistics in national or international organizations with focus on the methodological development and production of food security statistics.
Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).


Competencies


Results Focus
Teamwork
Communication
Building Effective Relationships
Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


Technical/Functional Skills


Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field positions.
Strong command of statistical methods including: data presentation, analysis and descriptive statistics; main continuous and discrete random variables (binomial, normal, standard normal, log-normal) and their properties; probability distributions; conditional probability, probabilities of intersections of events, Bayes' theorem; correlation and rank correlation; sampling and sample size: simple, stratified, and multistage random sampling; Inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and significance; linear regression (single and multiple) comparison of population means and variances, ANOVA; Chi-square and goodness of fit tests; nonlinear models: maximum likelihood estimation; elements of survey and questionnaire design.
Extent and relevance of experience and knowledge of the main data sources used for the compilation of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in the compilation, validation, and analysis of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in software used for processing and analysing data, such as R, STATA, SPSS, SAS.
Extent and relevance of statistical programming skills.
Depth familiarity with relevant statistical methods for data analysis using Item Response Theory.
Ability to analyse complex statistical-related issues.

  • Works on and refines the methodologies for data disaggregation and variance computation of the different food security and nutrition indicators.

Undertakes and supports data analysis and dissemination activities.

  • Conducts analyses of national datasets collected in order to determine the potential for producing food insecurity prevalence estimates to inform the global assessment.
  • Contributes to the publication of divisional reports and scientific papers on the FIES methodology and empirical application.
  • Conduct s research on extending existing methods to different applications (e.g. acute food insecurity monitoring, right to food, urban food security, etc.).
  • Contributes to discussions among food security analysts in different fora, providing guidance for the analysis and interpretation of food security indicators.
  • Disseminates and interprets results based on the analysis of FIES data in different platforms and systems (Statistical Working System -SWS, FAOSTAT, UNSD, etc.).

  • Within the mandate of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team , provides assistance for statistical analyses related to food security indicators to other teams and divisions in FAO, to professionals from other international agencies, NGOs and academicians with an interest towards food security measurement, their interpretation and use in policy making.
  • Provides technical assistance to national statistical offices for statistical analyses of food security data collected in national surveys.
  • Designs, tests and conducts capacity development activities on the use of the developed FAO software and modelling approach to assess access to food (may require travel and language courses).
  • Oversees the development of web-based learning materials for the software and model application to estimate the access to food, both for internal (FAO) and external (not FAO) users.

Provide statistical expertise/support to other members of the food security and nutrition statistics team as necessary.

  • Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, and Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA), headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, operate collectively as a “Bridgestone West” strategic region. BSAM and BSEMEA are subsidiaries of Bridgestone Corporation, globally headquartered in Japan. Bridgestone and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market a wide range of Bridgestone, Firestone and associate brand products and solutions to address the needs of a broad range of customers and industries.

About The Role

Job Purpose

As part of the Procurement Operations, Digitalization & Strategic Excellence team, the Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining the data foundations that enable modern, data-driven procurement operations.

The role ensures procurement data is accurate, reliable, governed, and accessible in real time to support operational excellence, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with procurement, IT, data engineering, and business stakeholders, the specialist will transform procurement data into a strategic asset that drives better decision-making and continuous improvement

Also, Bridgestone Europe is embedding AI across multiple ERP (mostly SAP - S/4HANA, BDC) landscapes and platforms. Within Procurement, this role delivers the data products that make those use cases possible: clearly defined, properly modelled, documented, and trusted.

Responsibilities

Data Governance & Stewardship



Act as the Procurement Data Steward for master and transactional procurement data.
Define, implement and continuously improve procurement data standards, governance and quality rules.
Monitor data quality KPIs and drive corrective actions with business and IT teams.
Ensure data consistency across SAP and connected procurement applications.



Data Foundation & Architecture



Data Attribute Definition: Define and document data attributes, business rules, calculation logic, and field-level definitions for all procurement data products — spend, suppliers, contracts, and purchasing KPIs.
Collaborate with IT and Data Platform teams to ensure procurement data is available, secure and scalable.
Support the integration of SAP data with enterprise data platforms and analytical environments.
Contribute to the evolution of procurement data architecture.
Source-to-Target Validation: mappings from SAP S/4HANA and various data sources into SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks, ensuring data flows correctly and completely.



Analytics & Business Intelligence



Develop and maintain procurement dashboards, KPIs and self-service reporting solutions.
Translate business requirements into actionable reporting and analytics.
Support procurement category managers and leadership with insightful data analysis.
Promote data-driven decision making throughout the procurement organization.



AI Enablement



Ensure procurement data is AI-ready by improving its quality, structure and accessibility.
Support the deployment of AI and Generative AI use cases within procurement.
Partner with Digital and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and predictive analytics.



Qualifications & Experience Required

Education, Master, other certification:



Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
SAP certifications or proven experience in S/4HANA, BTP, Datasphere / Business Data Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, or hyperscaler data platforms are a strong advantage.
Training in data modelling, data governance, or AI and machine learning fundamentals is a plus.



Experience (years):



3-5 years in a data, analytics, procurement operations, or procurement technology role.
SAP is essential: hands-on experience with S/4HANA procurement data structures, plus exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BTP, and SAP Business AI.
Proven end-to-end delivery of data products, from definition to production, not one-off extracts.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Python, and SQL within a lakehouse or cloud data platform.
Experience with integration and harmonisation of data across multiple or heterogeneous ERP systems.
Experience preparing and governing data for AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics use cases.
International, multi-country transformation programmes are a plus.



Technical Skills:



SAP S/4HANA procurement data objects and master data: vendor, material, info records, source lists, contracts, purchase orders.
SAP Business Data Cloud: data products, spaces, replication, consumption models; awareness of SAP Business AI, Joule, and AI Foundation on SAP BTP.
Data modelling: relational and dimensional, semantic layers, canonical cross-system models, master data harmonisation.
SQL and Python, including pandas and PySpark, for transformation, analysis, and automation.
Databricks: notebooks, Delta Lake, workflows.
Common data technologies beyond SAP: cloud data warehouses, ETL/ELT and orchestration, APIs, event-based integration.
Architectural design at comprehension level: layering, lakehouse versus warehouse, batch versus real-time, and related trade-offs.
Data governance: lineage, cataloguing, data contracts, and quality frameworks.
SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Tableau; advanced Excel and PowerPoint.



Languages Skills:



Fluent English, written and spoken.
Additional European languages are a plus.



Soft/Behavioral Skills:



Structured and precise, with rigour on definitions and documentation.
Systems thinking: connects business process, data structure, and technology.
Explains data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Turns ambiguous business needs into scoped, deliverable data requirements.
Curious about emerging data and AI technologies; comfortable with change and ambiguity.
Strong ownership across multiple stakeholders and parallel deliverables.



Salary range: € 37,601.10 - 54,000

The salary range is based on gender-neutral criteria: applicable CCNL requirements, responsibilities, working conditions and market benchmarks for the role and location. Final compensation will be determined based on gender-neutral criteria: experience, skills, and internal equity.

A supportive and engaging onboarding experience to ensure a smooth transition into our team.
The opportunity to develop and grow, through training and regular mentorship.
Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
A truly global, dynamic and challenging work environment.
Agility and work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being.
A diverse and inclusive team.

This means that all job applicants and members of staff will receive equal treatment and that we will not discriminate on grounds of gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, color, nationality, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, religion or age.

Title: Customer Excellence & Analytics Senior Manager
Description:
Job description:



At Angelini Pharma, we believe that great healthcare starts with truly understanding the people we serve. As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you'll turn data, AI, and customer insight into smarter decisions and more meaningful connections with healthcare professionals. You'll shape how we listen, measure, and engage across every channel, transforming numbers into stories that inspire action and make a real difference for patients. If you're passionate about changing the way teams work, not just reporting on it, we'd love to meet you.

 

About the role

As our Customer Excellence & Analytics Manager, you will lead how we understand, measure, and improve our commercial engagement model — combining data, AI, and customer experience thinking to drive better decisions and better outcomes.

What you will own: 

Customer Intelligence
Build deep understanding of HCP segments — behaviours, channel preferences, content needs, and prescribing drivers — that goes beyond traditional targeting.
Use predictive analytics and AI models to anticipate HCP responsiveness, churn risk, and engagement opportunities before they surface in the field.
Omnichannel Performance & Measurement
Design the KPI architecture that tells us whether our commercial model is working with customer — reach, frequency, engagement quality, cross-channel synergy, and conversion.
Move beyond reporting: translate performance data into clear, narrative-driven recommendations that change how brand and field teams operate.
Commercial Analytics & AI
Lead the commercial analytics roadmap: sales performance, promotional response, market share, competitive intelligence
Champion a data-driven culture: enable commercial teams to self-serve on core insights; brief senior leadership with clarity, not complexity
Identify and pilot AI applications that create competitive advantage 
Data Governance & Commercial Data Strategy
Own the integrity of commercial data assets: KPI definitions, master data standards, source-of-truth alignment across CRM, BI, and marketing platforms.
Ensure all analytical outputs are consistent, documented, and decision-ready 

 

Requirements

Degree in Business, Economics, Life Sciences, or a quantitative discipline.
5–8 years in commercial operations, analytics, customer excellence, market intelligence or digital within pharma 
Proven track record of connecting data to commercial decisions — not just producing reports, but changing what teams do
Fluency in commercial metrics and omnichannel models; power-user comfort with CRM, BI tools (Power BI)
Working knowledge of AI and machine learning applications in a commercial context 
Strong cross-functional influencer: able to align Sales, Marketing, Medical, and IT stakeholders without direct authority
Executive communication skills: you simplify complexity, tell stories with data, and make senior stakeholders act.

 

The salary for this role starts from 64000€ gross per year, depending on experience and location. The offer isdetermined based on gender-neutral criteria, including relevant skills, competencies, and experience.

Angelini Pharma is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We believe that diversity is a huge value that contributes to individual and company success. We arecommitted to create and foster a diverse and inclusive environment.

Title: Service Operations Analyst – AI & Automation
HTML:
Job Description

KeyBiz è una società di consulenza specializzata in trasformazione digitale e servizi IT per clienti enterprise. Operiamo in contesti internazionali strutturati, con un forte focus sull’innovazione e l’eccellenza operativa. La nostra cultura aziendale valorizza la collaborazione, la crescita professionale e l’adozione di tecnologie all’avanguardia per supportare i nostri clienti nel percorso di digitalizzazione.

Descrizione del ruolo

Stiamo cercando un/una Service Operations Analyst – AI & Automation da inserire in un contesto internazionale presso un cliente del settore telecomunicazioni. La risorsa supporterà il team di Service Manager nelle attività operative, di reporting e analisi delle performance dei servizi digitali, contribuendo allo sviluppo di automazioni basate su AI e GenAI.

Responsabilità principali

  • Produzione e manutenzione di report periodici su SLA, OLA, KPI di servizio, trend e backlog con focus sul miglioramento continuo;
  • Analisi dati operativi, supporto alla qualità dei dati e sviluppo di metriche per stakeholder IT e business;
  • Supporto nella gestione dei processi Incident, Problem e Request Fulfillment, monitoraggio code operative e follow-up delle attività aperte;
  • Aggiornamento della knowledge base (FAQ, runbook, playbook) per garantire la condivisione delle informazioni;
  • Prototipazione di automazioni leggere tramite Copilot/GenAI e scripting di base (es. estrazione dati, arricchimento ticket);
  • Contributo all’identificazione e valutazione di nuovi casi d’uso AI in ambito Service Operations;
  • Preparazione di presentazioni operative in italiano e inglese per stakeholder IT e business;
  • Collaborazione quotidiana con team internazionali (Operations, Service Desk, Vendor, Business);
  • Aggiornamento documentazione su SharePoint e ServiceNow garantendo tracciabilità e qualità.

Requisiti essenziali

  • Laurea STEM o esperienza pratica equivalente;
  • Eccellente conoscenza della lingua inglese per reportistica, presentazioni e interazioni operative;
  • Ottima padronanza di Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel avanzato (formule, pivot, grafici) e PowerPoint;
  • Spiccate capacità analitiche e di sintesi orientate al passaggio dai dati alle azioni;
  • Proattività, autonomia operativa e attitudine al lavoro in team.

Requisiti preferenziali

  • Esperienza in Service Management / IT Operations (ticketing, KPI, processi ITSM);
  • Conoscenza di ITIL® (certificazione considerata un plus);
  • Familiarità con Copilot, AI/GenAI, prompt design e micro-automazioni;
  • Esperienza con strumenti ITSM come ServiceNow (preferibile), Jira, Zendesk o OTRS;
  • Nozioni base di Python o capacità nell’interrogazione di dataset;
  • Esperienza nel settore telecomunicazioni;
  • Competenze nella programmazione e integrazione sistemi.

Competenze trasversali richieste

  • Eccellente comunicazione chiara ed orientamento al cliente;
  • Adeguate capacità di problem solving nonché gestione efficace del tempo e delle priorità;
  • Cura tecnologica costante con attitudine all’apprendimento continuo;
  • Mentalità internazionale ed esperienza nel lavoro in contesti multiculturali.

Cosa offriamo

  • Inserimento in un ambiente internazionale con servizi digitali ad alta visibilità;
  • Percorsi formativi dedicati su ITIL/ITSM e AI/GenAI;
  • Sperimentazione concreta su automazioni innovative con contributo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo;
  • Sistema welfare aziendale completo;
  • Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa.

Condizioni economiche

L’offerta prevede una RAL compresa tra €35.000 e €40.000 annui .

Modalità di lavoro: Ibrida, due gg a settimana in presenza zona Parco Dè Medici

Diversità ed inclusione

L’offerta è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi ai sensi della Legge n.903/77. KeyBiz promuove un ambiente lavorativo inclusivo che valorizza diversità culturale ed esperienziale.

Tutela della privacy

I dati personali forniti saranno trattati esclusivamente ai fini della selezione del personale nel rispetto del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR), secondo principi di liceità, correttezza e trasparenza.

Title: Fabric Analytics Engineer
Description:
Noi di AGIC, Solution Partner di Microsoft, siamo una realtà che punta sull'innovazione e sulla crescita delle persone. Crediamo che il successo nasca dalla collaborazione e dalla passione per la tecnologia. Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Fabric Analytics Engineer che voglia unirsi al nostro team Data Intelligence per progettare, realizzare e governare soluzioni analitiche enterprise su Microsoft Fabric, accompagnando i nostri clienti nel percorso verso una cultura data driven.




I nostri punti di forza sono 4: le persone, le competenze, Microsoft e la crescita.




Siamo una grande squadra, orientata allo sviluppo di nuovi talenti e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi comuni.




Se vuoi far parte di un ambiente dinamico e stimolante, questa è l'opportunità giusta per te!




La risorsa entrerà a far parte di un team specializzato nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di soluzioni Microsoft Fabric su progetti di Data Integration, Data Migration, Data Management e Data Analytics.




La risorsa avrà modo di:

Progettare e realizzare soluzioni analitiche end-to-end su Microsoft Fabric, con architetture lakehouse e warehouse organizzate a livelli
Preparare, trasformare e arricchire i dati provenienti da sorgenti eterogenee, costruendo pipeline e dataflow affidabili e monitorabili
Progettare, implementare e ottimizzare report e modelli semantici, curandone performance, granularità, relazioni e misure DAX
Mettere in sicurezza e mantenere gli asset analitici: permessi, row-level e object-level security, etichette di riservatezza, ciclo di vita e deployment degli ambienti
Raccogliere i requisiti tecnici e funzionali dal cliente, stimare i tempi e redigere documentazione tecnica
Mantenere aggiornate le competenze sulle tecnologie Microsoft e sulle best practice di data management e analytics




I nostri candidati ideali:

Cerchiamo persone appassionate e motivate, in possesso di:

Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Business Intelligence o Data Analytics in ambito Microsoft
Almeno 1 anno di esperienza con Microsoft Fabric e partecipazione attiva ad almeno un progetto realizzato con la piattaforma e rilasciato in produzione
Conoscenza approfondita di Power BI (Desktop e Service) e dei componenti Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory e notebook Spark
Conoscenza di SQL, DAX, e PySpark, unita a solide basi di modellazione dati
Esperienza nella gestione della sicurezza e della governance degli asset analitici
Attitudine al lavoro in team e orientamento al cliente
Laurea in discipline tecnico-scientifiche o esperienza equivalente
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata




Skill chiave:

Capacità di analisi e problem solving
Competenze nella progettazione di architetture dati e BI
Abilità di presentazione e storytelling dei dati
Elevata flessibilità tecnica nel navigare l'intero ecosistema Microsoft Fabric, dall'architettura OneLake alla data visualization in Power BI
Capacità di comunicare in modo chiaro e convincente con interlocutori tecnici e business
Approccio consulenziale, con spiccata flessibilità e dinamicità




Requisiti graditi:

Certificazione Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600) e/o DP-700
Conoscenza degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale applicati al dato: Copilot, Fabric Data Agent, preparazione di dati AI-ready
Conoscenza di Azure Data Services (Data Lake, Synapse, Data Factory) e di Databricks o Spark
Esperienza di lavoro in contesti DevOps e Agile, con pratiche di CI/CD applicate agli asset analitici




Cosa offriamo:

Un ambiente dinamico e informale
Numerosi eventi aziendali e occasioni di team building
Possibilità di smart working e flessibilità oraria
Attenzione alle persone e orientamento ai risultati
Percorsi di crescita professionale, formazione continua e supporto al percorso di certificazione Microsoft




Tipologia di inserimento: tempo indeterminato RAL: 30.000€ - 40.000€.




Sede di lavoro: Roma, Milano, Napoli, Francavilla. Ibrido.




La ricerca è rivolta a candidati ambosessi (L. 903/77).

Invia la tua candidatura!

Capacità di modellare requisiti informativi (entità, attributi, relazioni). Saper definire metriche e indicatori in modo univoco.
Familiarità con modelli dimensionali (star schema, snowflake schema) e concetti di data mart.
Conoscenza dei servizi di gestione dei Dati e dei servizi di AI applicati alla generazione automatica di contenuti in diversi contesti (conoscenza di OpenAI e Microsoft Copilot sono un plus).
Conoscenze statistiche/analitiche e di linguaggi di programmazione come SQL e Python sono considerati un plus per validare i dati o supportare analisi.
Conoscere framework come Dama DMBok concetti di Data Management sono considerati un plus.
Eccellenti capacità di organizzazione del tempo, gestione dei progetti e collaborazione in team multidisciplinari.
Capacità di supportare risorse junior con buone capacità di comunicazione e mentoring.
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese sia scritta che parlata.

Analitic* e curios*.

Title: Stage in Tender Excellence, Data Analytics & Digital Transformation
Description:
Obiettivo

Supportare il Tender Office nelle attività di monitoraggio, analisi dei dati, monitoraggio dei KPI, standardizzazione dei processi e implementazione del modulo BOT di Contract Manager, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione e all’ottimizzazione della raccolta ed elaborazione dati.

Lo stagista collaborerà con il Tender Manager e con le principali funzioni aziendali coinvolte nei processi per organizzare dati, lavorare sui KPI e implementare il nuovo modulo di Contract Manager integrato con funzionalità di Intelligenza Artificiale per lo scouting dei bandi di gara.

Responsabilità dello stagista


Monitoraggio KPI Tender e Reporting
Supportare la raccolta, validazione e analisi dei dati relativi alle gare.
Aggiornare periodicamente dashboard e report di monitoraggio.
Elaborazione reportistica e monitoraggio su KPI chiave quali a titolo esemplificativo :
Numero gare gestite
Tasso di aggiudicazione
Mancate aggiudicazioni ed esclusioni
Lead time dei processi approvativi
Monitoraggio della contract compliance
Reporting Consip
Sviluppo e manutenzione Dashboard KPI
Supportare la costruzione e manutenzione di dashboard in Excel, Power BI o strumenti aziendali.
Standardizzare la reportistica per garantire coerenza e affidabilità delle informazioni.
Strutturare flussi interni per alimentare le dashboard e la reportistica.
Supporto all'implementazione del Modulo BOT di contract manager
Partecipare alle attività di configurazione e testing del nuovo modulo BOT per la fase di scouting capitolati.
Supportare la raccolta dei requisiti utente e la relativa documentazione.
Collaborare alla definizione dei flussi operativi e delle responsabilità degli utenti coinvolti nel processo.
Analisi dei Processi e Miglioramento Continuo
Mappare i principali processi di reportistica e KPI del Tender Office.
Identificare opportunità di semplificazione, standardizzazione e automazione.
Partecipare a iniziative cross-funzionali finalizzate all'individuazione di ulteriori analisi e opportunità di ottimizzazione dei processi.
Creazione flussi e linee guida
Predisporre guide operative e materiale formativo per gli utenti.
Supportare l'organizzazione di sessioni di training sul modulo BOT e sugli strumenti di monitoraggio KPI.
Raccogliere feedback dagli utenti e proporre miglioramenti.


Strumenti e competenze

Dati & Tool


Excel avanzato (Pivot, formule avanzate).
Microsoft PowerPoint.
Microsoft Teams e SharePoint.


Competenze


Forte attitudine analitica, capacità di organizzazione dei processi e strutturazione dei flussi informativi.
Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio.
Capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità.
Problem solving e approccio al miglioramento continuo.
Capacità di lavorare in team e interfacciarsi con stakeholder differenti.


Lingue


Inglese di buon livello, sia scritto che parlato.


Requisiti candidato


Laureando o neolaureato in Ingegneria Gestionale, Economia, Statistica, Data Science o discipline affini.
Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft Office, in particolare Excel.
Interesse per analisi dati, processi aziendali e digitalizzazione.
Precisione, proattività, spirito di iniziativa e orientamento ai risultati.

Title: Attuario Pricing – Non Motor
Description:
Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con solide competenze attuariali in ambito pricing, da inserire in un team nuovo e dinamico all’interno dell’Attuariato Danni Non Auto. La figura contribuirà in modo attivo alla definizione delle tariffe, allo sviluppo di modelli statistici avanzati e al monitoraggio tecnico dei portafogli Non Motor.




La risorsa si occuperà di:

Preparare e strutturare le basi dati necessarie alle analisi tariffarie e al monitoraggio tecnico, anche attraverso l’organizzazione dei dati storici aziendali e l’integrazione con fonti esterne
Condurre analisi univariate dei principali fattori di rischio e predisporre reportistica con KPI rilevanti
Sviluppare modelli predittivi (GLM e tecniche di machine learning) per i principali perils, con focus su rischi climatici e analisi territoriale
Calcolare il technical price, puntuale e aggregato, valutando componenti attuariali e di costo secondo le linee guida di Gruppo
Realizzare analisi di impatto tariffario (AS IS / AS IF analysis) tramite simulazioni sulle strutture tariffarie per supportare la calibrazione finale del pricing
Contribuire alla definizione della reportistica tecnica (es. Leakage), secondo le linee guida di capogruppo, predisponendo analisi di approfondimento ad hoc.




Requirements

Laurea in Scienze Attuariali, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini (preferibile indirizzo data science)
Familiarità con strumenti di data analysis e machine learning (Python/R) e ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office (Excel)
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.




Competenze trasversali

Capacità di gestire richieste complesse e strutturate, coinvolgendo più interlocutori
Motivazione, impegno, flessibilità e orientamento al risultato
Ottime capacità relazionali e attitudine al lavoro in team.




Nice to have

Esperienza anche minima in ambito area tecnica Danni
Familiarità con le tecniche di analisi multivariata e con i software di modellizzazione (Emblem/Radar)
Conoscenza delle componenti del fabbisogno tariffario dei prodotti Danni e dei prodotti multirischio
Conoscenza base dei requisiti normativi (es. VfM in ambito PoG) e dei relativi processi di monitoraggio.




Soft Skills

Spiccate capacità di analisi quantitativa e approccio metodico al problem solving
Curiosità, visione innovativa e apertura al cambiamento
Attitudine alla formazione continua
Capacità di gestione del tempo e dello stress
Proattività e determinazione nel proporre soluzioni con autonomia decisionale.

Title: JUNIOR SHORT TERM OPTIMIZATION
HTML:
Descrizione azienda

TTEP Italia, la nuova identità di EP Produzione, è parte di TTEP, la piattaforma energetica europea nata dalla partnership paritaria tra EPH e TotalEnergies. La Società opera in Italia nella generazione flessibile di energia con un portafoglio diversificato di centrali a gas e impianti a biomasse, per circa 4,6 GW di capacità operativa. Attraverso le proprie competenze industriali, il radicamento nei territori, lo sviluppo di soluzioni di accumulo e le attività di fornitura a clienti industriali, TTEP Italia contribuisce alla sicurezza energetica del Paese e alla transizione del sistema elettrico.

Posizione

Per la posizione di Junior Short Term Optimization, stiamo cercando una persona da inserire nel team della Direzione Energy Management.

All’interno dell’Area Short Term Optimization ti occuperai delle attività di ottimizzazione del portafoglio di generazione su un orizzonte temporale di breve termine, analizzando gli scenari di mercato e definendo le strategie di vendita fino al mercato spot, “day ahead” e “intraday”, organizzato dal Gestore dei Mercati Energetici (GME).

Nello Specifico Ti Saranno Affidate Le Seguenti Responsabilità

  • Definire la strategia di offerta del mercato del giorno prima e il relativo pricing con dettaglio quartorario;
  • Definire la strategia per l'acquisto del prodotto mensile CCC per la copertura del corrispettivo di capacità di trasporto (CCT) e partecipare alle relative aste;
  • Definire la strategia di offerta sui mercati infragiornalieri (mercati MI);
  • Predisporre la reportistica actual sui margini MGP realizzati e del forecast settimanale a supporto della strategia di ottimizzazione di portafoglio per la settimana successiva;
  • Gestire i piani di prove ed indisponibilità dal mese al Day-Ahead costituendo l’interfaccia sia nei confronti delle centrali che di Terna;
  • Definire la previsione di consumo gas nell'orizzonte temporale di competenza;
  • Sviluppare e aggiornare i tool relativi ai processi di competenza in funzione delle necessità di business.

Requisiti

  • Laurea in Ingegneria, Finanza o in Matematica;

Soft Skills

  • Ottima capacità di analisi;
  • Ottima predisposizione alle relazioni e al lavoro in team.

Altri Requisiti

  • Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese;
  • Buona conoscenza del sistema Windows e del Pacchetto Office; verrà considerato un plus la conoscenza di un linguaggio di programmazione (es. Power BI, SQL, VBA, Python).

Altre informazioni

COSA OFFRIAMO

  • Modalità lavorativa ibrida: Smart working e flessibilità organizzativa;
  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato;
  • Programma di onboarding dedicato ai neoassunti per accompagnare al meglio i nuovi ingressi;
  • Formazione continua: grazie ai nostri percorsi interni e al training on the job potrai sviluppare competenze tecniche e manageriali lavorando a contatto diretto con figure senior del settore energetico;
  • Ambiente dinamico e collaborativo: lavorerai in un contesto stimolante, orientato al lavoro di squadra, alla condivisione e all’innovazione;
  • Work-life balance: mettiamo al centro il benessere delle persone offrendo un piano di welfare aziendale con una serie di benefit pensati per supportare il benessere dei nostri dipendenti, dentro e fuori l’ufficio;
  • Ticket restaurant;
  • Fondo pensionistico integrativo ed Assistenza Sanitaria Integrativa;
  • Accesso al circuito Wellhub.

Informazioni Retributive

Ai sensi dell’art. 5 del D.Lgs. 96/2026 in materia di trasparenza retributiva, per la presente posizione è prevista una RAL compresa tra € 40k e € 43k.

L’inquadramento e il trattamento economico sono determinati sulla base di criteri oggettivi, trasparenti e non discriminatori, correlati alle responsabilità del ruolo e alle competenze richieste in coerenza con il CCNL per i lavoratori addetti al settore elettrico.

Eventuali trattamenti economici migliorativi potranno essere valutati esclusivamente in presenza di ulteriori elementi oggettivamente verificabili, quali esperienza professionale, competenze specialistiche o qualificazioni pertinenti alla posizione.

Lavoriamo ogni giorno per costruire un ambiente accogliente e rispettoso, in cui ciascuna persona possa esprimere al meglio il proprio potenziale.

L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto delle pari opportunità e della parità di trattamento (D.Lgs. 198/2006 e Direttiva 2000/78/CE).

Title: Junior Consultant Economic Advisory - EYP
Description:
Junior Consultant Economic Advisory

In EY‑Parthenon mettiamo al centro la tua crescita: competenze avanzate, accesso a progetti ad alta complessità e un ambiente che valorizza la tua esperienza. La tua capacità di giudizio e il tuo modo di guidare persone, relazioni e decisioni in contesti in continua evoluzione.

Con noi puoi dare forma al tuo futuro, contribuendo a trasformare aziende e settori, attraverso la combinazione di competenze strategiche, insight abilitati dalla tecnologia e comprensione delle esigenze delle persone e delle organizzazioni.

Chi siamo

EY‑Parthenon combina strategia trasformativa, competenze transazionali e corporate finance per generare valore concreto per le organizzazioni. Lavorerai in team multidisciplinari, collaborando con alcuni dei principali player globali.

La tua opportunità

In EY Economic Advisory, lavorerai in un team multidisciplinare che supporta clienti pubblici e privati nell’analisi economica, nella valutazione di impatto, nella consulenza su politiche pubbliche e nella definizione di strategie aziendali basate su evidenze.

Di cosa ti occuperai


Analisi di impatto socioeconomico di progetti e investimenti
Analisi di scenario macroeconomico
Previsioni macroeconomiche
Stesura di report di analisi economica
Mantenimento di database macroeconomici
Analisi di microdati
Supervisione tecnica delle attività eseguite dalle risorse più junior all'interno del team
Preparazione dei documenti da sottoporre alla review dei responsabili di progetto


Il profile che cerchiamo


Esperienza di circa 1-2 anni di attività di analisi economica maturata in istituzioni, centri di ricerca o società di consulenza
Laurea Specialistica in Economia con indirizzo Economics/Econometrics
Esperienza nelle seguenti attività: analisi di impatto socioeconomico di progetti e investimenti, analisi di scenario macroeconomico, previsioni macroeconomiche, stesura di report di analisi economica, mantenimento di database macroeconomici, analisi di microdati
Capacità di utilizzo di software econometrici (p.es. EViews, Matlab, R) e conoscenza approfondita di tecniche standard di micro-macro econometria


Cosa ti offriamo


Percorsi di sviluppo basati su competenze future-ready, metodologie all’avanguardia e soluzioni abilitate da AI, per ampliare il tuo potenziale e concentrarti sulle attività in cui esperienza, intuizione e leadership generano maggiore valore.
Un ambiente inclusivo che valorizza background e prospettive diverse, fondamentale per innovare, rafforzare la qualità del confronto e prendere decisioni più consapevoli.
Opportunità di lavorare in team internazionali attraversando settori e deal complessi.
Programmi strutturati di formazione continua e accesso a piattaforme evolute per accelerare la tua crescita, integrando sviluppo professionale, apprendimento sul campo e condivisione delle competenze.


In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: 

Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva. 

Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. 

Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99. 

Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 30000 e 32000 euro, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.

Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno. 

Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro in EY‑Parthenon? Candidati ora.

Title: Senior Commercial Insights & Planning Analyst - Contratto a Tempo Determinato
Description:
Salary: €40800 – €51000 EUR annual gross salary

Stiamo cercando un/una Senior Commercial Insights & Planning Analyst che supporti il processo decisionale del business attraverso analisi commerciali, insight di mercato e pianificazione strutturata.

La persona selezionata entrerà a far parte del team Cluster Insights & Intelligence SE Europe e lavorerà a stretto contatto con Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain e Insights, trasformando dati di mercato e performance commerciali in raccomandazioni concrete per il business italiano.

Il ruolo è ideale per un/una professionista con forte mentalità analitica e orientamento commerciale, interessato/a a comprendere cosa guida la performance del business, quali opportunità emergono dal mercato e quali azioni possono generare valore.

La persona selezionata contribuirà a identificare i principali driver di performance e opportunità di crescita, supportando decisioni commerciali basate su dati e insight.

Responsabilità principali

In questo ruolo contribuirai a trasformare dati e analisi in insight utili a guidare le decisioni commerciali, occupandoti di:


Analisi della performance commerciale, trend di mercato, sell-out, market share e dinamiche competitive per identificare opportunità e aree di miglioramento.
Supporto ai processi di forecasting, scenario modelling e business planning, contribuendo alla definizione di previsioni e scenari futuri.
Monitoraggio delle performance di vendita, categorie e canali, identificando i principali driver di crescita o gli scostamenti rispetto ai piani.
Supporto a business review, IBP/S&OP e valutazione di iniziative commerciali, fornendo analisi e raccomandazioni data-driven.
Traduzione di dati provenienti da diverse fonti in insight chiari e actionable per stakeholder di Sales, Marketing, Finance e Supply Chain.
Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali per supportare decisioni strategiche sul mercato italiano.


Competenze ed esperienze richieste

Il profilo ideale ha una forte mentalità analitica, orientamento commerciale e capacità di trasformare dati e insight in raccomandazioni per il business.

Requisiti:


3+ anni di esperienza in ruoli quali Business Planning, Commercial Insights, Business Performance, Sales Analytics, Market Intelligence, Category Management, Trade Marketing Analytics o ruoli commerciali analitici in contesti FMCG.
Esperienza nell’analisi di performance commerciali, trend di mercato, dati di vendita, category performance o market dynamics.
Capacità di interpretare dati complessi e trasformarli in insight utili al processo decisionale.
Esperienza con forecasting, reporting, business review o pianificazione commerciale.
Ottima conoscenza di Excel e PowerPoint; esperienza con Power BI o strumenti di visualizzazione dati considerata un plus.
Inglese fluente scritto e parlato.
Approccio proattivo, autonomia e capacità di collaborare con stakeholder cross-funzionali.


Costituisce un plus l’esperienza in aziende FMCG, Consumer Goods, Retail o Tobacco.

Offerta prevista

In cambio del tuo ruolo nella costruzione del nostro futuro, riceverai un pacchetto retributivo completo con stipendio, programma di bonus e ulteriori vantaggi, nonché luoghi stimolanti in cui lavorare e collaborare con uno scopo. Qui a Imperial ti daremo l'opportunità di crescere e imparare, innovare al ritmo e far parte del nostro scopo di tracciare un percorso verso un futuro più sano per momenti di relax e piacere per i nostri consumatori.

Inclusività

In Imperial abbiamo il massimo rispetto di ogni dipendente e siamo orgogliosi di essere un'organizzazione realmente inclusiva. Incoraggiamo e accogliamo candidature di persone di tutte le età, sesso, etnia, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o credo e neurodiversità, valutandole con la massima attenzione. Il nostro indirizzo web recruitment@impbrands.com è a disposizione per richieste di assistenza o per definire eventuali colloqui.

Chi siamo

Siamo un'azienda a forte impronta internazionale, la quarta più grande del nostro settore e operante in 119 mercati. Un'azienda produttrice di beni di consumo globale, inclusiva e innovativa che vanta 25.000 dipendenti. Ci stiamo trasformando di pari passo con l'evoluzione del mondo che ci circonda. La nostra visione e cultura del lavoro sono sostenute da una mentalità rivolta al futuro, che pone costantemente in discussione lo status quo e consente alle persone di raggiungere il loro massimo potenziale. La nostra agilità e capacità di collaborazione agevolano il raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi, l'innovazione e il successo, grazie ai nostri pluripremiati programmi di sviluppo che creano opportunità di carriera estremamente gratificanti.  Incoraggiando l'inclusività a livello locale e sostenendo globalmente un eccezionale programma di diversità, siamo pienamente impegnati a creare e mantenere un ambiente che celebra e rispetta ogni differenza.

Per una questione di politica, Imperial Tobacco o le sue sussidiarie non richiedono mai o richiedono un pagamento come parte di alcun processo di reclutamento.

Title: Business Analyst - Graduate Development Program
Description:
About ION

We are a Software Product Company with a global footprint in the FinTech sector. With more than 10,000 professionals across 40+ offices worldwide, we provide solutions combining trading and workflow automation, market data, and advanced business intelligence.

Our Graduate Development Program is a three-year journey designed for recent graduates who look beyond the obvious, challenge existing processes, and are driven to automate and reinvent the way things work.

The program is structured into 4 progressive phases, each with distinct learning objectives. Tasks evolve according to your abilities and interests, ensuring the experience is as individual as you are.

From day one, you join ION on a full‑time permanent contract, carry real accountability on live projects, and be paired with senior professionals who guide your development throughout the entire journey.

What You'll Do

Across phases, you will support different stages of the product lifecycle, gaining exposure to trading and workflow automation solutions, data processing, and business intelligence. Your work will include:


Analyzing processes and workflows to identify inefficiencies and automation opportunities
Supporting data processing and contributing to business intelligence initiatives
Collaborating with product, development, and operations teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
Presenting findings, gathering feedback, and iterating based on real-world data


What We're Looking For


Master's degree in a STEM field — obtained within the last year or currently in progress, with a strong academic record
Written and spoken English at B2 level or above
Strong collaboration and teamworking skills
Based in Italy or willing to relocate; non-EU candidates must hold a valid EU work permit


Gross Salary Range

34.000 - 38.000 EUR

Pursuant to Italian Law (L.68/99), candidates registered on the disability list will be given priority. Only candidates meeting the selection criteria will be contacted. Please apply only if you currently hold full legal right to work in Italy.

We envision a world where people from different cultures can communicate seamlessly, gaining unprecedented access to knowledge, cultural exchange, and opportunity. To make this possible, we combine proprietary translation AI (Lara Translate) with advanced text, audio, and video translation technologies (Matecat, Matesub, and Matedub) and the world’s largest network of vetted, native-speaking language professionals.

We welcome complex technical challenges from our customers and engineer tailored solutions that often become part of our core products, whether integrated into our enterprise localization platform, the tools designed to support translators, or Lara Translate, our online AI translator for teams and individuals.

Everything we build reflects a simple principle: technology should amplify human potential, not replace it.

We believe in humans.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Data Scientist to work closely with our customers, product teams, and leadership, transforming complex business challenges into data-driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with business acumen and the ability to work directly with stakeholders. You will investigate customer and product data, develop analyses and models, and help deploy solutions that generate measurable business impact.




The Role: Forward Deployed Data Science

Forward Deployed Data Scientists operate at the intersection of data science, product, engineering, and customer success.

You will collaborate directly with Translated’s enterprise customers and internal teams to understand their objectives, investigate their data, identify opportunities, and develop solutions tailored to their operational needs. These solutions may include analytical models, forecasting systems, performance metrics, experiments, dashboards, and data products.

Rather than working only on predefined datasets or isolated research questions, you will follow projects through their complete lifecycle: from problem definition and data discovery to implementation, validation, deployment, and communication of results.

You will gradually develop a deep understanding of Translated’s business, products, and technology, working across areas such as translation quality, operational efficiency, customer behavior, demand forecasting, marketing performance, and financial outcomes.

Successful projects may become reusable capabilities integrated into Translated’s products, enterprise platform, or internal decision-making systems.




Responsibilities

Work directly with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into well-defined data problems.
Identify, access, and evaluate relevant internal and external data sources.
Conduct initial data investigations and exploratory data analysis.
Develop metrics, statistical analyses, machine learning models, and other data-driven solutions.
Design experiments and measurement frameworks to evaluate product and business initiatives.
Analyze customer behavior, operational performance, translation quality, revenue, costs, and other key business indicators.
Build prototypes and collaborate with engineering teams to turn successful analyses into reliable production solutions.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that make complex findings accessible and actionable.
Present recommendations and results clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, leadership, and customers.
Define success criteria, measure outcomes, and continuously improve deployed solutions.
Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, AI researchers, sales teams, and customer-facing teams.
Help develop reusable analytical methods, tools, and best practices across the company.
Stay informed about developments in data science, machine learning, analytics, and applied AI.




Requirements

3+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Data Analytics, Applied Machine Learning, or a related quantitative role.
Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, and experimental design.
Excellent programming skills in Python.
Strong experience with SQL and working with large, complex datasets.
Experience with data exploration, statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation.
Ability to transform ambiguous business questions into structured, measurable analytical problems.
Experience defining business and product metrics and using data to support decision-making.
Familiarity with modern data pipelines, data warehouses, and analytical workflows.
Experience with at least one business intelligence or data visualization tool, such as Metabase, Tableau, Superset, or a similar platform.
Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
Ability to manage projects involving multiple stakeholders and evolving requirements.
Excellent written and spoken English.
BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or another relevant quantitative field.




Bonus Points If…

You have worked in a customer-facing, consulting, solutions engineering, or forward deployed role.
You have experience taking data science projects from initial discovery through deployment and business adoption.
You have worked with enterprise customers and complex operational processes.
You have experience with AWS and data technologies such as S3, Redshift, Redis, Spark, or similar systems.
You have experience with distributed data processing or large-scale computing tools.
You have worked with product analytics, forecasting, optimization, experimentation, or causal inference.
You have experience analyzing data from third-party platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Ads, or other marketing and product systems.
You understand business metrics and channels such as revenue, gross margin, retention, conversion, SEO, SEM, paid acquisition, and mobile applications.
You have experience building dashboards and presenting insights to senior stakeholders or customers.
You have experience with NLP, Large Language Models, or multilingual technologies.
You have worked with data quality, monitoring, model observability, or production machine learning systems.




Headquarter

Translated is hosted at Pi Campus, a working environment immersed in nature where six luxury villas in Rome, Italy, have been converted into functional offices designed to foster talent growth. Pi Campus is also a venture firm created by Translated to reinvest part of its profits into promising AI startups.




Our Offer

Depending on expertise, the offered salary typically ranges between €40,000 and €60,000. Compensation generally grows quickly as experience leads to greater contributions. Exceptionally strong candidates may be offered salaries above this range to acknowledge their higher potential impact.

We offer a flexible remote work policy, combined with a requirement for periodic presence at our Rome headquarters.




Benefits and Perks

At Translated, we see our people as athletes, and Pi Campus as the place where they can reach their full potential. This vibrant environment fosters talent aggregation and continuous growth of mind, body, and spirit.

We nurture and support the team’s personal and professional development every day through growth-oriented initiatives like personalized learning paths and networking events with industry leaders, health-oriented initiatives like massages, sauna, and workouts in our gym and swimming pool, as well as relaxation rooms, open meeting rooms, a cafeteria, and fully equipped kitchens in every villa. In case of need, every team member has access to psychological, legal, and financial support.

Learn more about our company: https://translated.com/work-at-translated-onboarding.




Application Process

We will conduct an initial screening based on the information you provide about yourself and your experience.

If the screening is successful, we will send you a practical case study designed to assess how you approach an applied data problem. The exercise should require no more than one working day, and you will have one week to complete it. We may also arrange a call beforehand to answer questions and provide additional context.

Once submitted, we will review your work and provide feedback. Successful candidates will then be invited to an interview to discuss the exercise, their technical approach, and their experience working with data and stakeholders.

If everything goes well, we will make you an offer to join our team.




Diversity Statement

At Translated, we proudly embrace and celebrate the unique qualities each individual brings to our team, regardless of race, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other difference.

We recognize that diverse perspectives empower us to overcome challenges, foster innovation, and drive excellence. As an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer, we are committed to cultivating an environment where everyone feels welcome, valued, and supported in reaching their full potential.

Title: Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist
Description:
POSITION SNAPSHOT

JobReq ID: 55578

Type of work: Hybrid

Type of contract: Open-ended/permanent

Full/Part Time: Full time

Salary Range:

Location:

ROMA, IT Zaventem, BE

About Us

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, and Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA), headquartered in Brussels, Belgium, operate collectively as a “Bridgestone West” strategic region. This region services the strategic business needs of teams across the Americas, Europe, Middle East and Africa. BSAM and BSEMEA are subsidiaries of Bridgestone Corporation, globally headquartered in Japan. Bridgestone and its subsidiaries develop, manufacture and market a wide range of Bridgestone, Firestone and associate brand products and solutions to address the needs of a broad range of customers and industries.

About The Role

Job Purpose

As part of the Procurement Operations, Digitalization & Strategic Excellence team, the Procurement Data & Digital Excellence Specialist is responsible for building and maintaining the data foundations that enable modern, data-driven procurement operations.

The role ensures procurement data is accurate, reliable, governed, and accessible in real time to support operational excellence, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities. Working closely with procurement, IT, data engineering, and business stakeholders, the specialist will transform procurement data into a strategic asset that drives better decision-making and continuous improvement

Also, Bridgestone Europe is embedding AI across multiple ERP (mostly SAP - S/4HANA, BDC) landscapes and platforms. Within Procurement, this role delivers the data products that make those use cases possible: clearly defined, properly modelled, documented, and trusted.

Responsibilities

Data Governance & Stewardship



Act as the Procurement Data Steward for master and transactional procurement data.
Define, implement and continuously improve procurement data standards, governance and quality rules.
Monitor data quality KPIs and drive corrective actions with business and IT teams.
Ensure data consistency across SAP and connected procurement applications.



Data Foundation & Architecture



Data Attribute Definition: Define and document data attributes, business rules, calculation logic, and field-level definitions for all procurement data products — spend, suppliers, contracts, and purchasing KPIs.
Collaborate with IT and Data Platform teams to ensure procurement data is available, secure and scalable.
Support the integration of SAP data with enterprise data platforms and analytical environments.
Contribute to the evolution of procurement data architecture.
Source-to-Target Validation: mappings from SAP S/4HANA and various data sources into SAP Business Data Cloud and Databricks, ensuring data flows correctly and completely.



Analytics & Business Intelligence



Develop and maintain procurement dashboards, KPIs and self-service reporting solutions.
Translate business requirements into actionable reporting and analytics.
Support procurement category managers and leadership with insightful data analysis.
Promote data-driven decision making throughout the procurement organization.



AI Enablement



Ensure procurement data is AI-ready by improving its quality, structure and accessibility.
Support the deployment of AI and Generative AI use cases within procurement.
Partner with Digital and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and predictive analytics.



Qualifications & Experience Required

Education, Master, other certification:



Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
SAP certifications or proven experience in S/4HANA, BTP, Datasphere / Business Data Cloud, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks, or hyperscaler data platforms are a strong advantage.
Training in data modelling, data governance, or AI and machine learning fundamentals is a plus.



Experience (years):



3-5 years in a data, analytics, procurement operations, or procurement technology role.
SAP is essential: hands-on experience with S/4HANA procurement data structures, plus exposure to SAP Business Data Cloud, Datasphere, BTP, and SAP Business AI.
Proven end-to-end delivery of data products, from definition to production, not one-off extracts.
Hands-on experience with Databricks, Python, and SQL within a lakehouse or cloud data platform.
Experience with integration and harmonisation of data across multiple or heterogeneous ERP systems.
Experience preparing and governing data for AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics use cases.
International, multi-country transformation programmes are a plus.



Technical Skills:



SAP S/4HANA procurement data objects and master data: vendor, material, info records, source lists, contracts, purchase orders.
SAP Business Data Cloud: data products, spaces, replication, consumption models; awareness of SAP Business AI, Joule, and AI Foundation on SAP BTP.
Data modelling: relational and dimensional, semantic layers, canonical cross-system models, master data harmonisation.
SQL and Python, including pandas and PySpark, for transformation, analysis, and automation.
Databricks: notebooks, Delta Lake, workflows.
Common data technologies beyond SAP: cloud data warehouses, ETL/ELT and orchestration, APIs, event-based integration.
Architectural design at comprehension level: layering, lakehouse versus warehouse, batch versus real-time, and related trade-offs.
Data governance: lineage, cataloguing, data contracts, and quality frameworks.
SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, or Tableau; advanced Excel and PowerPoint.



Languages Skills:



Fluent English, written and spoken.
Additional European languages are a plus.



Soft/Behavioral Skills:



Structured and precise, with rigour on definitions and documentation.
Systems thinking: connects business process, data structure, and technology.
Explains data and AI concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Turns ambiguous business needs into scoped, deliverable data requirements.
Curious about emerging data and AI technologies; comfortable with change and ambiguity.
Strong ownership across multiple stakeholders and parallel deliverables.



Salary range: € 37,601.10 - 54,000

The salary range is based on gender-neutral criteria: applicable CCNL requirements, responsibilities, working conditions and market benchmarks for the role and location. Final compensation will be determined based on gender-neutral criteria: experience, skills, and internal equity.

What We Offer

At Bridgestone, what really matter is to foster co-creation opportunities and empowering you to be creative and curious to make mobility safer, more efficient, and more sustainable for future generations. Whatever role you fill, when you represent Bridgestone, you are a valued teammate, and part of our larger mission to “Serve Society with Superior Quality”, for that, we offer you more than just a competitive payment; we will provide you:



A supportive and engaging onboarding experience to ensure a smooth transition into our team.
The opportunity to develop and grow, through training and regular mentorship.
Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
A truly global, dynamic and challenging work environment.
Agility and work/life effectiveness and your long-term well-being.
A diverse and inclusive team.



We are committed to create an even more inclusive culture that advances equity, embraces individuality, and helps our increasingly diverse teammates, customers, and communities thrive, by providing equal opportunities in employment. This means that all job applicants and members of staff will receive equal treatment and that we will not discriminate on grounds of gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, color, nationality, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, religion or age.

Title: Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Expert
Description:
Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Expert




NTU International is preparing a proposal for the project “Support to the Africa-EU Space Partnership Programme – AESPP Boost.”




The programme aims to strengthen cooperation between Africa and the European Union in the space sector, supporting policy dialogue, institutional partnerships, knowledge exchange, innovation, private sector engagement and investment, while contributing to stronger and more sustainable African space ecosystems.




In this context, we are seeking a highly qualified Non Key Expert – Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) Expert to support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the programme's monitoring, evaluation and learning framework.




Minimum Qualifications and Skills

University degree at Master’s level in evaluation, statistics/data science, development economics, social sciences, or a related field. In the absence of such degree, four additional years of relevant professional experience.
Excellent command of English.
Working knowledge of French and/or Portuguese will be considered an asset.




Minimum General Professional Experience

Minimum 8 years of professional experience in monitoring and evaluation, results-based management, programme evaluation and/or applied data analysis.




Minimum Specific Professional Experience

At least 4 years of professional experience in the design and/or operation of Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning frameworks for donor-funded or complex multi-partner programmes, including indicators, baselines, data collection protocols, evidence consolidation and/or impact assessment.
Experience with EU-funded programmes and in Africa is an asset.




If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and upload your CV via LinkedIn or send to recruitment@ntu.eu. Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted due to the large amount of applicants

Title: Attuario Pricing – Non Motor
Description:
Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con solide competenze attuariali in ambito pricing, da inserire in un team nuovo e dinamico all’interno dell’Attuariato Danni Non Auto. La figura contribuirà in modo attivo alla definizione delle tariffe, allo sviluppo di modelli statistici avanzati e al monitoraggio tecnico dei portafogli Non Motor.




La risorsa si occuperà di:

Preparare e strutturare le basi dati necessarie alle analisi tariffarie e al monitoraggio tecnico, anche attraverso l’organizzazione dei dati storici aziendali e l’integrazione con fonti esterne
Condurre analisi univariate dei principali fattori di rischio e predisporre reportistica con KPI rilevanti
Sviluppare modelli predittivi (GLM e tecniche di machine learning) per i principali perils, con focus su rischi climatici e analisi territoriale
Calcolare il technical price, puntuale e aggregato, valutando componenti attuariali e di costo secondo le linee guida di Gruppo
Realizzare analisi di impatto tariffario (AS IS / AS IF analysis) tramite simulazioni sulle strutture tariffarie per supportare la calibrazione finale del pricing
Contribuire alla definizione della reportistica tecnica (es. Leakage), secondo le linee guida di capogruppo, predisponendo analisi di approfondimento ad hoc.




Requirements

Laurea in Scienze Attuariali, Statistica, Matematica o discipline affini (preferibile indirizzo data science)
Familiarità con strumenti di data analysis e machine learning (Python/R) e ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office (Excel)
Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata.




Competenze trasversali

Capacità di gestire richieste complesse e strutturate, coinvolgendo più interlocutori
Motivazione, impegno, flessibilità e orientamento al risultato
Ottime capacità relazionali e attitudine al lavoro in team.




Nice to have

Esperienza anche minima in ambito area tecnica Danni
Familiarità con le tecniche di analisi multivariata e con i software di modellizzazione (Emblem/Radar)
Conoscenza delle componenti del fabbisogno tariffario dei prodotti Danni e dei prodotti multirischio
Conoscenza base dei requisiti normativi (es. VfM in ambito PoG) e dei relativi processi di monitoraggio.




Soft Skills

Spiccate capacità di analisi quantitativa e approccio metodico al problem solving
Curiosità, visione innovativa e apertura al cambiamento
Attitudine alla formazione continua
Capacità di gestione del tempo e dello stress
Proattività e determinazione nel proporre soluzioni con autonomia decisionale.

Title: Business Analyst - Graduate Development Program
Description:
About ION

We are a Software Product Company with a global footprint in the FinTech sector. With more than 10,000 professionals across 40+ offices worldwide, we provide solutions combining trading and workflow automation, market data, and advanced business intelligence.

Our Graduate Development Program is a three-year journey designed for recent graduates who look beyond the obvious, challenge existing processes, and are driven to automate and reinvent the way things work.

The program is structured into 4 progressive phases, each with distinct learning objectives. Tasks evolve according to your abilities and interests, ensuring the experience is as individual as you are.

From day one, you join ION on a full‑time permanent contract, carry real accountability on live projects, and be paired with senior professionals who guide your development throughout the entire journey.

What You'll Do

Across phases, you will support different stages of the product lifecycle, gaining exposure to trading and workflow automation solutions, data processing, and business intelligence. Your work will include:


Analyzing processes and workflows to identify inefficiencies and automation opportunities
Supporting data processing and contributing to business intelligence initiatives
Collaborating with product, development, and operations teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
Presenting findings, gathering feedback, and iterating based on real-world data


What We're Looking For


Master's degree in a STEM field — obtained within the last year or currently in progress, with a strong academic record
Written and spoken English at B2 level or above
Strong collaboration and teamworking skills
Based in Italy or willing to relocate; non-EU candidates must hold a valid EU work permit


Gross Salary Range

34.000 - 38.000 EUR

Pursuant to Italian Law (L.68/99), candidates registered on the disability list will be given priority. Only candidates meeting the selection criteria will be contacted. Please apply only if you currently hold full legal right to work in Italy.
